R1InputPairSelection.text:
import R1InputPair
import R1SpendSemantics

/-! The occupied slot is the same commitment carried by the input-note hash
block. The equality is derived from the path gates and literal copy links. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.InputPairSelection
open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

open Classical in
theorem path_bit (A : Trace K) :
    (tracePath A 0).1 = if A 0 913 = 0 then false else true := by
  classical
  unfold tracePath
  change ((if A 0 913 = 0 then _ else _) : Bool × R0P.Digest K).1 = _
  split <;> rfl

theorem left_path (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A)
    (i : Fin 8) : (InputPair.leaf A).firstCommitment i = A (i.castAdd 21) 914 := by
  exact ((copy_path_cells_of_balance pub A hb 0).1 i).symm

theorem right_path (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A)
    (i : Fin 8) : (InputPair.leaf A).secondCommitment i = A ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ 914 := by
  have h := (copy_path_cells_of_balance pub A hb 0).2.1 i
  change A ⟨i.val + 8, by omega⟩ 914 = A ⟨i.val + 8, by omega⟩ 64 +
    (if i.val = 7 then (1051521018 : K) else 0) at h
  simp only [Nat.add_comm i.val 8] at h
  exact (InputPairCopyLinks.right_cells pub A hb i).trans h.symm

theorem selected_output (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hp : Holds pathFamily pub A) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    (InputPair.leaf A).selectedCommitment (tracePath A 0).1 = OutputNotes.output A 3 := by
  classical
  have hpath := (path_holds_iff pub A).mp hp 913 (pathBaseRow_mem 0)
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hcurrent⟩ := copy_input_note_cells_of_balance pub A hb
  rw [path_bit]
  by_cases hz : A 0 913 = 0
  · rw [if_pos hz]
    change (InputPair.leaf A).firstCommitment = OutputNotes.output A 3
    funext i
    rw [left_path pub A hb i]
    have h := hpath.2.1 i
    rw [hz] at h
    have he : A (i.castAdd 21) 914 = A ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩ 913 := by
      rw [show succRow (913 : Fin 1024) = 914 by decide] at h
      simpa only [sub_zero, one_mul, sub_eq_zero, Fin.castAdd, Fin.castLE, Fin.addNat] using h
    exact he.trans (hcurrent i).symm
  · rw [if_neg hz]
    change (InputPair.leaf A).secondCommitment = OutputNotes.output A 3
    funext i
    rw [right_path pub A hb i]
    have h := hpath.2.2 i
    have he : A ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ 914 = A ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩ 913 :=
      sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left hz)
    exact he.trans (hcurrent i).symm

structure Facts (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) : Prop where
  valid : (InputPair.leaf A).Valid
  pair : OutputNotes.output A 4 =
    nodeCompress (InputPair.leaf A).firstCommitment (InputPair.leaf A).secondCommitment
  selected : (InputPair.leaf A).selectedCommitment (tracePath A 0).1 = OutputNotes.output A 3
  spendable : (InputPair.leaf A).SelectedSlotIsSpendable (tracePath A 0).1

theorem of_production (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (lam chi : K)
    (h : ProductionHolds pub lam chi A ∧ CopyLinkBalance pub A) : Facts pub A := by
  exact ⟨InputPair.leaf_valid pub A h.1.2.1,
    InputPair.pair_output pub A h.1.2.2.2.1 h.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 h.2,
    selected_output pub A h.1.2.2.2.2.1 h.2,
    InputPair.selected_spendable pub A h.1.2.1 h.2⟩

#print axioms selected_output
#print axioms of_production
end AspisR1.InputPairSelection
R1InputPairSelection.qualification: Retained source alongside hash-matched historical selected object; fresh replay required; no claim of an independently retained original source receipt.

R1InputPair.text:
import R1AppendPair
import R1InputPairCopyLinks

/-! The input pair and the occupancy of the slot selected by the literal
trace path. This does not yet strengthen the existential input-note witness
with a complete authenticated pair/forest relation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.InputPair
open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

attribute [local irreducible] nodeCompress poseidonPermutation

def leaf (A : Trace K) : PairLeaf K where
  firstCommitment := AppendNode.left A 4
  secondOccupied := A 0 1017
  secondCommitment := fun i => A ⟨2 + i.val, by omega⟩ 1017
  secondOccupancyInverse := A 1 1017

theorem leaf_valid (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (ho : Holds occupancyFamily pub A) : (leaf A).Valid := by
  have h := (occupancy_holds_iff pub A).mp ho |>.1 1017 (Or.inl rfl)
  exact ⟨h.1, sub_eq_zero.mp h.2.1, h.2.2.1, h.2.2.2⟩

theorem pair_output (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    OutputNotes.output A 4 = nodeCompress (leaf A).firstCommitment (leaf A).secondCommitment := by
  rw [AppendNode.node_step pub A hs hpo 4 (nodeBlock_node 0)]
  have hr : AppendNode.right A 4 = (leaf A).secondCommitment := by
    funext i
    exact (InputPairCopyLinks.right_cells pub A hb i).symm
  rw [hr]
  rfl

/-- The path's first side bit selects an occupied slot. The copy link binds
that very bit to the input occupancy gate, rather than assuming spendability. -/
theorem selected_spendable (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (ho : Holds occupancyFamily pub A) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    (leaf A).SelectedSlotIsSpendable (tracePath A 0).1 := by
  classical
  have hbit := InputPairCopyLinks.selected_bit pub A hb
  have hg := (occupancy_holds_iff pub A).mp ho |>.2.1
  rw [← hbit] at hg
  by_cases hz : A 0 913 = 0
  · have hp : (tracePath A 0).1 = false := by
      simp only [tracePath, pathBaseRow]
      change ((if A 0 913 = 0 then _ else _) : Bool × R0P.Digest K).1 = false
      rw [if_pos hz]
    rw [hp]
    exact first_slot_is_spendable (leaf A)
  · have hp : (tracePath A 0).1 = true := by
      simp only [tracePath, pathBaseRow]
      change ((if A 0 913 = 0 then _ else _) : Bool × R0P.Digest K).1 = true
      rw [if_neg hz]
    rw [hp, second_slot_spendable_iff]
    have hz' : 1 - A 0 1017 = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hg).resolve_left hz
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hz').symm

theorem empty_second_rejected (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (ho : Holds occupancyFamily pub A) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A)
    (hempty : (leaf A).secondOccupied = 0) : (tracePath A 0).1 = false := by
  have hs := selected_spendable pub A ho hb
  cases hp : (tracePath A 0).1 with
  | false => rfl
  | true =>
    rw [hp, second_slot_spendable_iff, hempty] at hs
    exact (zero_ne_one hs).elim

#print axioms leaf_valid
#print axioms pair_output
#print axioms selected_spendable
#print axioms empty_second_rejected
end AspisR1.InputPair
R1InputPair.qualification: Retained source alongside hash-matched historical selected object; fresh replay required; no claim of an independently retained original source receipt.

R1AppendPair.text:
import R1AppendNode
import R1PairCopyLinks
import R0P.Occupancy
import AspisFormal.Pool.V7PairLeafOccupancy

/-! The append leaf is the ordered output pair, with the existing algebraic
occupancy relation. Transfers append recipient/change; withdrawals append
change/zero. This derives the pair from gates and public digest bindings. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.AppendPair
open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def leaf (A : Trace K) : PairLeaf K where
  firstCommitment := AppendNode.left A 33
  secondOccupied := A 0 1018
  secondCommitment := fun i => A ⟨2 + i.val, by omega⟩ 1018
  secondOccupancyInverse := A 1 1018

theorem leaf_valid (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (ho : Holds occupancyFamily pub A) : (leaf A).Valid := by
  have h := (occupancy_holds_iff pub A).mp ho |>.1 1018 (Or.inr rfl)
  exact ⟨h.1, sub_eq_zero.mp h.2.1, h.2.2.1, h.2.2.2⟩

theorem pair_output (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    OutputNotes.output A 33 = nodeCompress (leaf A).firstCommitment (leaf A).secondCommitment := by
  rw [AppendNode.node_step pub A hs hpo 33 (by right; constructor <;> decide)]
  have hr : AppendNode.right A 33 = (leaf A).secondCommitment := by
    funext i
    exact (PairCopyLinks.right_cells pub A hb i).symm
  rw [hr]
  rfl

theorem transfer_first (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (hd : Holds digestFamily pub A)
    (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) (recipient : R0P.Digest K)
    (hpresent : pub.recipient = some recipient) : (leaf A).firstCommitment = recipient := by
  funext i
  exact (PairCopyLinks.first_transfer pub A hb hv i).symm.trans
    ((digest_holds_iff pub A).mp hd |>.2.2.1 recipient hpresent i)

theorem transfer_second (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (hd : Holds digestFamily pub A)
    (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) : (leaf A).secondCommitment = pub.change := by
  funext i
  exact (PairCopyLinks.second_transfer pub A hb hv i).symm.trans
    ((digest_holds_iff pub A).mp hd |>.2.2.2.1 i)

theorem withdrawal_first (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (hd : Holds digestFamily pub A)
    (hv : pub.variant = .withdrawal) : (leaf A).firstCommitment = pub.change := by
  funext i
  exact (PairCopyLinks.first_withdrawal pub A hb hv i).symm.trans
    ((digest_holds_iff pub A).mp hd |>.2.2.2.1 i)

theorem withdrawal_second (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (ho : Holds occupancyFamily pub A) (hv : pub.variant = .withdrawal) :
    (leaf A).secondCommitment = fun _ => 0 := by
  apply valid_empty_second_commitment_zero (leaf A) (leaf_valid pub A ho)
  have h := (occupancy_holds_iff pub A).mp ho |>.2.2
  simpa only [leaf, hv] using h

theorem transfer_output (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (hd : Holds digestFamily pub A)
    (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) (recipient : R0P.Digest K)
    (hpresent : pub.recipient = some recipient) :
    OutputNotes.output A 33 = nodeCompress recipient pub.change := by
  rw [pair_output pub A hs hpo hb, transfer_first pub A hb hd hv recipient hpresent,
    transfer_second pub A hb hd hv]

theorem withdrawal_output (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (hd : Holds digestFamily pub A)
    (ho : Holds occupancyFamily pub A) (hv : pub.variant = .withdrawal) :
    OutputNotes.output A 33 = nodeCompress pub.change (fun _ => 0) := by
  rw [pair_output pub A hs hpo hb, withdrawal_first pub A hb hd hv,
    withdrawal_second pub A ho hv]

#print axioms leaf_valid
#print axioms transfer_output
#print axioms withdrawal_output
end AspisR1.AppendPair
R1AppendPair.qualification: Retained source alongside hash-matched historical selected object; fresh replay required; no claim of an independently retained original source receipt.

R1AppendNode.text:
import R1OutputNotes

/-! Symbolic node-compression and frozen-target untweaking interfaces. These
derive a hash node from the existing schedule/Poseidon gates. They neither
evaluate Poseidon nor assert that the frozen empty-root table is recursively
generated by that permutation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.AppendNode
open R0P
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

attribute [local irreducible] poseidonPermutation

def left (A : Trace K) (block : Fin 57) : Digest K := OutputNotes.chunk A block
def right (A : Trace K) (block : Fin 57) : Digest K := fun i =>
  poseidonState A block 0 ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ +
    if i.val = 7 then (1051521018 : K) else 0

theorem rate_zero (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (block : Fin 57)
    (hn : ScheduleNode block.val) (i : Fin 8) :
    poseidonState A block 0 (i.castAdd 8) = 0 := by
  have hdiv : (poseidonBlockRow block 0).val / 16 = block.val := by
    change (16 * block.val + 0) / 16 = block.val
    omega
  have hmod : (poseidonBlockRow block 0).val % 16 = 0 := by
    change (16 * block.val + 0) % 16 = 0
    omega
  exact ((schedule_holds_iff pub A).mp hs).2.1 _ hmod (by rwa [hdiv]) i

theorem node_step (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A)
    (block : Fin 57) (hn : ScheduleNode block.val) :
    OutputNotes.output A block = nodeCompress (left A block) (right A block) := by
  unfold OutputNotes.output nodeCompress
  rw [poseidon_scalar_holds_output pub A hpo block]
  apply congrArg digestOf
  apply congrArg poseidonPermutation
  funext lane
  by_cases hlow : lane.val < 8
  · rw [dif_pos hlow]
    have hz := rate_zero pub A hs block hn ⟨lane.val, hlow⟩
    change poseidonState A block 0 lane = 0 at hz
    change (if lane.val < 8 then
      poseidonState A block 0 lane + poseidonState A block 12 lane
      else poseidonState A block 0 lane) = _
    rw [if_pos hlow, hz, zero_add]
    rfl
  · rw [dif_neg hlow]
    change (if lane.val < 8 then
      poseidonState A block 0 lane + poseidonState A block 12 lane
      else poseidonState A block 0 lane) = _
    rw [if_neg hlow]
    by_cases h15 : lane.val = 15
    · rw [if_pos h15]
      have he : lane = 15 := Fin.ext h15
      subst lane
      change poseidonState A block 0 15 =
        poseidonState A block 0 15 + (1051521018 : K) - 1051521018
      ring
    · rw [if_neg h15]
      unfold right
      simp only [Fin.val_mk, if_neg (show ¬ lane.val - 8 = 7 from by omega), add_zero]
      apply congrArg (poseidonState A block 0)
      apply Fin.ext
      change lane.val = 8 + (lane.val - 8)
      omega

/-- Subtracting the characteristic before casting preserves the field value.
The branch comparison alone supplies the Nat-subtraction side condition. -/
theorem cast_reduce_once (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime] (n : Nat) :
    ((if prime ≤ n then n - prime else n : Nat) : K) = (n : K) := by
  by_cases h : prime ≤ n
  · rw [if_pos h, Nat.cast_sub h, CharP.cast_eq_zero K prime, sub_zero]
  · rw [if_neg h]

def frozenEmpty (level : Fin 21) : Digest K := fun i => (emptyRootsNat level i : K)

/-- The source's reduced right-target tweak and the registry's inverse tweak
cancel in characteristic 2^31-1. No empty-root recurrence premise is used. -/
theorem empty_target_untweak (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime]
    (hprime : prime = 2^31-1) (level : Fin 20) (i : Fin 8) :
    emptyRootRightTarget (K := K) level i +
      (if i.val = 7 then (1051521018 : K) else 0) = frozenEmpty level.castSucc i := by
  unfold emptyRootRightTarget frozenEmpty
  by_cases hi : i.val = 7
  · rw [if_pos (by omega : i.val + 1 = 8), if_pos hi]
    change ((if 0x7fff_ffff ≤ emptyRootsNat level.castSucc i + 0x4153_1005
      then emptyRootsNat level.castSucc i + 0x4153_1005 - 0x7fff_ffff
      else emptyRootsNat level.castSucc i + 0x4153_1005 : Nat) : K) + 1051521018 = _
    have hp : prime = 0x7fff_ffff := by omega
    rw [← hp, cast_reduce_once prime, Nat.cast_add]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have ht : (0x4153_1005 : K) + 1051521018 = 0 := by
      have hsum : (0x4153_1005 : Nat) + 1051521018 = prime := by omega
      calc
        (0x4153_1005 : K) + 1051521018 =
            (((0x4153_1005 : Nat) + 1051521018 : Nat) : K) := by
              norm_num only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat]
        _ = (prime : K) := congrArg (fun n : Nat => (n : K)) hsum
        _ = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero K prime
    rw [add_assoc, ht, add_zero]
  · rw [if_neg (by omega : ¬ i.val + 1 = 8), if_neg hi, add_zero]

#print axioms node_step
#print axioms empty_target_untweak
end AspisR1.AppendNode
R1AppendNode.qualification: Retained source alongside hash-matched historical selected object; fresh replay required; no claim of an independently retained original source receipt.

R1OutputNotes.text:
import R1OutputCopyLinks
import R0P.Semantics
import R0P.Asset

/-! Output-note extraction from the existing production families. The block
composition follows R0P.Extraction's input-note proof, keeping the permutation
opaque. Recipient extraction is explicitly private-transfer-only and public
recipient binding additionally requires the matching Option to be present.
No ownership of either output key or append transition is asserted here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.OutputNotes
open R0P
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

attribute [local irreducible] poseidonPermutation

def chunk (A : Trace K) (block : Fin 57) : Digest K :=
  digestOf (poseidonState A block 12)

def output (A : Trace K) (block : Fin 57) : Digest K :=
  digestOf (poseidonState A block 11)

/-- The six salt limbs in the middle chunk, then two in the final chunk. -/
def salt (A : Trace K) (middle last : Fin 57) : Digest K := fun i =>
  if h : i.val < 6 then chunk A middle ⟨i.val + 2, by omega⟩
  else chunk A last ⟨i.val - 6, by omega⟩

theorem block_step (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A) (block : Fin 57) :
    poseidonState A block 11 = spongeStep (poseidonState A block 0) (chunk A block) := by
  rw [poseidon_scalar_holds_output pub A hpo block]
  unfold spongeStep
  apply congrArg poseidonPermutation
  funext lane
  simp only [poseidonAbsorbedInput, absorb, chunk, digestOf, poseidonState]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

theorem initial (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (block : Fin 57)
    (hf : ScheduleFull pub.variant block.val) :
    poseidonState A block 0 = scheduleTarget pub.variant block.val := by
  have hdiv : (poseidonBlockRow block 0).val / 16 = block.val := by
    change (16 * block.val + 0) / 16 = block.val
    omega
  have hmod : (poseidonBlockRow block 0).val % 16 = 0 := by
    change (16 * block.val + 0) % 16 = 0
    omega
  funext lane
  have hh := ((schedule_holds_iff pub A).mp hs).1 _ hmod (by rwa [hdiv]) lane
  simpa only [hdiv] using hh

theorem last_padding (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (block : Fin 57)
    (hb : block.val = 29 ∨ block.val = 32) (i : Fin 8) (hi : 2 ≤ i.val) :
    chunk A block i = 0 := by
  have hdiv : (poseidonBlockRow block 12).val / 16 = block.val := by
    change (16 * block.val + 12) / 16 = block.val
    omega
  have hmod : (poseidonBlockRow block 12).val % 16 = 12 := by
    change (16 * block.val + 12) % 16 = 12
    omega
  have hz := (schedule_holds_iff pub A).mp hs |>.2.2
    (poseidonBlockRow block 12) hmod (i.castAdd 8) (by
      rw [hdiv]
      change ScheduleAbsorbs pub.variant block.val i.val
      simp only [ScheduleAbsorbs, if_neg (show ¬ i.val < 2 from by omega),
        if_pos i.isLt]
      rcases hb with hb | hb
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl hb))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hb))
  exact hz

theorem middle_chunk (A : Trace K) (middle last : Fin 57) (value asset : K)
    (hv : chunk A middle 0 = value) (ha : chunk A middle 1 = asset) :
    chunk A middle = fun i : Fin 8 =>
      if i.val = 0 then value else if i.val = 1 then asset
      else salt A middle last ⟨i.val - 2, by omega⟩ := by
  funext i
  by_cases h0 : i.val = 0
  · rw [if_pos h0]
    have he : i = 0 := Fin.ext h0
    subst i
    exact hv
  · rw [if_neg h0]
    by_cases h1 : i.val = 1
    · rw [if_pos h1]
      have he : i = 1 := Fin.ext h1
      subst i
      exact ha
    · rw [if_neg h1]
      unfold salt
      rw [dif_pos (by omega : i.val - 2 < 6)]
      exact congrArg (chunk A middle) (Fin.ext (by
        change i.val = i.val - 2 + 2
        omega))

theorem last_chunk (A : Trace K) (middle last : Fin 57)
    (hz : ∀ i : Fin 8, 2 ≤ i.val → chunk A last i = 0) :
    chunk A last = fun i : Fin 8 =>
      if h : i.val < 2 then salt A middle last ⟨i.val + 6, by omega⟩ else 0 := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < 2
  · rw [dif_pos hi]
    unfold salt
    rw [dif_neg (by omega : ¬ i.val + 6 < 6)]
    exact congrArg (chunk A last) (Fin.ext (by
      change i.val = i.val + 6 - 6
      omega))
  · rw [dif_neg hi]
    exact hz i (by omega)

/-- A symbolic three-block hash composition; it does not evaluate Poseidon. -/
theorem note_of_blocks (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A) (first middle last : Fin 57)
    (value asset : K)
    (hinit : poseidonState A first 0 = spongeInit 0x4153_0003 18)
    (h01 : poseidonState A middle 0 = poseidonState A first 11)
    (h12 : poseidonState A last 0 = poseidonState A middle 11)
    (hv : chunk A middle 0 = value) (ha : chunk A middle 1 = asset)
    (hz : ∀ i : Fin 8, 2 ≤ i.val → chunk A last i = 0) :
    output A last = noteCommitment (chunk A first) value asset (salt A middle last) := by
  unfold noteCommitment output
  rw [block_step pub A hpo last, h12, block_step pub A hpo middle,
    h01, block_step pub A hpo first, hinit,
    middle_chunk A middle last value asset hv ha, last_chunk A middle last hz]

theorem change_hash (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (ha : Holds assetFamily pub A)
    (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    output A 32 = noteCommitment (chunk A 30) (A 10 1012) pub.assetId (salt A 31 32) := by
  obtain ⟨hc01, hc12, hv⟩ := OutputCopyLinks.change_cells pub A hb
  apply note_of_blocks pub A hpo 30 31 32
  · rw [initial pub A hs 30 (by right; right; right; left; rfl)]
    funext lane
    simp [scheduleTarget, spongeInit]
  · funext lane; exact (hc01 lane).symm
  · funext lane; exact (hc12 lane).symm
  · exact hv
  · exact (asset_holds_iff pub A).mp ha |>.2.1
  · exact last_padding pub A hs 32 (Or.inr rfl)

theorem recipient_hash (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hvariant : pub.variant = .privateTransfer)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (ha : Holds assetFamily pub A)
    (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    output A 29 = noteCommitment (chunk A 27) (A 10 1010) pub.assetId (salt A 28 29) := by
  obtain ⟨hc01, hc12, hv⟩ := OutputCopyLinks.recipient_cells pub A hb hvariant
  apply note_of_blocks pub A hpo 27 28 29
  · rw [initial pub A hs 27 (by right; right; right; right; left; rfl)]
    funext lane
    simp [scheduleTarget, spongeInit, hvariant]
  · funext lane; exact (hc01 lane).symm
  · funext lane; exact (hc12 lane).symm
  · exact hv
  · exact (asset_holds_iff pub A).mp ha |>.2.2.1 hvariant
  · exact last_padding pub A hs 29 (Or.inl rfl)

theorem change_public (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (ha : Holds assetFamily pub A)
    (hd : Holds digestFamily pub A) (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    pub.change = noteCommitment (chunk A 30) (A 10 1012) pub.assetId (salt A 31 32) := by
  have hbind : pub.change = output A 32 := by
    funext i
    exact ((digest_holds_iff pub A).mp hd |>.2.2.2.1 i).symm
  exact hbind.trans (change_hash pub A hs ha hpo hb)

theorem recipient_public (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hvariant : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) (recipient : Digest K)
    (hpresent : pub.recipient = some recipient)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (ha : Holds assetFamily pub A)
    (hd : Holds digestFamily pub A) (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    recipient = noteCommitment (chunk A 27) (A 10 1010) pub.assetId (salt A 28 29) := by
  have hbind : recipient = output A 29 := by
    funext i
    exact ((digest_holds_iff pub A).mp hd |>.2.2.1 recipient hpresent i).symm
  exact hbind.trans (recipient_hash pub A hvariant hs ha hpo hb)

#print axioms note_of_blocks
#print axioms change_public
#print axioms recipient_public
end AspisR1.OutputNotes

import R0P.CopyInputLinks

/-! Mechanical projections of the named output-copy registry entries.

These lemmas use only the selected source-order links and their declared
weights; they do not identify output commitments or establish semantic claims.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.OutputCopyLinks

open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

private def beforeAt (i : Fin 14) : CopyLink :=
  copyLinksBeforePositivity.get ⟨i.val, by
    have hlen : copyLinksBeforePositivity.length = 14 := rfl
    rw [hlen]
    exact i.isLt⟩

private theorem before_mem (i : Fin 14) : beforeAt i ∈ copyLinks := by
  have hm : beforeAt i ∈ copyLinksBeforePositivity := List.get_mem _ _
  exact List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl (List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl hm)))

private theorem link_balance_pattern_funcs (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (link : CopyLink) (hmem : link ∈ copyLinks)
    (hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) link pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant ≠ 0) :
    copyPatternTuple (copyPatterns link.producer.pattern)
        (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) link.producer.row) =
      copyPatternTuple (copyPatterns link.consumer.pattern)
        (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) link.consumer.row) := by
  change (copyProducerTuple A link).2 = (copyConsumerTuple A link).2
  exact congrArg Prod.snd (hb link hmem hw)

private theorem copyPattern0_tuple (o : Fin 16 → K) :
    copyPatternTuple copyPattern0 o = o := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [copyPatternTuple, copyPattern0]

private theorem copyPattern6_tuple (o : Fin 16 → K) :
    copyPatternTuple copyPattern6 o = fun i => if i = 0 then o 0 else 0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [copyPatternTuple, copyPattern6]

private theorem copyPattern7_tuple (o : Fin 16 → K) :
    copyPatternTuple copyPattern7 o = fun i => if i = 0 then o 10 else 0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [copyPatternTuple, copyPattern7]

private theorem copyPatterns0 : copyPatterns 0 = copyPattern0 := rfl
private theorem copyPatterns6 : copyPatterns 6 = copyPattern6 := rfl
private theorem copyPatterns7 : copyPatterns 7 = copyPattern7 := rfl

private theorem before3_spec :
    beforeAt 3 = ⟨1124073475, 1, 0, ⟨443, 0, 0⟩, ⟨448, 0, 0⟩⟩ := rfl

private theorem before4_spec :
    beforeAt 4 = ⟨1124073476, 1, 0, ⟨459, 0, 0⟩, ⟨464, 0, 0⟩⟩ := rfl

private theorem before5_spec :
    beforeAt 5 = ⟨1124073477, 0, 0, ⟨491, 0, 0⟩, ⟨496, 0, 0⟩⟩ := rfl

private theorem before6_spec :
    beforeAt 6 = ⟨1124073478, 0, 0, ⟨507, 0, 0⟩, ⟨512, 0, 0⟩⟩ := rfl

private theorem before12_spec :
    beforeAt 12 = ⟨1124073484, 1, 0, ⟨460, 0, 6⟩, ⟨1010, 0, 7⟩⟩ := rfl

private theorem before13_spec :
    beforeAt 13 = ⟨1124073485, 0, 0, ⟨508, 0, 6⟩, ⟨1012, 0, 7⟩⟩ := rfl

private theorem castLE_eq_castAdd13 (i : Fin 16) :
    Fin.castLE (by omega : 16 ≤ 29) i = i.castAdd 13 := by
  apply Fin.ext
  rfl

private theorem castLE0 : Fin.castLE (by omega : 16 ≤ 29) (0 : Fin 16) = (0 : Fin 29) := by decide
private theorem castLE10 : Fin.castLE (by omega : 16 ≤ 29) (10 : Fin 16) = (10 : Fin 29) := by decide

private theorem privateTransfer_weight_one (pub : Public K) (link : CopyLink)
    (hkind : link.weightKind.val = 1)
    (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) :
    copyLinkWeight (K := K) link pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant = 1 := by
  unfold copyLinkWeight
  rw [hkind]
  simp [hv]

/-- The two unconditional change-hash state continuations and the change-value
alias, projected from source-order links 5, 6, and 13. -/
theorem change_cells (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    (∀ i : Fin 16, A (i.castAdd 13) 491 = A (i.castAdd 13) 496) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 16, A (i.castAdd 13) 507 = A (i.castAdd 13) 512) ∧
      A 0 508 = A 10 1012 := by
  have balanceAt (link : CopyLink) (hmem : link ∈ copyLinks)
      (hkind : link.weightKind = 0) :
      copyPatternTuple (copyPatterns link.producer.pattern)
          (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) link.producer.row) =
        copyPatternTuple (copyPatterns link.consumer.pattern)
          (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) link.consumer.row) :=
    link_balance_pattern_funcs pub A hb link hmem
      (by simp [copyLinkWeight, hkind])
  have h5 := balanceAt (beforeAt 5) (before_mem 5) (by rw [before5_spec])
  have h6 := balanceAt (beforeAt 6) (before_mem 6) (by rw [before6_spec])
  have h13 := balanceAt (beforeAt 13) (before_mem 13) (by rw [before13_spec])
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    have hi := congrFun h5 i
    have hi' : A (Fin.castLE (by omega : 16 ≤ 29) i) 491 =
        A (Fin.castLE (by omega : 16 ≤ 29) i) 496 := by
      simpa only [before5_spec, copyPatterns0, copyPattern0_tuple] using hi
    simpa only [castLE_eq_castAdd13] using hi'
  · intro i
    have hi := congrFun h6 i
    have hi' : A (Fin.castLE (by omega : 16 ≤ 29) i) 507 =
        A (Fin.castLE (by omega : 16 ≤ 29) i) 512 := by
      simpa only [before6_spec, copyPatterns0, copyPattern0_tuple] using hi
    simpa only [castLE_eq_castAdd13] using hi'
  · have hi := congrFun h13 (0 : Fin 16)
    simpa only [before13_spec, copyPatterns6, copyPatterns7,
      copyPattern6_tuple, copyPattern7_tuple, if_true, castLE0, castLE10] using hi

/-- The private-transfer-only recipient-hash continuations and value alias,
projected from source-order links 3, 4, and 12. -/
theorem recipient_cells (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) :
    (∀ i : Fin 16, A (i.castAdd 13) 443 = A (i.castAdd 13) 448) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 16, A (i.castAdd 13) 459 = A (i.castAdd 13) 464) ∧
      A 0 460 = A 10 1010 := by
  have balanceAt (link : CopyLink) (hmem : link ∈ copyLinks)
      (hkind : link.weightKind.val = 1) :
      copyPatternTuple (copyPatterns link.producer.pattern)
          (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) link.producer.row) =
        copyPatternTuple (copyPatterns link.consumer.pattern)
          (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) link.consumer.row) :=
    link_balance_pattern_funcs pub A hb link hmem
      (by rw [privateTransfer_weight_one pub link hkind hv]; exact one_ne_zero)
  have h3 := balanceAt (beforeAt 3) (before_mem 3) (by rw [before3_spec]; rfl)
  have h4 := balanceAt (beforeAt 4) (before_mem 4) (by rw [before4_spec]; rfl)
  have h12 := balanceAt (beforeAt 12) (before_mem 12)
    (by rw [before12_spec]; rfl)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    have hi := congrFun h3 i
    have hi' : A (Fin.castLE (by omega : 16 ≤ 29) i) 443 =
        A (Fin.castLE (by omega : 16 ≤ 29) i) 448 := by
      simpa only [before3_spec, copyPatterns0, copyPattern0_tuple] using hi
    simpa only [castLE_eq_castAdd13] using hi'
  · intro i
    have hi := congrFun h4 i
    have hi' : A (Fin.castLE (by omega : 16 ≤ 29) i) 459 =
        A (Fin.castLE (by omega : 16 ≤ 29) i) 464 := by
      simpa only [before4_spec, copyPatterns0, copyPattern0_tuple] using hi
    simpa only [castLE_eq_castAdd13] using hi'
  · have hi := congrFun h12 (0 : Fin 16)
    simpa only [before12_spec, copyPatterns6, copyPatterns7,
      copyPattern6_tuple, copyPattern7_tuple, if_true, castLE0, castLE10] using hi

#print axioms change_cells
#print axioms recipient_cells

end AspisR1.OutputCopyLinks

namespace AspisR1.PairCopyLinks

open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

private def copyAfterAt (i : Fin 118) : CopyLink :=

    have hlen : copyLinksAfterPositivity.length = 118 := rfl
    rw [hlen]
    exact i.isLt⟩

private theorem copy_after_mem (i : Fin 118) : copyAfterAt i ∈ copyLinks := by
  have hm : copyAfterAt i ∈ copyLinksAfterPositivity := List.get_mem _ _
  exact List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hm)

private theorem balance_pattern_funcs (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (link : CopyLink) (hmem : link ∈ copyLinks)
    (hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) link pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant ≠ 0) :
    copyPatternTuple (copyPatterns link.producer.pattern)
        (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) link.producer.row) =
      copyPatternTuple (copyPatterns link.consumer.pattern)
        (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) link.consumer.row) := by

  exact congrArg Prod.snd (hb link hmem hw)

private theorem weight_one (pub : Public K) (link : CopyLink)
    (hkind : link.weightKind = 0) :
    copyLinkWeight (K := K) link pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant = 1 := by
  simp [copyLinkWeight, hkind]

private theorem copyPattern1_tuple (o : Fin 16 → K) :
    copyPatternTuple copyPattern1 o = fun i => if i.val < 8 then o i else 0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [copyPatternTuple, copyPattern1]

private theorem copyPattern10_tuple (o : Fin 16 → K) :
    copyPatternTuple copyPattern10 o = fun i =>
      if h : i.val < 8 then
        o ⟨i.val + 8, by omega⟩ + (if i.val = 7 then (1051521018 : K) else 0)
      else 0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [copyPatternTuple, copyPattern10]

private theorem copyPattern11_tuple (o : Fin 16 → K) :
    copyPatternTuple copyPattern11 o = fun i =>
      if h : i.val < 8 then o ⟨i.val + 2, by omega⟩ else 0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [copyPatternTuple, copyPattern11]

private theorem copyPatterns1 : copyPatterns 1 = copyPattern1 := rfl
private theorem copyPatterns10 : copyPatterns 10 = copyPattern10 := rfl
private theorem copyPatterns11 : copyPatterns 11 = copyPattern11 := rfl

private theorem after2_spec :
    copyAfterAt 2 = ⟨1124073492, 1, 0, ⟨523, 0, 1⟩, ⟨1018, 0, 11⟩⟩ := rfl
private theorem after3_spec :
    copyAfterAt 3 = ⟨1124073493, 1, 0, ⟨475, 0, 1⟩, ⟨540, 0, 1⟩⟩ := rfl
private theorem after4_spec :
    copyAfterAt 4 = ⟨1124073494, 2, 0, ⟨523, 1, 1⟩, ⟨540, 1, 1⟩⟩ := rfl
private theorem after5_spec :
    copyAfterAt 5 = ⟨1124073495, 0, 0, ⟨1018, 0, 11⟩, ⟨528, 0, 10⟩⟩ := rfl

private theorem fin8_fin29 (i : Fin 8) :
    (Fin.castLE (by omega) (⟨i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 16) : Fin 29) =
      i.castAdd 21 := by
  apply Fin.ext
  rfl

private theorem fin8_fin29_add2 (i : Fin 8) :
    (Fin.castLE (by omega) (⟨i.val + 2, by omega⟩ : Fin 16) : Fin 29) =
      ⟨2 + i.val, by omega⟩ := by
  apply Fin.ext
  change i.val + 2 = 2 + i.val
  omega

private theorem fin8_fin29_add8 (i : Fin 8) :
    (Fin.castLE (by omega) (⟨i.val + 8, by omega⟩ : Fin 16) : Fin 29) =
      ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ := by
  apply Fin.ext
  change i.val + 8 = 8 + i.val
  omega

theorem right_cells (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    ∀ i : Fin 8,
      A ⟨2 + i.val, by omega⟩ 1018 =
        A ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ 528 +
          (if i.val = 7 then (1051521018 : K) else 0) := by
  intro i
  have hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) (copyAfterAt 5) pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant ≠ 0 := by
    simp [copyLinkWeight, after5_spec]
  have hpat := balance_pattern_funcs pub A hb (copyAfterAt 5) (copy_after_mem 5) hw
  have hpat' :
      copyPatternTuple copyPattern11
          (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) 1018) =
        copyPatternTuple copyPattern10
          (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) 528) := by
    simpa only [after5_spec, copyPatterns1, copyPatterns10, copyPatterns11] using hpat
  let j : Fin 16 := ⟨i.val, by omega⟩
  have hj : j.val < 8 := i.isLt
  have hi := congrFun hpat' j
  have hindex2 :
      (Fin.castLE (by omega) (⟨j.val + 2, by omega⟩ : Fin 16) : Fin 29) =
        ⟨2 + i.val, by omega⟩ := by
    simpa [j] using fin8_fin29_add2 i
  have hindex8 :
      (Fin.castLE (by omega) (⟨j.val + 8, by omega⟩ : Fin 16) : Fin 29) =
        ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ := by
    simpa [j] using fin8_fin29_add8 i
  simpa only [copyPattern11_tuple, copyPattern10_tuple, j, Fin.val_mk,
    if_pos hj, dif_pos hj, hindex2, hindex8] using hi

theorem first_transfer (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A)
    (hvariant : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) :
    ∀ i : Fin 8, A (i.castAdd 21) 475 = A (i.castAdd 21) 540 := by
  intro i
  have hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) (copyAfterAt 3) pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant ≠ 0 := by
    simp [copyLinkWeight, after3_spec, hvariant]
  have hpat := balance_pattern_funcs pub A hb (copyAfterAt 3) (copy_after_mem 3) hw
  have hpat' :
      copyPatternTuple copyPattern1
          (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) 475) =
        copyPatternTuple copyPattern1
          (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) 540) := by
    simpa only [after3_spec, copyPatterns1] using hpat
  let j : Fin 16 := ⟨i.val, by omega⟩
  have hj : j.val < 8 := i.isLt
  have hi := congrFun hpat' j
  have hindex : (Fin.castLE (by omega) j : Fin 29) = i.castAdd 21 := by
    simpa [j] using fin8_fin29 i
  simpa only [copyPattern1_tuple, j, Fin.val_mk, if_pos hj, hindex] using hi

theorem first_withdrawal (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A)
    (hvariant : pub.variant = .withdrawal) :
    ∀ i : Fin 8, A (i.castAdd 21) 523 = A (i.castAdd 21) 540 := by
  intro i
  have hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) (copyAfterAt 4) pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant ≠ 0 := by
    simp [copyLinkWeight, after4_spec, hvariant]
  have hpat := balance_pattern_funcs pub A hb (copyAfterAt 4) (copy_after_mem 4) hw
  have hpat' :
      copyPatternTuple copyPattern1
          (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) 523) =
        copyPatternTuple copyPattern1
          (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) 540) := by
    simpa only [after4_spec, copyPatterns1] using hpat
  let j : Fin 16 := ⟨i.val, by omega⟩
  have hj : j.val < 8 := i.isLt
  have hi := congrFun hpat' j
  have hindex : (Fin.castLE (by omega) j : Fin 29) = i.castAdd 21 := by
    simpa [j] using fin8_fin29 i
  simpa only [copyPattern1_tuple, j, Fin.val_mk, if_pos hj, hindex] using hi

theorem second_transfer (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A)
    (hvariant : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) :
    ∀ i : Fin 8,
      A (i.castAdd 21) 523 = A ⟨2 + i.val, by omega⟩ 1018 := by
  intro i
  have hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) (copyAfterAt 2) pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant ≠ 0 := by
    simp [copyLinkWeight, after2_spec, hvariant]
  have hpat := balance_pattern_funcs pub A hb (copyAfterAt 2) (copy_after_mem 2) hw
  have hpat' :
      copyPatternTuple copyPattern1
          (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) 523) =
        copyPatternTuple copyPattern11
          (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) 1018) := by
    simpa only [after2_spec, copyPatterns1, copyPatterns11] using hpat
  let j : Fin 16 := ⟨i.val, by omega⟩
  have hj : j.val < 8 := i.isLt
  have hi := congrFun hpat' j
  have hindex2 :
      (Fin.castLE (by omega) (⟨j.val + 2, by omega⟩ : Fin 16) : Fin 29) =
        ⟨2 + i.val, by omega⟩ := by
    simpa [j] using fin8_fin29_add2 i
  simpa only [copyPattern1_tuple, copyPattern11_tuple, j, Fin.val_mk,
    if_pos hj, dif_pos hj, hindex2, fin8_fin29] using hi

#print axioms right_cells
#print axioms first_transfer

AspisFormal.Pool.V7PairLeafOccupancy.text:
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-!
# Algebraic occupancy for V7 Pool pair leaves

The Pool pair leaf never represents an empty slot by asking that a particular
digest have no preimage.  The first slot is occupied by construction.  The
second slot carries a field-valued occupancy bit and a zero-test witness for a
fixed sentinel limb of its commitment.  The constraints make occupancy zero
exactly when that sentinel is zero; an empty slot additionally forces every
commitment limb to zero.  Spending a selected slot separately requires its
occupancy value to equal one.

The pair-tree leaf is the ordinary lowest internal node of a depth-21 note
tree: its one-permutation compression input is the ordered pair of complete
eight-limb commitments.  Occupancy is not squeezed into an already-full hash
lane.  Instead it is a function of the fully committed second digest.  An
honest second output whose sentinel happens to be zero must resample its note
salt; this is a liveness rejection event, not an assumption that zero has no
preimage.  Collision resistance of Poseidon compression is deliberately
outside this algebraic file.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy

abbrev Digest (K : Type) := Fin 8 → K

/-- One transaction appends one pair.  Slot zero is always occupied; slot one
is present exactly when `secondOccupied = 1`. -/
structure PairLeaf (K : Type) where
  firstCommitment : Digest K
  secondOccupied : K
  secondCommitment : Digest K
  secondOccupancyInverse : K

/-- The last M31 limb is the fixed zero-test sentinel.  Any fixed limb would
work; pinning lane seven makes the encoding and source bridge unambiguous. -/
def PairLeaf.secondSentinel {K : Type} (leaf : PairLeaf K) : K :=
  leaf.secondCommitment ⟨7, by decide⟩

/-- Exact algebraic validity constraints for a pair leaf. -/
def PairLeaf.Valid {K : Type} [CommRing K] (leaf : PairLeaf K) : Prop :=
  leaf.secondOccupied * (leaf.secondOccupied - 1) = 0 ∧
    leaf.secondSentinel * leaf.secondOccupancyInverse =
      leaf.secondOccupied ∧
    (1 - leaf.secondOccupied) * leaf.secondOccupancyInverse = 0 ∧
    ∀ lane, (1 - leaf.secondOccupied) * leaf.secondCommitment lane = 0

/-- The occupancy value selected by a private membership witness. -/
def PairLeaf.selectedOccupied {K : Type} [OfNat K 1]
    (leaf : PairLeaf K) (secondSlot : Bool) : K :=
  if secondSlot then leaf.secondOccupied else 1

/-- The commitment selected by the same private side bit. -/
def PairLeaf.selectedCommitment {K : Type}
    (leaf : PairLeaf K) (secondSlot : Bool) : Digest K :=
  if secondSlot then leaf.secondCommitment else leaf.firstCommitment

/-- The relation-level spend gate.  Membership in the pair hash is not enough:
the privately selected slot must also be occupied. -/
def PairLeaf.SelectedSlotIsSpendable {K : Type} [OfNat K 1]
    (leaf : PairLeaf K) (secondSlot : Bool) : Prop :=
  leaf.selectedOccupied secondSlot = 1

theorem selected_spendable_implies_occupied_one
    {K : Type} [OfNat K 1] (leaf : PairLeaf K) (secondSlot : Bool)
    (spendable : leaf.SelectedSlotIsSpendable secondSlot) :
    leaf.selectedOccupied secondSlot = 1 :=
  spendable

theorem first_slot_is_spendable
    {K : Type} [OfNat K 1] (leaf : PairLeaf K) :
    leaf.SelectedSlotIsSpendable false := by
  simp [PairLeaf.SelectedSlotIsSpendable, PairLeaf.selectedOccupied]

theorem second_slot_spendable_iff
    {K : Type} [OfNat K 1] (leaf : PairLeaf K) :
    leaf.SelectedSlotIsSpendable true ↔ leaf.secondOccupied = 1 := by
  simp [PairLeaf.SelectedSlotIsSpendable, PairLeaf.selectedOccupied]

/-- A canonical empty second slot is rejected by the spend gate by an exact
field inequality, not by a preimage-resistance claim. -/
theorem canonical_empty_second_slot_not_spendable
    {K : Type} [Semiring K] [Nontrivial K]
    (first : Digest K) :
    let leaf : PairLeaf K := ⟨first, 0, fun _ => 0, 0⟩
    ¬ leaf.SelectedSlotIsSpendable true := by
  intro leaf
  change ¬ (0 : K) = 1
  exact zero_ne_one

/-- Booleanity gives the intended exhaustive occupied/empty cases over any
integral domain. -/
theorem valid_second_occupied_cases
    {K : Type} [CommRing K] [NoZeroDivisors K]
    (leaf : PairLeaf K) (valid : leaf.Valid) :
    leaf.secondOccupied = 0 ∨ leaf.secondOccupied = 1 := by
  rcases eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero valid.1 with zero | one
  · exact Or.inl zero
  · exact Or.inr (sub_eq_zero.mp one)

/-- In the empty case the commitment is algebraically the canonical all-zero
digest. -/
theorem valid_empty_second_commitment_zero
    {K : Type} [CommRing K]
    (leaf : PairLeaf K) (valid : leaf.Valid)
    (empty : leaf.secondOccupied = 0) :
    leaf.secondCommitment = fun _ => 0 := by
  funext lane
  have constrained := valid.2.2.2 lane
  simpa [empty] using constrained

theorem valid_empty_second_inverse_zero
    {K : Type} [CommRing K]
    (leaf : PairLeaf K) (valid : leaf.Valid)
    (empty : leaf.secondOccupied = 0) :
    leaf.secondOccupancyInverse = 0 := by
  have constrained := valid.2.2.1
  simpa [empty] using constrained

/-- Occupancy one algebraically certifies a nonzero sentinel. -/
theorem valid_occupied_second_sentinel_ne_zero
    {K : Type} [CommRing K] [Nontrivial K]
    (leaf : PairLeaf K) (valid : leaf.Valid)
    (occupied : leaf.secondOccupied = 1) :
    leaf.secondSentinel ≠ 0 := by
  intro zero
  have inverse := valid.2.1
  simp [zero, occupied] at inverse

/-- The bit is not free metadata: validity makes it the exact zero test of the
committed sentinel limb. -/
theorem valid_second_occupied_zero_iff_sentinel_zero
    {K : Type} [CommRing K] [NoZeroDivisors K]
    (leaf : PairLeaf K) (valid : leaf.Valid) :
    leaf.secondOccupied = 0 ↔ leaf.secondSentinel = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro empty
    have allZero := valid_empty_second_commitment_zero leaf valid empty
    simp [PairLeaf.secondSentinel, allZero]
  · intro zero
    have inverse := valid.2.1
    rw [zero, zero_mul] at inverse
    exact inverse.symm

/-- A single-output append has an algebraically empty second slot. -/
def singleOutputPair {K : Type} [Zero K]
    (commitment : Digest K) : PairLeaf K :=
  ⟨commitment, 0, fun _ => 0, 0⟩

/-- A private transfer has two algebraically occupied slots. -/
def twoOutputPair {K : Type} [One K]
    (recipient change : Digest K) (sentinelInverse : K) : PairLeaf K :=
  ⟨recipient, 1, change, sentinelInverse⟩

theorem singleOutputPair_valid
    {K : Type} [CommRing K] (commitment : Digest K) :
    (singleOutputPair commitment).Valid := by
  constructor <;> simp [singleOutputPair]

theorem twoOutputPair_valid
    {K : Type} [CommRing K] (recipient change : Digest K)
    (sentinelInverse : K)
    (inverseCorrect : change ⟨7, by decide⟩ * sentinelInverse = 1) :
    (twoOutputPair recipient change sentinelInverse).Valid := by
  refine ⟨by simp [twoOutputPair], ?_, by simp [twoOutputPair], ?_⟩
  · simpa [twoOutputPair, PairLeaf.secondSentinel] using inverseCorrect
  · intro lane
    simp [twoOutputPair]

/-- The exact one-permutation preimage.  This is also the ordinary ordered
input to the lowest internal-node compression in the depth-21 note tree. -/
def PairLeaf.compressionPreimage {K : Type} (leaf : PairLeaf K) :
    Digest K × Digest K :=
  (leaf.firstCommitment, leaf.secondCommitment)

/-- Two valid witnesses for the same committed second digest cannot disagree
about whether the slot is empty. -/
theorem valid_same_second_commitment_same_occupancy
    {K : Type} [CommRing K] [NoZeroDivisors K] [Nontrivial K]
    (left right : PairLeaf K) (leftValid : left.Valid)
    (rightValid : right.Valid)
    (sameSecond : left.secondCommitment = right.secondCommitment) :
    left.secondOccupied = right.secondOccupied := by
  rcases valid_second_occupied_cases left leftValid with leftEmpty | leftOccupied
  · have leftSentinel : left.secondSentinel = 0 :=
      (valid_second_occupied_zero_iff_sentinel_zero left leftValid).mp leftEmpty
    have rightSentinel : right.secondSentinel = 0 := by
      simpa [PairLeaf.secondSentinel, sameSecond] using leftSentinel
    exact leftEmpty.trans
      ((valid_second_occupied_zero_iff_sentinel_zero right rightValid).mpr
        rightSentinel).symm
  · rcases valid_second_occupied_cases right rightValid with rightEmpty | rightOccupied
    · have rightSentinel : right.secondSentinel = 0 :=
        (valid_second_occupied_zero_iff_sentinel_zero right rightValid).mp rightEmpty
      have leftSentinel : left.secondSentinel = 0 := by
        simpa [PairLeaf.secondSentinel, sameSecond] using rightSentinel
      exact False.elim
        ((valid_occupied_second_sentinel_ne_zero left leftValid leftOccupied)
          leftSentinel)
    · exact leftOccupied.trans rightOccupied.symm

theorem valid_same_compression_preimage_same_occupancy
    {K : Type} [CommRing K] [NoZeroDivisors K] [Nontrivial K]
    (left right : PairLeaf K) (leftValid : left.Valid)
    (rightValid : right.Valid)
    (sameInput : left.compressionPreimage = right.compressionPreimage) :
    left.secondOccupied = right.secondOccupied := by
  exact valid_same_second_commitment_same_occupancy left right leftValid rightValid
    (congrArg Prod.snd sameInput)

#print axioms selected_spendable_implies_occupied_one
#print axioms canonical_empty_second_slot_not_spendable
#print axioms valid_second_occupied_cases
#print axioms valid_empty_second_commitment_zero
#print axioms valid_empty_second_inverse_zero
#print axioms valid_occupied_second_sentinel_ne_zero
#print axioms valid_second_occupied_zero_iff_sentinel_zero
#print axioms singleOutputPair_valid
#print axioms twoOutputPair_valid
#print axioms valid_same_compression_preimage_same_occupancy

end AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy

import R0P.CopyInputLinks

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.InputPairCopyLinks

open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

private def copyAfterAt (i : Fin 118) : CopyLink :=
  copyLinksAfterPositivity.get ⟨i.val, by
    have hlen : copyLinksAfterPositivity.length = 118 := rfl
    rw [hlen]
    exact i.isLt⟩

private theorem copy_after_mem (i : Fin 118) : copyAfterAt i ∈ copyLinks := by
  have hm : copyAfterAt i ∈ copyLinksAfterPositivity := List.get_mem _ _
  exact List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hm)

private theorem balance_pattern_funcs (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (link : CopyLink) (hmem : link ∈ copyLinks)
    (hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) link pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant ≠ 0) :
    copyPatternTuple (copyPatterns link.producer.pattern)
        (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) link.producer.row) =
      copyPatternTuple (copyPatterns link.consumer.pattern)
        (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) link.consumer.row) := by
  change (copyProducerTuple A link).2 = (copyConsumerTuple A link).2
  exact congrArg Prod.snd (hb link hmem hw)

private theorem copyPattern6_tuple (o : Fin 16 → K) :
    copyPatternTuple copyPattern6 o = fun i => if i.val = 0 then o 0 else 0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [copyPatternTuple, copyPattern6]

private theorem copyPattern7_tuple (o : Fin 16 → K) :
    copyPatternTuple copyPattern7 o = fun i => if i.val = 0 then o 10 else 0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [copyPatternTuple, copyPattern7]

private theorem copyPattern10_tuple (o : Fin 16 → K) : copyPatternTuple copyPattern10 o = fun i =>
    if h : i.val < 8 then
      o ⟨i.val + 8, by omega⟩ + (if i.val = 7 then (1051521018 : K) else 0)
    else 0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [copyPatternTuple, copyPattern10]

private theorem copyPattern11_tuple (o : Fin 16 → K) :
    copyPatternTuple copyPattern11 o = fun i =>
      if h : i.val < 8 then o ⟨i.val + 2, by omega⟩ else 0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [copyPatternTuple, copyPattern11]

private theorem copyPatterns6 : copyPatterns 6 = copyPattern6 := rfl
private theorem copyPatterns7 : copyPatterns 7 = copyPattern7 := rfl
private theorem copyPatterns10 : copyPatterns 10 = copyPattern10 := rfl
private theorem copyPatterns11 : copyPatterns 11 = copyPattern11 := rfl

private theorem after0_spec :
    copyAfterAt 0 = ⟨1124073490, 0, 0, ⟨64, 0, 10⟩, ⟨1017, 0, 11⟩⟩ := rfl

private theorem after1_spec :
    copyAfterAt 1 = ⟨1124073491, 0, 0, ⟨913, 0, 6⟩, ⟨1017, 1, 7⟩⟩ := rfl

theorem selected_bit (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    A 0 913 = A 10 1017 := by
  have hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) (copyAfterAt 1) pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant ≠ 0 := by
    simp [copyLinkWeight, after1_spec]
  have hpat := balance_pattern_funcs pub A hb (copyAfterAt 1) (copy_after_mem 1) hw
  have hpat' :
      copyPatternTuple copyPattern6 (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) 913) =
        copyPatternTuple copyPattern7 (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) 1017) := by
    simpa only [after1_spec, copyPatterns6, copyPatterns7] using hpat
  have hzero := congrFun hpat' (0 : Fin 16)
  have hleft :
      (Fin.castLE (by omega) (0 : Fin 16) : Fin 29) = 0 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    rfl
  have hright :
      (Fin.castLE (by omega) (10 : Fin 16) : Fin 29) = 10 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    rfl
  simpa only [copyPattern6_tuple, copyPattern7_tuple, Fin.val_zero,
    if_pos rfl, if_true, hleft, hright] using hzero

theorem right_cells (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    ∀ i : Fin 8,
      A ⟨2 + i.val, by omega⟩ 1017 =
        A ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ 64 +
          (if i.val = 7 then (1051521018 : K) else 0) := by
  intro i
  have hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) (copyAfterAt 0) pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant ≠ 0 := by
    simp [copyLinkWeight, after0_spec]
  have hpat := balance_pattern_funcs pub A hb (copyAfterAt 0) (copy_after_mem 0) hw
  have hpat' :
      copyPatternTuple copyPattern10 (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) 64) =
        copyPatternTuple copyPattern11 (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) 1017) := by
    simpa only [after0_spec, copyPatterns10, copyPatterns11] using hpat
  let j : Fin 16 := ⟨i.val, by omega⟩
  have hj : j.val < 8 := i.isLt
  have hi := congrFun hpat' j
  have hindex2 :
      (Fin.castLE (by omega) (⟨j.val + 2, by omega⟩ : Fin 16) : Fin 29) =
        ⟨2 + i.val, by omega⟩ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [j]
    omega
  have hindex8 :
      (Fin.castLE (by omega) (⟨j.val + 8, by omega⟩ : Fin 16) : Fin 29) =
        ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [j]
    omega
  simpa only [copyPattern10_tuple, copyPattern11_tuple, j, Fin.val_mk,
    if_pos hj, dif_pos hj, hindex2, hindex8] using hi.symm

#print axioms selected_bit
#print axioms right_cells

end AspisR1.InputPairCopyLinks

import R1SpendValues
import R1OutputNotes
import R0P.SemAssembly

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SpendSemantics

open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- Production value, input-note extraction, and output-note bindings. This
statement does not include a public append update, public `Option` shape,
strict output positivity, ROM condition, Rust correspondence, or privacy claim. -/
structure NoteFacts (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) : Prop where
  values : SpendValues.BoundedBalanced A
  input : InputNoteExtracted pub A
  change : pub.change =
    noteCommitment (OutputNotes.chunk A 30) (A 10 1012) pub.assetId (OutputNotes.salt A 31 32)
  recipient : pub.variant = .privateTransfer →
    ∀ r : Digest K, pub.recipient = some r →
      r = noteCommitment (OutputNotes.chunk A 27) (A 10 1010) pub.assetId
        (OutputNotes.salt A 28 29)
  withdrawal : pub.variant = .withdrawal →
    ∀ amount, pub.withdrawalAmount = some amount → A 10 1010 = amount

theorem of_production (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime]
    (hprime : prime = 2 ^ 31 - 1) (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (lam chi : K) (h : ProductionHolds pub lam chi A ∧ CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    NoteFacts pub A := by
  have values := SpendValues.of_value_balance prime hprime pub A h.1.1 h.2
  have input := semantic_extraction pub A lam chi h (extraction_step pub lam chi A)
  have hasset : Holds assetFamily pub A := h.1.2.2.1
  have hschedule : Holds scheduleFamily pub A := h.1.2.2.2.1
  have hdigest : Holds digestFamily pub A := h.1.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hposeidon : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A := h.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hassetFacts := (asset_holds_iff pub A).mp hasset
  refine ⟨values, input,
    OutputNotes.change_public pub A hschedule hasset hdigest hposeidon h.2,
    ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hvariant r hpresent
    exact OutputNotes.recipient_public pub A hvariant r hpresent
      hschedule hasset hdigest hposeidon h.2
  · exact hassetFacts.2.2.2

#print axioms of_production

end AspisR1.SpendSemantics

import R0P.PositivityChain
import R0P.Asset

/-! Reuse of the production value rows and copy registry. The three bounded
natural values balance as integers because their possible sum is below the
characteristic. This does not assume the research-only positive family and
does not claim either output value is strictly positive. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SpendValues

open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def BoundedBalanced (A : Trace K) : Prop :=
  ∃ v0 v1 v2 : Nat,
    v0 < 2 ^ 30 ∧ v1 < 2 ^ 30 ∧ v2 < 2 ^ 30 ∧
    v0 = v1 + v2 ∧
    A 10 1008 = (v0 : K) ∧ A 10 1010 = (v1 : K) ∧ A 10 1012 = (v2 : K)

theorem of_value_balance (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime]
    (hprime : prime = 2 ^ 31 - 1) (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hv : Holds valueFamily pub A) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    BoundedBalanced A := by
  obtain ⟨_, hcons0, hcons1⟩ := (value_holds_iff pub A).mp hv
  obtain ⟨hc0, hc1, hc2, hc3⟩ := positivity_copy_cells pub A hb
  obtain ⟨v0, hv0, e0⟩ := valueRow_nat A 1008
    (valueRow_of_holds pub A hv 1008 (Or.inl rfl))
  obtain ⟨v1, hv1, e1⟩ := valueRow_nat A 1010
    (valueRow_of_holds pub A hv 1010 (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)))
  obtain ⟨v2, hv2, e2⟩ := valueRow_nat A 1012
    (valueRow_of_holds pub A hv 1012 (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)))
  have a0 : A 0 1014 = (v0 : K) := hc0.symm.trans e0
  have a1 : A 1 1014 = (v1 : K) := hc1.symm.trans e1
  have a2 : A 1 1015 = (v2 : K) := hc2.symm.trans e2
  have hfield : ((v0 : Nat) : K) = ((v1 + v2 : Nat) : K) := by
    push_cast
    rw [← a0, ← a1, ← a2, hcons0, hc3, hcons1]
  have hmod := (CharP.natCast_eq_natCast K prime).mp hfield
  have hbalance : v0 = v1 + v2 := by
    subst hprime
    exact Nat.ModEq.eq_of_lt_of_lt hmod (by omega) (by omega)
  exact ⟨v0, v1, v2, hv0, hv1, hv2, hbalance, e0, e1, e2⟩

#print axioms of_value_balance

end AspisR1.SpendValues

import R1LiteralClassifier
import R1LiteralByteSampler
import R1LiteralProtocol
import R1AllAddressFiatShamir
import FS2.Verifier

/-! The selected 33-row protocol over all finite byte strings. The bounded
carrier only constructs protocol-format calls. The adversary, verifier and
oracle table below have unrestricted byte addresses. Both decoder and extractor
are parameters; the default extractor is specification-level choice.
The concrete classifier D1/D2 uses that default; this supplies no efficiency.
The conditional bound keeps raw-byte injection and collision mass explicit. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.LiteralByteProtocol

open FS FS2 AspisV8PairedCommitment
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw AspisV8R19.OracleProgramOps
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.AdaptiveFirstReadLaw AspisV8R19.CausalFirstHitUnionBound
open LiteralTranscript

abbrev State := AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep.State
abbrev Address := Bytes
abbrev Proof := LiteralProtocol.Proof
abbrev Witness := SpendRelation.Wspend
abbrev Decoder := Address → Table Address State →
  Option (Sampler Address State (LiteralTranscript.Prefix × LiteralTranscript.Message × Challenge))
abbrev Extractor := Public → Table Address State → Option Witness

def protocol (decoder : Decoder)
    (extractor : Extractor := fun pub _ => GenericNoHit.chooseWitness LiteralProtocol.relation pub) :
    FS2.Protocol Public LiteralTranscript.Message Challenge Witness Proof Address State where
  r := 33
  msg := fun pf i => pf i
  samp := LiteralByteSampler.samp
  decode := decoder
  extract := extractor

def rows : RoundByRound' Public LiteralTranscript.Message Challenge Bytes State :=
  GenericNoHitFS2.rows LiteralClassifier.bad LiteralProtocol.relation LiteralClassifier.budget

theorem d1 (decoder : Decoder) : D1 (protocol decoder) rows :=
  GenericNoHitFS2.d1 (protocol decoder) LiteralClassifier.bad LiteralProtocol.relation
    LiteralClassifier.budget (fun _ _ => rfl)

theorem d2 (decoder : Decoder) : D2 (protocol decoder) rows := by
  apply GenericNoHitFS2.d2 (protocol decoder) LiteralClassifier.bad
    LiteralProtocol.relation LiteralClassifier.budget
  intro i P m hround hi _
  subst i
  exact LiteralClassifier.byte_density P m hi

#print axioms d1
#print axioms d2

theorem firstCell_map {I J A C : Type} [DecidableEq I] [Inhabited A]
    (label : I → J) (s : Sampler I A C) :
    firstCell (ProgramSamplerMap.map label s) = (firstCell s).map label := by
  cases s <;> rfl

theorem transcript_eq (decoder : Decoder) (extractor : Extractor)
    (H : Bytes → State) (pub : Public) (pf : Proof) (n : Nat) :
    (protocol decoder extractor).transcript H pub pf n =
      LiteralRun.transcript (fun a => H a.toBytes) pub pf n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      change ((protocol decoder extractor).transcript H pub pf n).ext (pf n)
        (eval H (LiteralByteSampler.samp n
          ((protocol decoder extractor).transcript H pub pf n) (pf n)).toProgram).2 = _
      rw [ih, LiteralByteSampler.eval_eq]
      rfl

theorem erased_transcript (decoder : Decoder) (extractor : Extractor)
    (H : Bytes → State) (pub : Public) (pf : Proof) (n : Nat) :
    erasePrefix ((protocol decoder extractor).transcript H pub pf n) =
      LiteralRun.erasedTranscript (fun a => H a.toBytes) pub pf n := by
  rw [transcript_eq]
  exact LiteralRun.erase_transcript _ pub pf n

theorem chainsRead (decoder : Decoder) (extractor : Extractor) :
    FS2.ChainsRead (protocol decoder extractor) := by
  intro i P m hi
  change firstCell (ProgramSamplerMap.map FS2.Duplex.Addr.toBytes
    (LiteralTranscript.samp i P m)) ≠ none
  rw [firstCell_map]
  have hn : firstCell (LiteralTranscript.samp i P m) ≠ none :=
    UnifiedSampler.firstCell_some _ _ _ _ _
  cases h : firstCell (LiteralTranscript.samp i P m) with
  | none => exact absurd h hn
  | some a => simp

private theorem firstCell_mem {I A C : Type} [DecidableEq I] [Inhabited A]
    (H : I → A) (s : Sampler I A C) (a : I) (ha : firstCell s = some a) :
    a ∈ (eval H s.toProgram).1.map Prod.fst := by
  cases s with
  | done c => cases ha
  | ask i k =>
      simp only [FS2.firstCell, Option.some.injEq] at ha
      subst i
      exact List.mem_cons_self ..
  | multi c cs nd k =>
      simp only [FS2.firstCell, Option.some.injEq] at ha
      subst c
      exact List.mem_cons_self ..

theorem readsChains (decoder : Decoder) (extractor : Extractor)
    (decision : LiteralTranscript.Prefix → LiteralTranscript.Message → Bool) :
    FS2.ReadsChains (protocol decoder extractor)
      (FS2.verifier (protocol decoder extractor) decision) := by
  intro H pub pf i a hi ha
  apply FS2.verifier_reads (protocol decoder extractor) decision H pub pf i hi a
  exact firstCell_mem H _ a ha

/-- This is an oracle-model theorem with obligations, not a closed R1 bound.
In particular no injection theorem is transported through a noninjective
address map, and no finite input-length or CallsFit premise is present. -/
theorem conditional_bound {Y : Type} (decoder : Decoder) (extractor : Extractor)
    (rb : RoundByRound' Public LiteralTranscript.Message Challenge Bytes State)
    (dec : R0C.V3.Dec Public LiteralTranscript.Message Challenge Bytes State Y)
    (P : Program Bytes State Proof) (V : Public → Proof → Program Bytes State Bool)
    (pub : Public) (κ : Nat → ℚ) (Qtot : Nat)
    (hD1 : FS2.D1 (protocol decoder extractor) rb)
    (hCD : R0C.V3.ChainDensity3 (protocol decoder extractor) rb dec)
    (hD3 : FS2.D3 (protocol decoder extractor) rb V)
    (hV : FS2.ReadsChains (protocol decoder extractor) V)
    (inj : AllAddressFiatShamir.LazyInj (protocol decoder extractor) dec P V pub κ Qtot)
    (hQ : ∀ H : Bytes → State,
      FS2.distinctFirstReads (eval H (FS2.experiment P V pub)) ≤ Qtot) :
    lazyMean (FS2.experiment P V pub) emptyTable
      (fun v => indicator (FS2.accepts v ∧ FS2.extractFails (protocol decoder extractor) pub v)) ≤
      (Qtot : ℚ) * maxErr rb.ε 33 + κ Qtot :=
  AllAddressFiatShamir.soundness_bound (protocol decoder extractor) rb dec P V pub κ Qtot
    hD1 hCD hD3 (chainsRead decoder extractor) hV inj hQ

#print axioms firstCell_map
#print axioms transcript_eq
#print axioms erased_transcript
#print axioms chainsRead
#print axioms readsChains
#print axioms conditional_bound
end AspisR1.LiteralByteProtocol
end

import R1LiteralRun
import R1GenericNoHitFS2
import R1SpendRelation

/-! Ideal word-message protocol carrier for the selected spend relation.
The decoder is an explicit parameter. Only its relation, transcript, and
D1 bookkeeping are established here; the concrete classifier, row density,
terminal acceptance, Merkle compilation, and efficient extraction remain open.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.LiteralProtocol

open FS FS2 AspisV8PairedCommitment
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw AspisV8R19.OracleProgramOps
open LiteralTranscript

abbrev Address := FS2.Duplex.Addr SelectedTranscriptParams.L
abbrev State := AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep.State
abbrev Witness := SpendRelation.Wspend
abbrev Proof := Nat → LiteralTranscript.Message
abbrev Decoder := Address → Table Address State →
  Option (Sampler Address State (LiteralTranscript.Prefix × LiteralTranscript.Message × Challenge))

/-- The canonical public byte model and the checked spend relation. -/
def relation (pub : Public) (w : Witness) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic pub.pubBytes = some p ∧ SpendRelation.Rspend p w

/-- The specification extractor selects a relation witness if one exists.
It is intentionally separate from the required executable Las Vegas extractor. -/
def protocol (decoder : Decoder) :
    FS2.Protocol Public LiteralTranscript.Message Challenge Witness Proof Address State where
  r := 33
  msg := fun pf i => pf i
  samp := LiteralTranscript.samp
  decode := decoder
  extract := fun pub _ => GenericNoHit.chooseWitness relation pub

theorem transcript_eq (decoder : Decoder) (H : Address → State) (pub : Public)
    (pf : Proof) (n : Nat) :
    (protocol decoder).transcript H pub pf n = LiteralRun.transcript H pub pf n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      change ((protocol decoder).transcript H pub pf n).ext (pf n)
        (eval H (LiteralTranscript.samp n ((protocol decoder).transcript H pub pf n)
          (pf n)).toProgram).2 = _
      rw [ih]
      rfl

theorem erased_transcript (decoder : Decoder) (H : Address → State) (pub : Public)
    (pf : Proof) (n : Nat) :
    erasePrefix ((protocol decoder).transcript H pub pf n) =
      LiteralRun.erasedTranscript H pub pf n := by
  rw [transcript_eq]
  exact LiteralRun.erase_transcript H pub pf n

theorem d1 (decoder : Decoder)
    (bad : LiteralTranscript.Prefix → LiteralTranscript.Message → Challenge → Prop)
    (eps : Nat → ℚ) :
    FS2.D1 (protocol decoder) (GenericNoHitFS2.rows bad relation eps) :=
  GenericNoHitFS2.d1 (protocol decoder) bad relation eps (fun _ _ => rfl)

theorem extracted_relation (decoder : Decoder) (pub : Public)
    (T : Table Address State) (w : Witness)
    (h : (protocol decoder).extract pub T = some w) : relation pub w :=
  GenericNoHit.returned_relation relation pub w h

#print axioms transcript_eq
#print axioms erased_transcript
#print axioms d1
#print axioms extracted_relation

end AspisR1.LiteralProtocol
end

R1LiteralRun.text:
import R1LiteralTranscript

/-! A recursive literal-message run and its selected byte-message projection.
This is transcript plumbing only; it supplies no decoder, acceptance, or
source-correspondence result. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.LiteralRun

open FS FS2
open AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw AspisV8R19.OracleProgramOps

abbrev E := AspisWideTower.WideExact
abbrev L := SelectedTranscriptParams.L
abbrev Address := FS2.Duplex.Addr L
abbrev State := AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep.State
abbrev Public := LiteralTranscript.Public
abbrev Message := LiteralTranscript.Message
abbrev Challenge := LiteralTranscript.Challenge
abbrev Prefix := LiteralTranscript.Prefix
abbrev BytesMessage := LiteralTranscript.BytesMessage

/-- Run the literal-word message carrier using the sampler supplied by that
carrier. -/
def transcript (H : Address → State) (pub : Public) (messages : Nat → Message) :
    Nat → Prefix
  | 0 => FS.emptyPrefix pub
  | n + 1 =>
      let P := transcript H pub messages n
      P.ext (messages n)
        (eval H (LiteralTranscript.samp n P (messages n)).toProgram).2

/-- Run the erased byte-message schedule directly through the selected
unified sampler. -/
def erasedTranscript (H : Address → State) (pub : Public) (messages : Nat → Message) :
    Nat → UnifiedSampler.Prefix BytesMessage E L
  | 0 => FS.emptyPrefix pub
  | n + 1 =>
      let P := erasedTranscript H pub messages n
      P.ext (LiteralTranscript.erase (messages n))
        (eval H (UnifiedSampler.samp SelectedTranscriptParams.params
          (by norm_num [SelectedTranscriptParams.params, SelectedTranscriptParams.D])
          n P (LiteralTranscript.erase (messages n))).toProgram).2

/-- Erasing each literal message commutes with the recursive transcript run. -/
theorem erase_transcript (H : Address → State) (pub : Public)
    (messages : Nat → Message) (n : Nat) :
    LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix (transcript H pub messages n) =
      erasedTranscript H pub messages n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [transcript, erasedTranscript, LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix_ext,
        LiteralTranscript.samp, ih]

/-- The recursive literal transcript contains exactly one round per step. -/
theorem transcript_round (H : Address → State) (pub : Public)
    (messages : Nat → Message) (n : Nat) :
    (transcript H pub messages n).round = n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      change (transcript H pub messages n).rounds.length = n at ih
      simpa [transcript, FS.Prefix.round, FS.Prefix.ext] using congrArg Nat.succ ih

/-- The three indexed literal-word reads are unaffected by appending a suffix
once all their positions are already present. -/
theorem reads_append_stable (rs tail : List (Message × Challenge))
    (h : 30 < rs.length) :
    LiteralTranscript.c1At (rs ++ tail) = LiteralTranscript.c1At rs ∧
    LiteralTranscript.c2At (rs ++ tail) = LiteralTranscript.c2At rs ∧
    LiteralTranscript.vAt (rs ++ tail) = LiteralTranscript.vAt rs := by
  exact ⟨LiteralTranscript.c1At_append rs tail (by omega),
    LiteralTranscript.c2At_append rs tail (by omega),
    LiteralTranscript.vAt_append rs tail h⟩

#print axioms erase_transcript
#print axioms transcript_round
#print axioms reads_append_stable

end AspisR1.LiteralRun
end

R1GenericNoHitFS2.text:
import R1GenericNoHit
import FS2.Statement

/-! Generic FS2 bookkeeping for the table-independent no-hit classifier.
The row-density and terminal implication remain explicit hypotheses. This
module does not establish either for the selected spend protocol. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.GenericNoHitFS2

open FS FS2 AspisV8PairedCommitment
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw AspisV8R19.AdaptiveFirstReadLaw
open AspisV8R19.OracleResampling AspisV8R19.CausalFirstHitUnionBound
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {X M C W Pf I A O : Type}

/-- Monotonicity of the existing independent-answer interpreter. -/
theorem independentMean_mono [Fintype A] (p : Program I A O)
    (f g : View I A O → ℚ) (h : ∀ v, f v ≤ g v) :
    independentMean p f ≤ independentMean p g := by
  induction p generalizing f g with
  | done o => exact h ([], o)
  | ask i next ih =>
      change mean (fun a => independentMean (next a) _) ≤
        mean (fun a => independentMean (next a) _)
      apply mean_mono
      intro a
      exact ih a _ _ (fun v => h ((i,a) :: v.1, v.2))

def rows (bad : Prefix X M C → M → C → Prop) (relation : X → W → Prop)
    (eps : Nat → ℚ) : RoundByRound' X M C I A where
  doomed := fun P _ => GenericNoHit.doomed bad relation P
  ε := eps

theorem d1 [DecidableEq I] [Inhabited A] [Fintype A]
    (pr : Protocol X M C W Pf I A)
    (bad : Prefix X M C → M → C → Prop) (relation : X → W → Prop)
    (eps : Nat → ℚ)
    (hextract : ∀ x T, pr.extract x T = GenericNoHit.chooseWitness relation x) :
    D1 pr (rows bad relation eps) := by
  intro x T h
  change GenericNoHit.doomed bad relation (emptyPrefix x)
  apply (GenericNoHit.empty_doomed bad relation x).mpr
  rw [← hextract x T]
  exact h

/-- Pointwise escape containment is independent of both tables. The supplied
fixed-prefix density must still be proved for every applicable message. -/
theorem d2 [DecidableEq I] [Inhabited A] [Fintype A]
    (pr : Protocol X M C W Pf I A)
    (bad : Prefix X M C → M → C → Prop) (relation : X → W → Prop)
    (eps : Nat → ℚ)
    (hdensity : ∀ i P m, P.round = i → i < pr.r →
      GenericNoHit.doomed bad relation P →
      independentMean (pr.samp i P m).toProgram
        (fun v => indicator (bad P m v.2)) ≤ eps i) :
    D2 pr (rows bad relation eps) := by
  intro i P m T' T hr hi hd
  apply le_trans _ (hdensity i P m hr hi hd)
  apply independentMean_mono
  intro v
  apply indicator_mono
  exact GenericNoHit.doomed_ext_bad bad relation P m v.2 hd

/-- The terminal accepted/no-hit implication suffices for D3. It is not
supplied by the generic classifier construction. -/
theorem d3 [DecidableEq I] [Inhabited A] [Fintype A]
    (pr : Protocol X M C W Pf I A)
    (bad : Prefix X M C → M → C → Prop) (relation : X → W → Prop)
    (eps : Nat → ℚ) (V : X → Pf → Program I A Bool)
    (hterminal : ∀ H x pf, (eval H (V x pf)).2 = true →
      ¬ GenericNoHit.hitFrom bad x [] (pr.transcript H x pf pr.r).rounds →
      ∃ w, relation x w) :
    D3 pr (rows bad relation eps) V := by
  intro H x pf T hd
  by_cases hacc : (eval H (V x pf)).2 = true
  · have hx : (pr.transcript H x pf pr.r).statement = x := by
      have aux : ∀ n, (pr.transcript H x pf n).statement = x := by
        intro n
        induction n with
        | zero => rfl
        | succ n ih => exact ih
      exact aux pr.r
    have hno : ¬ GenericNoHit.hitFrom bad x [] (pr.transcript H x pf pr.r).rounds := by
      simpa only [hx] using hd.2
    have hrel : ¬ ∃ w, relation x w := by simpa only [hx] using hd.1
    exact (hrel (hterminal H x pf hacc hno)).elim
  · exact Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hacc

#print axioms independentMean_mono
#print axioms d1
#print axioms d2
#print axioms d3

end AspisR1.GenericNoHitFS2
end

R1GenericNoHit.text:
import FS.Statement

/-! Generic no-hit bookkeeping for a list of message/challenge rounds.  The
relation and bad-round predicate remain explicit; this file makes no
probability or protocol-specific claim. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.GenericNoHit

variable {X M C W I A : Type}

/-- A bad event occurs at the current round or in the remaining suffix. -/
def hitFrom (bad : FS.Prefix X M C → M → C → Prop) (x : X)
    (prev : List (M × C)) : List (M × C) → Prop
  | [] => False
  | (m, c) :: rest => bad ⟨x, prev⟩ m c ∨ hitFrom bad x (prev ++ [(m, c)]) rest

/-- A prefix is doomed when the relation has no witness and its existing
round list contains no bad event. -/
def doomed (bad : FS.Prefix X M C → M → C → Prop)
    (relation : X → W → Prop) (P : FS.Prefix X M C) : Prop :=
  (¬ ∃ w, relation P.statement w) ∧ ¬ hitFrom bad P.statement [] P.rounds

/-- Split a concatenated list at the boundary between its two parts. -/
theorem hitFrom_append (bad : FS.Prefix X M C → M → C → Prop)
    (x : X) (prev xs ys : List (M × C)) :
    hitFrom bad x prev (xs ++ ys) ↔
      hitFrom bad x prev xs ∨ hitFrom bad x (prev ++ xs) ys := by
  induction xs generalizing prev with
  | nil => simp [hitFrom]
  | cons q xs ih =>
      rcases q with ⟨m, c⟩
      simp only [List.cons_append, hitFrom]
      rw [ih]
      simp only [List.append_assoc]
      tauto

/-- If an extension escapes doomedness, its new round must be bad. -/
theorem doomed_ext_bad
    (bad : FS.Prefix X M C → M → C → Prop)
    (relation : X → W → Prop)
    (P : FS.Prefix X M C) (m : M) (c : C)
    (hdoomed : doomed bad relation P)
    (hnot : ¬ doomed bad relation (P.ext m c)) :
    bad P m c := by
  rcases hdoomed with ⟨hrel, hprior⟩
  have hhit : hitFrom bad P.statement [] (P.rounds ++ [(m, c)]) := by
    by_contra hno
    apply hnot
    exact ⟨hrel, by simpa only [FS.Prefix.ext] using hno⟩
  rw [hitFrom_append] at hhit
  rcases hhit with hprior' | hcurrent
  · exact (hprior hprior').elim
  · simpa only [hitFrom, List.nil_append, List.append_nil, or_false] using hcurrent

/-- Select a witness when one exists. This is a specification-level
noncomputable choice, separate from any executable checker. -/
noncomputable def chooseWitness (relation : X → W → Prop) (x : X) : Option W :=
  by
    classical
    exact if h : ∃ w, relation x w then some (Classical.choose h) else none

theorem chooseWitness_eq_none_iff
    (relation : X → W → Prop) (x : X) :
    chooseWitness relation x = none ↔ ¬ ∃ w, relation x w := by
  classical
  unfold chooseWitness
  split_ifs with h
  · simp [h]
  · simp [h]

/-- The empty prefix is doomed exactly when the selector has no witness. -/
theorem empty_doomed
    (bad : FS.Prefix X M C → M → C → Prop)
    (relation : X → W → Prop) (x : X) :
    doomed bad relation (FS.emptyPrefix x) ↔ chooseWitness relation x = none := by
  classical
  unfold doomed FS.emptyPrefix hitFrom
  rw [chooseWitness_eq_none_iff]
  simp

theorem returned_relation
    (relation : X → W → Prop) (x : X) (w : W)
    (h : chooseWitness relation x = some w) : relation x w := by
  classical
  unfold chooseWitness at h
  split_ifs at h with hex
  · have hw : Classical.choose hex = w := Option.some.inj h
    subst w
    exact Classical.choose_spec hex

#print axioms hitFrom_append
#print axioms doomed_ext_bad
#print axioms chooseWitness_eq_none_iff
#print axioms empty_doomed
#print axioms returned_relation

end AspisR1.GenericNoHit
