/-- Count a predicate on finite vectors by its leading-coordinate fibers.
The equivalence is symbolic for arbitrary dimension and finite type. -/
theorem filter_card_fin_cons {K : Type} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (n : Nat) (P : (Fin (n+1) → K) → Prop) :
    (Finset.univ.filter P).card =
      ∑ x : K, (Finset.univ.filter (fun y : Fin n → K => P (Fin.cons x y))).card := by
  classical
  let e : {z : Fin (n+1) → K // P z} ≃
      Σ x : K, {y : Fin n → K // P (Fin.cons x y)} :=
    { toFun := fun z => ⟨z.1 0, ⟨Fin.tail z.1, by
        simpa only [Fin.cons_self_tail] using z.2⟩⟩
      invFun := fun z => ⟨Fin.cons z.1 z.2.1, z.2.2⟩
      left_inv := fun z => Subtype.ext (Fin.cons_self_tail z.1)
      right_inv := by
        rintro ⟨x, y, hy⟩
        rfl }
  calc
    _ = Fintype.card {z : Fin (n+1) → K // P z} := by
      rw [Fintype.card_subtype]
    _ = Fintype.card (Σ x : K, {y : Fin n → K // P (Fin.cons x y)}) :=
      Fintype.card_congr e
    _ = ∑ x : K, Fintype.card {y : Fin n → K // P (Fin.cons x y)} :=
      Fintype.card_sigma
    _ = _ := by simp only [Fintype.card_subtype]

private theorem badTheta_card_of_nonzero (lanes : Fin 29 → (Fin 10 → Bool) → K)

  classical
  obtain ⟨i₀, b₀, hi₀⟩ := hnz
  let p := thetaRootPoly lanes b₀
  have hcoeff : p.coeff i₀.val = lanes i₀ b₀ := by
    simp only [p, thetaRootPoly, finsetSum_coeff, coeff_C_mul_X_pow]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i₀]
    · simp
    · intro j hj hji
      have hval : j.val ≠ i₀.val := fun h => hji (Fin.ext h)
      simp [Ne.symm hval]
    · simp
  have hp : p ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hzero : p.coeff i₀.val = 0 := by rw [h]; simp
    have : lanes i₀ b₀ = 0 := hcoeff ▸ hzero
    exact hi₀ this
  have hdeg : p.natDegree ≤ 28 := by
    dsimp [p, thetaRootPoly]
    apply Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
    intro i hi
    calc
      _ ≤ (C (lanes i b₀)).natDegree + (X ^ i.val).natDegree :=
        Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le
      _ ≤ 0 + i.val := Nat.add_le_add (by simp) (by simp)
      _ ≤ 28 := by omega
  have heval (θ : K) : p.eval θ = R0P.Sumcheck.lanesComp θ lanes b₀ := by
    simp only [p, thetaRootPoly, eval_finsetSum, eval_mul,
      eval_C, eval_pow, eval_X]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [mul_comm]
  have hsub : (Finset.univ.filter (fun θ : K => R0P.Sumcheck.BadTheta lanes θ)) ⊆
      Finset.univ.filter (fun θ : K => p.eval θ = 0) := by
    intro θ hθ
    rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hθ ⊢
    have hzero := hθ.2.2 b₀
    exact ⟨hθ.1, by rw [heval]; exact hzero⟩
  calc
    _ ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun θ : K => p.eval θ = 0)).card := Finset.card_le_card hsub
    _ ≤ 28 := by
      have huni := univariate_bad_card p hp 28 hdeg
      convert huni using 1
      congr 1
      ext θ
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]

#print axioms badTheta_card_of_nonzero

theorem badTheta_card (lanes : Fin 29 → (Fin 10 → Bool) → K) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun θ : K => R0P.Sumcheck.BadTheta lanes θ)).card ≤ 28 := by
  classical
  by_cases hnz : ∃ i b, lanes i b ≠ 0
  · exact badTheta_card_of_nonzero lanes hnz
  · have hempty : (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun θ : K => R0P.Sumcheck.BadTheta lanes θ)) = ∅ := by
      ext θ
      simp [R0P.Sumcheck.BadTheta, hnz]
    rw [hempty]
    simp

#print axioms badTheta_card

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] in
private theorem affine_zero_unique (a b x y : K)
    (hx : a + x * (b - a) = 0) (hy : a + y * (b - a) = 0)
    (hab : a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ 0) : x = y := by
  have hprod : (x - y) * (b - a) = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = (a + x * (b - a)) - (a + y * (b - a)) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hx, hy]; ring
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with hxy | hba
  · exact sub_eq_zero.mp hxy
  · have ha : a = 0 := by simpa [hba] using hx
    have hba' : b = a := sub_eq_zero.mp hba
    subst b
    rcases hab with h | h <;> contradiction

#print axioms affine_zero_unique

/-- A nonzero function on the Boolean cube has at most `n |K|^(n-1)` zeros
under its recursive multilinear extension. The successor proof counts the
first-coordinate fibers after the symbolic `Fin.cons` split. -/
private theorem mle_bad_card_of_witness : ∀ (n : Nat) (f : (Fin n → Bool) → K),
    (∃ b, f b ≠ 0) →
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : Fin n → K => R0P.Sumcheck.mle n f z = 0)).card ≤
        n * Fintype.card K ^ (n - 1)
  | 0, f, hf => by
      classical
      have hval : f (fun i : Fin 0 => i.elim0) ≠ 0 := by
        obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hf
        have hb' : b = fun i : Fin 0 => i.elim0 := by
          funext i
          exact i.elim0
        simpa [hb'] using hb
      have hempty : (Finset.univ.filter
          (fun z : Fin 0 → K => R0P.Sumcheck.mle 0 f z = 0)) = ∅ := by
        ext z
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.notMem_empty]
        constructor
        · intro hz
          exact hval (by simpa [R0P.Sumcheck.mle] using hz)
        · intro hz
          exact False.elim hz
      rw [hempty]
      simp
  | n + 1, f, hf => by
      classical
      obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hf
      let f0 : (Fin n → Bool) → K := fun v => f (Fin.cons false v)
      let f1 : (Fin n → Bool) → K := fun v => f (Fin.cons true v)
      let A : (Fin n → K) → K := R0P.Sumcheck.mle n f0
      let B : (Fin n → K) → K := R0P.Sumcheck.mle n f1
      let g : (Fin n → Bool) → K := if b 0 then f1 else f0
      have hbcons : b = Fin.cons (b 0) (Fin.tail b) := by
        funext i
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
        · rfl
        · rfl
      have hg : ∃ v, g v ≠ 0 := by
        refine ⟨Fin.tail b, ?_⟩
        have hb' : f (Fin.cons (b 0) (Fin.tail b)) ≠ 0 := by
          rw [← hbcons]
          exact hb
        by_cases hbit : b 0
        · simpa [g, f1, hbit] using hb'
        · simpa [g, f0, hbit] using hb'
      have htail := mle_bad_card_of_witness n g hg
      let Both : Finset (Fin n → K) := Finset.univ.filter
        (fun v => A v = 0 ∧ B v = 0)
      let Gzero : Finset (Fin n → K) := Finset.univ.filter (fun v => R0P.Sumcheck.mle n g v = 0)
      let Z : Finset (Fin (n + 1) → K) := Finset.univ.filter
        (fun z => R0P.Sumcheck.mle (n + 1) f z = 0)
      let R0 : Finset (Fin (n + 1) → K) := Finset.univ.filter
        (fun z => A (Fin.tail z) = 0 ∧ B (Fin.tail z) = 0)
      let R1 : Finset (Fin (n + 1) → K) := Z.filter
        (fun z => ¬ (A (Fin.tail z) = 0 ∧ B (Fin.tail z) = 0))
      have hcons (z : Fin (n + 1) → K) : z = Fin.cons (z 0) (Fin.tail z) := by
        funext i
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
        · rfl
        · rfl
      have hR0sub : R0 ⊆ Z := by
        intro z hz
        have hb := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz).2
        rw [hcons z]
        simp only [Z, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        change (1 - z 0) * A (Fin.tail z) + z 0 * B (Fin.tail z) = 0
        rw [hb.1, hb.2]
        ring
      have hR0card : R0.card = Fintype.card K * Both.card := by
        let P : (Fin (n + 1) → K) → Prop :=
          fun z => A (Fin.tail z) = 0 ∧ B (Fin.tail z) = 0
        have hfilter : R0 = Finset.univ.filter P := by
          ext z
          simp [R0, P]
        calc
          _ = (Finset.univ.filter P).card := by rw [hfilter]
          _ = Fintype.card K * Both.card := by
            have hc := filter_card_fin_cons (K := K) n P
            convert hc using 1
            · congr 1
              ext z
              simp [P]
            · simp [Both, P, Fin.tail_cons]
      have hBoth : Both ⊆ Gzero := by
        intro v hv
        have hb := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hv).2
        simp only [Gzero, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
        by_cases hbit : b 0
        · simpa [g, hbit] using hb.2
        · simpa [g, hbit] using hb.1
      have hR1maps : Set.MapsTo Fin.tail (R1 : Set (Fin (n + 1) → K))
          ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n → K)) : Set (Fin n → K)) := by
        intro z hz
        simp
      have hR1inj : (R1 : Set (Fin (n + 1) → K)).InjOn Fin.tail := by
        intro z hz w hw htailEq
        have hzroot : R0P.Sumcheck.mle (n + 1) f z = 0 :=
          (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz).1).2
        have hwroot : R0P.Sumcheck.mle (n + 1) f w = 0 :=
          (Finset.mem_filter.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hw).1).2
        have hznot : ¬ (A (Fin.tail z) = 0 ∧ B (Fin.tail z) = 0) :=
          (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz).2
        have hnonzero : A (Fin.tail z) ≠ 0 ∨ B (Fin.tail z) ≠ 0 :=
          not_and_or.mp hznot
        have hzlin : A (Fin.tail z) + z 0 * (B (Fin.tail z) - A (Fin.tail z)) = 0 := by
          rw [R0P.Sumcheck.mle] at hzroot
          change (1 - z 0) * A (Fin.tail z) + z 0 * B (Fin.tail z) = 0 at hzroot
          have hrec : (1-z 0) * A (Fin.tail z) + z 0 * B (Fin.tail z) = 0 := hzroot
          calc
            _ = (1-z 0) * A (Fin.tail z) + z 0 * B (Fin.tail z) := by ring
            _ = 0 := hrec
        have hwlin : A (Fin.tail z) + w 0 * (B (Fin.tail z) - A (Fin.tail z)) = 0 := by
          rw [R0P.Sumcheck.mle] at hwroot
          change (1 - w 0) * A (Fin.tail w) + w 0 * B (Fin.tail w) = 0 at hwroot
          have hrec : (1-w 0) * A (Fin.tail w) + w 0 * B (Fin.tail w) = 0 := hwroot
          rw [← htailEq] at hrec
          calc
            _ = (1-w 0) * A (Fin.tail z) + w 0 * B (Fin.tail z) := by ring
            _ = 0 := hrec
        have hhead : z 0 = w 0 :=
          affine_zero_unique (A (Fin.tail z)) (B (Fin.tail z)) (z 0) (w 0)
            hzlin hwlin hnonzero
        funext i
        refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
        · exact hhead
        · exact congrFun htailEq j
      have hR1 : R1.card ≤ Fintype.card (Fin n → K) :=
        Finset.card_le_card_of_injOn Fin.tail hR1maps hR1inj
      have hGzero : Gzero.card ≤ n * Fintype.card K ^ (n - 1) := htail
      have hdisj : Disjoint R0 R1 := by
        rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
        intro z hz0 hz1
        exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz1).2 (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz0).2
      have hpart : Z = R0 ∪ R1 := by
        ext z
        constructor
        · intro hz
          by_cases hb0 : A (Fin.tail z) = 0 ∧ B (Fin.tail z) = 0
          · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hb0⟩))
          · exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hz, hb0⟩))
        · intro hz
          rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hz with hz0 | hz1
          · exact hR0sub hz0
          · exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hz1).1
      calc
        _ = Z.card := rfl
        _ = R0.card + R1.card := by rw [hpart, Finset.card_union_of_disjoint hdisj]
        _ ≤ Fintype.card K * Gzero.card + Fintype.card (Fin n → K) := by
          rw [hR0card]
          exact Nat.add_le_add
            (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (Finset.card_le_card hBoth)) hR1
        _ ≤ Fintype.card K * (n * Fintype.card K ^ (n - 1)) + Fintype.card K ^ n := by
          simpa [Fintype.card_fun] using Nat.add_le_add_right
            (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (Fintype.card K) hGzero) (Fintype.card K ^ n)
        _ ≤ (n + 1) * Fintype.card K ^ n := by
          cases n with
          | zero => simp
          | succ n =>
              simp only [Nat.succ_sub_one, pow_succ]
              exact le_of_eq (by ring)

#print axioms mle_bad_card_of_witness

theorem mle_bad_card (n : Nat) (f : (Fin n → Bool) → K) (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : Fin n → K => R0P.Sumcheck.mle n f z = 0)).card ≤
      n * Fintype.card K ^ (n - 1) := by
  apply mle_bad_card_of_witness n f
  by_contra hnone
  have hzero : ∀ b, f b = 0 := by
    intro b
    by_contra hb
    exact hnone ⟨b, hb⟩
  apply hf
  funext b
  exact hzero b

#print axioms mle_bad_card

theorem badZc_card (f : (Fin 10 → Bool) → K) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : Fin 10 → K => R0P.Sumcheck.BadZc f z)).card ≤
      10 * Fintype.card K ^ 9 := by
  classical
  by_cases hf : ∃ b, f b ≠ 0
  · have h := mle_bad_card_of_witness 10 f hf
    simpa [R0P.Sumcheck.BadZc, hf] using h
  · have hempty : (Finset.univ.filter
        (fun z : Fin 10 → K => R0P.Sumcheck.BadZc f z)) = ∅ := by
      ext z
      simp [R0P.Sumcheck.BadZc, hf]
    rw [hempty]
    simp

#print axioms badZc_card

end

noncomputable section

namespace R0P.SemBadSets

open Polynomial
open R0P.Sumcheck

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

local instance : DecidableEq K := Classical.decEq K
local instance (p : Prop) : Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable p

/-- The first `i` coordinates of a challenge vector, in the explicit
`Fin.castLE` embedding used by an adaptive prover strategy. -/
def strategyPrefix {n : Nat} (α : Fin n → K) (i : Fin n) : Fin i.val → K :=
  fun j => α (Fin.castLE i.isLt.le j)

#print axioms strategyPrefix

/-- Round polynomials selected from the strategy using the transcript prefix. -/
def strategyPolys {n : Nat}
    (strat : (i : Fin n) → (Fin i.val → K) → K[X]) (α : Fin n → K) : Fin n → K[X] :=
  fun i => strat i (strategyPrefix α i)

#print axioms strategyPolys

/-- The adaptive transcript is checked by ordinary sumcheck acceptance after
instantiating each round polynomial at its actual earlier-challenge prefix. -/
def strategyAccept (d n : Nat) (G : (Fin n → K) → K) (c : K)
    (strat : (i : Fin n) → (Fin i.val → K) → K[X]) (α : Fin n → K) : Prop :=
  accept d n G c (strategyPolys strat α) α

#print axioms strategyAccept

/-- Accepted transcripts with a false initial claim. -/
def badAlphaStrategy (d n : Nat) (G : (Fin n → K) → K) (c : K)
    (strat : (i : Fin n) → (Fin i.val → K) → K[X]) (α : Fin n → K) : Prop :=
  strategyAccept d n G c strat α ∧ bsum n G ≠ c

#print axioms badAlphaStrategy

omit [Field K] in
private theorem strategyPrefix_cons_succ (n : Nat) (x : K)
    (α : Fin n → K) (i : Fin n) :
    strategyPrefix (Fin.cons x α) i.succ =
      (Fin.cons x (strategyPrefix α i) : Fin (i.val+1) → K) := by
  funext j
  refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ j
  · change (Fin.cons x α : Fin (n+1) → K) 0 =
      (Fin.cons x (strategyPrefix α i) : Fin (i.val+1) → K) 0
    simp only [Fin.cons_zero]
  · intro j
    change (Fin.cons x α : Fin (n+1) → K) (Fin.castLE i.isLt.le j).succ =
      (Fin.cons x (strategyPrefix α i) : Fin (i.val+1) → K) j.succ
    simp only [Fin.cons_succ]
    rfl

#print axioms strategyPrefix_cons_succ

private theorem strategyPolys_tail (n : Nat) (x : K)
    (strat : (i : Fin (n+1)) → (Fin i.val → K) → K[X]) (α : Fin n → K) :
    Fin.tail (strategyPolys strat (Fin.cons x α)) =
      strategyPolys (fun i pref => strat i.succ (Fin.cons x pref)) α := by
  funext i
  change strat i.succ (strategyPrefix (Fin.cons x α) i.succ) =
    strat i.succ (Fin.cons x (strategyPrefix α i))
  rw [strategyPrefix_cons_succ]
  rfl

#print axioms strategyPolys_tail

private theorem strategyAccept_cons_iff (d n : Nat) (G : (Fin (n+1) → K) → K)
    (c x : K) (strat : (i : Fin (n+1)) → (Fin i.val → K) → K[X])
    (α : Fin n → K) :
    strategyAccept d (n+1) G c strat (Fin.cons x α) ↔
      (strat 0 (fun j => j.elim0)).natDegree ≤ d ∧
      (strat 0 (fun j => j.elim0)).eval 0 +
        (strat 0 (fun j => j.elim0)).eval 1 = c ∧
    strategyAccept d n (fun v => G (Fin.cons x v))
      ((strat 0 (fun j => j.elim0)).eval x)
      (fun i pref => strat i.succ (Fin.cons x pref)) α := by
  have hzero : strategyPrefix (Fin.cons x α) (0 : Fin (n+1)) =
      (fun j => j.elim0) := by
    funext j
    exact j.elim0
  have hhead : (strategyPolys strat (Fin.cons x α)) 0 =
      strat 0 (fun j => j.elim0) := by
    change strat 0 (strategyPrefix (Fin.cons x α) 0) = _
    rw [hzero]
  simp only [strategyAccept, accept]
  rw [hhead, strategyPolys_tail, Fin.tail_cons, Fin.cons_zero]

#print axioms strategyAccept_cons_iff

/-- A false accepted claim under an adaptive degree-bounded strategy has at
most `n*d*|K|^(n-1)` challenge vectors. The round polynomial is queried at
`strategyPrefix`, i.e. `α (Fin.castLE i.isLt.le j)` for each prior coordinate. -/
theorem adaptive_strategy_bad_card [Fintype K] : ∀ (n d : Nat)
    (G : (Fin n → K) → K) (c : K)
    (strat : (i : Fin n) → (Fin i.val → K) → K[X]),
    IndDeg d n G →
    Fintype.card {α : Fin n → K // badAlphaStrategy d n G c strat α} ≤
      n * d * Fintype.card K ^ (n - 1) := by
  classical
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro d G c strat hdeg
      simp [badAlphaStrategy, strategyAccept, Sumcheck.accept, bsum]
  | succ n ih =>
      intro d G c strat hdeg
      let event : (Fin (n+1) → K) → Prop := badAlphaStrategy d (n+1) G c strat
      by_cases hevent : ∃ α, event α
      · obtain ⟨α₀, hα₀⟩ := hevent
        let x₀ := α₀ 0
        let v₀ := Fin.tail α₀
        have hα₀eq : α₀ = Fin.cons x₀ v₀ := by
          funext i
          refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ i
          · rfl
          · intro j
            rfl
        have hchosen : event (Fin.cons x₀ v₀) := by
          rw [← hα₀eq]
          exact hα₀
        obtain ⟨⟨h, hhd, hh⟩, hrest⟩ := hdeg
        let p := strat 0 (fun j => j.elim0)
        have hhead := (strategyAccept_cons_iff d n G _ x₀ strat v₀).1 hchosen.1
        have hpdeg : p.natDegree ≤ d := by simpa [p] using hhead.1
        have hsum : p.eval 0 + p.eval 1 = c := by simpa [p] using hhead.2.1
        have hph : p ≠ h := by
          intro heq
          apply hchosen.2
          calc
            bsum (n+1) G =
                bsum n (fun v => G (Fin.cons 0 v)) +
                  bsum n (fun v => G (Fin.cons 1 v)) := by rw [bsum]
            _ = h.eval 0 + h.eval 1 := by rw [hh 0, hh 1]
            _ = p.eval 0 + p.eval 1 := by rw [heq]
            _ = c := hsum
        have hdiff : p - h ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hph
        have hdifdeg : (p - h).natDegree ≤ d :=
          (natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le hpdeg hhd)
        let roots : Finset K := Finset.univ.filter (fun x => (p - h).eval x = 0)
        have hroots : roots.card ≤ d :=
          univariate_bad_card (p - h) hdiff d hdifdeg
        let q := Fintype.card K
        have hfiber (x : K) :
            Fintype.card {v : Fin n → K // event (Fin.cons x v)} ≤
              if x ∈ roots then q ^ n else n * d * q ^ (n - 1) := by
          by_cases hx : x ∈ roots
          · rw [if_pos hx]
            calc
              _ ≤ Fintype.card (Fin n → K) :=
                Fintype.card_le_of_injective (fun v => v.1) Subtype.val_injective
              _ = q ^ n := by simp [q]
          · rw [if_neg hx]
            have hfalseSuffix :
                bsum n (fun v => G (Fin.cons x v)) ≠ p.eval x := by
              intro heq
              apply hx
              simp only [roots, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
              rw [eval_sub, hh x, heq, sub_self]
            let sfx : (i : Fin n) → (Fin i.val → K) → K[X] :=
              fun i pref => strat i.succ (Fin.cons x pref)
            have hsub : ∀ v, event (Fin.cons x v) →
                badAlphaStrategy d n (fun w => G (Fin.cons x w)) (p.eval x) sfx v := by
              intro v hv
              have hc := (strategyAccept_cons_iff d n G _ x strat v).1 hv.1
              exact ⟨hc.2.2, hfalseSuffix⟩
            have hinj : Function.Injective
                (fun v : {v : Fin n → K // event (Fin.cons x v)} =>
                  (⟨v.1, hsub v.1 v.2⟩ :
                    {v : Fin n → K // badAlphaStrategy d n
                      (fun w => G (Fin.cons x w)) (p.eval x) sfx v})) := by
              intro a b hab
              have hval : a.1 = b.1 :=
                congrArg (fun z : {w : Fin n → K // badAlphaStrategy d n
                  (fun w => G (Fin.cons x w)) (p.eval x) sfx w} => z.1) hab
              exact Subtype.ext hval
            calc
              _ ≤ Fintype.card {v : Fin n → K //
                  badAlphaStrategy d n (fun w => G (Fin.cons x w)) (p.eval x) sfx v} :=
                Fintype.card_le_of_injective _ hinj
              _ ≤ n * d * q ^ (n - 1) := ih d _ _ _ (hrest x)
        have hsplit : Fintype.card {α : Fin (n+1) → K // event α} =
            ∑ x : K, Fintype.card {v : Fin n → K // event (Fin.cons x v)} := by
          simpa only [← Fintype.card_subtype] using
            (filter_card_fin_cons (K := K) n event)
        rw [hsplit]
        calc
          (∑ x : K, Fintype.card {v : Fin n → K // event (Fin.cons x v)}) ≤
              ∑ x : K, (if x ∈ roots then q ^ n else n * d * q ^ (n - 1)) :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun x hx => hfiber x)
          _ = roots.card * q ^ n +
              (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : K => x ∉ roots)).card *
                (n * d * q ^ (n - 1)) := by
            rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (s := Finset.univ)
              (p := fun x : K => x ∈ roots)]
            have hrootSet :
                Finset.univ.filter (fun x : K => x ∈ roots) = roots := by
              ext x
              simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
            have hrootSum :
                (∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun x : K => x ∈ roots),
                  if x ∈ roots then q ^ n else n * d * q ^ (n - 1)) =
                  roots.card * q ^ n := by
              rw [hrootSet]
              calc
                _ = ∑ x ∈ roots, q ^ n := by
                  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                  intro x hx
                  simp [hx]
                _ = _ := by simp
            have hnonrootSum :
                (∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun x : K => x ∉ roots),
                  if x ∈ roots then q ^ n else n * d * q ^ (n - 1)) =
                  (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : K => x ∉ roots)).card *
                    (n * d * q ^ (n - 1)) := by
              calc
                _ = ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun x : K => x ∉ roots),
                    (n * d * q ^ (n - 1)) := by
                  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                  intro x hx
                  have hnot : x ∉ roots := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
                  simp [hnot]
                _ = _ := by simp
            rw [hrootSum, hnonrootSum]
          _ ≤ d * q ^ n + q * (n * d * q ^ (n - 1)) := by
            apply Nat.add_le_add
            · exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ hroots
            · exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Finset.card_le_univ _)
          _ = (n+1) * d * q ^ n := by
            by_cases hn : n = 0
            · simp [hn]
            · have hpow : q * q ^ (n - 1) = q ^ n := by
                obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hn
                simp [pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]
              calc
                _ = d * q ^ n + n * d * (q * q ^ (n - 1)) := by ring
                _ = d * q ^ n + n * d * q ^ n := by rw [hpow]
                _ = (n+1) * d * q ^ n := by ring
      · have hempty : ∀ α, ¬ event α := by
          intro α hα
          exact hevent ⟨α, hα⟩
        letI : IsEmpty {α : Fin (n+1) → K // event α} :=
          ⟨fun a => (hempty a.1 a.2).elim⟩
        simp

#print axioms adaptive_strategy_bad_card

/-- The fixed production ledger instance: ten adaptive sumcheck rounds and
individual round degree at most 27. -/
theorem badAlpha_strategy [Fintype K]
    (G : (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (strat : (i : Fin 10) → (Fin i.val → K) → K[X])
    (hdeg : IndDeg 27 10 G) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin 10 → K =>
      accept 27 10 G 0
        (fun i => strat i (fun j => α (Fin.castLE i.isLt.le j))) α ∧
      bsum 10 G ≠ 0)).card ≤ 10 * 27 * Fintype.card K ^ 9 := by
  have hbound : (Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin 10 → K =>
      badAlphaStrategy 27 10 G 0 strat α)).card ≤
      10 * 27 * Fintype.card K ^ 9 := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_subtype] using
      adaptive_strategy_bad_card (K := K) 10 27 G 0 strat hdeg
  have hfilters :
      Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin 10 → K => badAlphaStrategy 27 10 G 0 strat α) =
      Finset.univ.filter (fun α : Fin 10 → K =>
        accept 27 10 G 0
          (fun i => strat i (fun j => α (Fin.castLE i.isLt.le j))) α ∧
        bsum 10 G ≠ 0) := by
    ext α
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      badAlphaStrategy, strategyAccept]
    unfold strategyPolys strategyPrefix
    rfl
  rw [← congrArg Finset.card hfilters]
  exact hbound

#print axioms badAlpha_strategy

end R0P.SemBadSets

end

-- Final public statement audit for the fixed composition obligations.
#check @R0P.SemBadSets.badMu_card
#check @R0P.SemBadSets.badTheta_card

import R1LiteralMatchingData

/-! Deterministic decomposition of a successful literal matching-data read.
This exposes the component reads already required by the reader; it adds no
acceptance, source-refinement, or security claim. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.LiteralMatchingFacts

open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript
open AspisR1.LiteralOpeningView
open AspisR1.LiteralOpeningStages
open AspisR1.LiteralChallengeRead
open AspisR1.OpeningRecordCodec
open AspisR1.SelectedOpeningData
open AspisR1.MatchingSupport

abbrev E := AspisR1.LiteralMatchingData.E

/-- The strict opening payloads assembled by `LiteralMatchingData.read` from
its staged rows and the separately read final row. -/
def payloads (staged : LiteralOpeningStages.Second)
    (row31 : OpeningRecordCodec.Payload .final) : SelectedOpeningData.Payloads :=
  { row25 := staged.toFirst.toKappa.toGamma.row25
    row26 := staged.toFirst.toKappa.toGamma.row26
    row27 := staged.toFirst.toKappa.toGamma.row27
    row28 := staged.toFirst.toKappa.row28
    row29 := staged.toFirst.row29
    row30 := staged.row30
    row31 := row31 }

theorem read_success_components
    (rs : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (d : MatchingSupport.Data E)
    (h : LiteralMatchingData.read rs = some d) :
    ∃ (common : LiteralOpeningView.View)
      (staged : LiteralOpeningStages.Second)
      (row31 : OpeningRecordCodec.Payload .final)
      (word : LiteralTranscript.VWord)
      (gamma kappa alpha0 alpha1 : E),
      LiteralOpeningView.read rs = some common ∧
      LiteralOpeningStages.readSecond rs = some staged ∧
      LiteralOpeningStages.readAt rs 31 (OpeningRecordCodec.decode .final) = some row31 ∧
      LiteralTranscript.vAt rs = some word ∧
      LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 27 = some gamma ∧
      LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 28 = some kappa ∧
      LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 29 = some alpha0 ∧
      LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 30 = some alpha1 ∧
      d = SelectedOpeningData.data (payloads staged row31) common.word word
        common.functionals common.baseFunctional gamma kappa alpha0 alpha1 := by
  unfold LiteralMatchingData.read at h
  cases hcommon : LiteralOpeningView.read rs with
  | none => simp [hcommon] at h
  | some common =>
    cases hstaged : LiteralOpeningStages.readSecond rs with
    | none => simp [hcommon, hstaged] at h
    | some staged =>
      cases hrow31 : LiteralOpeningStages.readAt rs 31 (OpeningRecordCodec.decode .final) with
      | none => simp [hcommon, hstaged, hrow31] at h
      | some row31 =>
        cases hword : LiteralTranscript.vAt rs with
        | none => simp [hcommon, hstaged, hrow31, hword] at h
        | some word =>
          cases hgamma : LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 27 with
          | none => simp [hcommon, hstaged, hrow31, hword, hgamma] at h
          | some gamma =>
            cases hkappa : LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 28 with
            | none => simp [hcommon, hstaged, hrow31, hword, hgamma, hkappa] at h
            | some kappa =>
              cases halpha0 : LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 29 with
              | none => simp [hcommon, hstaged, hrow31, hword, hgamma, hkappa, halpha0] at h
              | some alpha0 =>
                cases halpha1 : LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 30 with
                | none => simp [hcommon, hstaged, hrow31, hword, hgamma, hkappa, halpha0, halpha1] at h
                | some alpha1 =>
                  simp [hcommon, hstaged, hrow31, hword, hgamma, hkappa, halpha0, halpha1] at h
                  refine ⟨common, staged, row31, word, gamma, kappa, alpha0, alpha1,
                    rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
                  exact h.symm

#print axioms read_success_components

end AspisR1.LiteralMatchingFacts
end

import R0P.CopyInputLinks
import R0P.Digest

/-! Mechanical projection of the two append-continuation copy-link families.
The result records only the literal copy-link consequences under their
source-declared bit weights. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.AppendCopyLinks

open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

private def afterAt (i : Fin 118) : CopyLink :=
  copyLinksAfterPositivity.get ⟨i.val, by
    have hlen : copyLinksAfterPositivity.length = 118 := rfl
    rw [hlen]
    exact i.isLt⟩

private theorem after_mem (i : Fin 118) : afterAt i ∈ copyLinks := by
  have hm : afterAt i ∈ copyLinksAfterPositivity := List.get_mem _ _
  exact List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hm)

private theorem link_balance_pattern_funcs (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (link : CopyLink) (hmem : link ∈ copyLinks)
    (hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) link pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant ≠ 0) :
    copyPatternTuple (copyPatterns link.producer.pattern)
        (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) link.producer.row) =
      copyPatternTuple (copyPatterns link.consumer.pattern)
        (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) link.consumer.row) := by
  change (copyProducerTuple A link).2 = (copyConsumerTuple A link).2
  exact congrArg Prod.snd (hb link hmem hw)

private theorem copyPattern1_tuple (o : Fin 16 → K) :
    copyPatternTuple copyPattern1 o = fun i => if i.val < 8 then o i else 0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [copyPatternTuple, copyPattern1]

private theorem copyPattern10_tuple (o : Fin 16 → K) :
    copyPatternTuple copyPattern10 o = fun i =>
      if h : i.val < 8 then
        o ⟨i.val + 8, by omega⟩ + (if i.val = 7 then (1051521018 : K) else 0)
      else 0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [copyPatternTuple, copyPattern10]

private theorem copyPatterns1 : copyPatterns 1 = copyPattern1 := rfl
private theorem copyPatterns10 : copyPatterns 10 = copyPattern10 := rfl

private theorem leftSpec (level : Fin 20) :
    afterAt ⟨6 + 2 * level.val, by omega⟩ =
      ⟨1124073496 + 2 * level.val, 3, level.val,
        ⟨⟨539 + 16 * level.val, by omega⟩, 0, 1⟩,
        ⟨⟨556 + 16 * level.val, by omega⟩, 0, 1⟩⟩ := by
  fin_cases level <;> rfl

private theorem rightSpec (level : Fin 20) :
    afterAt ⟨7 + 2 * level.val, by omega⟩ =
      ⟨1124073497 + 2 * level.val, 4, level.val,
        ⟨⟨539 + 16 * level.val, by omega⟩, 1, 1⟩,
        ⟨⟨544 + 16 * level.val, by omega⟩, 0, 10⟩⟩ := by
  fin_cases level <;> rfl

private theorem leftRow (level : Fin 20) :
    g2Row ⟨33 + level.val, by omega⟩ 11 =
      (⟨539 + 16 * level.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 1024) := by
  apply Fin.ext
  change 16 * (33 + level.val) + 11 = 539 + 16 * level.val
  omega

private theorem rightRow12 (level : Fin 20) :
    g2Row ⟨34 + level.val, by omega⟩ 12 =
      (⟨556 + 16 * level.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 1024) := by
  apply Fin.ext
  change 16 * (34 + level.val) + 12 = 556 + 16 * level.val
  omega

private theorem rightRow0 (level : Fin 20) :
    g2Row ⟨34 + level.val, by omega⟩ 0 =
      (⟨544 + 16 * level.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 1024) := by
  apply Fin.ext
  change 16 * (34 + level.val) + 0 = 544 + 16 * level.val
  omega

private theorem castLE_fin8 (i : Fin 8) :
    Fin.castLE (by omega : 16 ≤ 29) (i.castAdd 8) = i.castAdd 21 := by
  apply Fin.ext
  rfl

private theorem castLE_fin8_shift (i : Fin 8) :
    Fin.castLE (by omega : 16 ≤ 29) ⟨i.val + 8, by omega⟩ =
      ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ := by
  apply Fin.ext
  change i.val + 8 = 8 + i.val
  omega

/-- The append continuation cells selected by the zero/one branch weights in
the exact `copyLinksAfterPositivity` registry entries. -/
theorem append_cells (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (level : Fin 20) :
    ((((pub.nextPairIndex >>> level.val) &&& 1) = 0) →
      ∀ i : Fin 8,
        A (i.castAdd 21) (g2Row ⟨33 + level.val, by omega⟩ 11) =
          A (i.castAdd 21) (g2Row ⟨34 + level.val, by omega⟩ 12)) ∧
    ((((pub.nextPairIndex >>> level.val) &&& 1) = 1) →
      ∀ i : Fin 8,
        A (i.castAdd 21) (g2Row ⟨33 + level.val, by omega⟩ 11) =
          A ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ (g2Row ⟨34 + level.val, by omega⟩ 0) +
            (if i.val = 7 then (1051521018 : K) else 0)) := by
  constructor
  · intro hbit i
    have hlink := link_balance_pattern_funcs pub A hb
      (afterAt ⟨6 + 2 * level.val, by omega⟩)
      (after_mem _)
      (by simp [copyLinkWeight, leftSpec, hbit])
    have hi := congrFun hlink (i.castAdd 8)
    simpa only [leftSpec, copyPatterns1, copyPattern1_tuple,
      Fin.val_castAdd, if_pos i.isLt, castLE_fin8,
      leftRow, rightRow12] using hi
  · intro hbit i
    have hlink := link_balance_pattern_funcs pub A hb
      (afterAt ⟨7 + 2 * level.val, by omega⟩)
      (after_mem _)
      (by simp [copyLinkWeight, rightSpec, hbit])
    have hi := congrFun hlink (i.castAdd 8)
    simp only [rightSpec, copyPatterns1, copyPatterns10,
      copyPattern1_tuple, copyPattern10_tuple, Fin.val_castAdd,
      if_pos i.isLt, dif_pos i.isLt, castLE_fin8, castLE_fin8_shift] at hi
    rw [leftRow, rightRow0]
    convert hi using 1
    congr 1 <;> norm_num

#print axioms append_cells

end AspisR1.AppendCopyLinks

import R1LiteralTypedWords
import R1CandidateBaseProjection
import R1ConcreteSpendExtraction

/-! Concrete M31 checking for a candidate selected from literal typed C1/C2
words. This is algebraic model plumbing only; it does not connect Rust
acceptance or byte extraction to the literal words. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxRecDepth 4096
namespace AspisR1.LiteralSpendExtraction

open R0P SpendRelation AspisWideTower AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase

attribute [local irreducible] ConcreteBinding.candidates

abbrev E := WideExact
abbrev embed := ExactBaseProjection.embed

theorem candidate_checked_witness
    (pub : Public M31Exact) (hshape : PublicOptionShape.canonical pub)
    (eK : QM31Exact →+* E)
    (c1 : LiteralTypedWords.C1Word) (c2 : LiteralTypedWords.C2Word)
    (t : ConcreteBinding.Tuple E)
    (ht : t ∈ ConcreteBinding.candidates (LiteralTypedWords.word embed eK c1 c2))
    (lam chi : E)
    (h : ProductionHolds (SpendDataMap.mapPublic embed pub) lam chi
        (SemSource.rowsOf rowEquiv t) ∧
      CopyLinkBalance (SpendDataMap.mapPublic embed pub) (SemSource.rowsOf rowEquiv t)) :
    ∃ w : Wspend, checkM31 pub w = true := by
  let S := LiteralTypedWords.laneSubfield embed eK
  let W := LiteralTypedWords.word embed eK c1 c2
  have htyped : CandidateDescent.WordTyped S W :=
    LiteralTypedWords.word_typed embed eK c1 c2
  have hlanes : ∀ l : Fin 29, l.val < 26 →
      S l = embed.fieldRange := by
    intro l hl
    simp [S, LiteralTypedWords.laneSubfield,
      TypedRecoveredWords.laneSubfield, hl]
  have hbase := CandidateBaseProjection.rows_base_typed_of_uniform
    (E := E) S embed.fieldRange hlanes W htyped t ht rowEquiv
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := ConcreteSpendExtraction.of_production pub
    (SemSource.rowsOf rowEquiv t) lam chi hshape hbase h
  exact ⟨w, (check_eq_true_iff pub w).mpr hw⟩

#print axioms candidate_checked_witness
end AspisR1.LiteralSpendExtraction

R1ConcreteSpendExtraction.text:
import R1TraceSpendWitness
import R1CandidateBaseProjection
import R1SpendRelationExtraction

/-! Production facts on a base-typed wide trace imply an actual M31 spend
witness. Candidate typing is discharged using the existing subfield descent.
This is an existential algebraic theorem, not an efficient list decoder or
an acceptance-to-production/source-refinement theorem. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxRecDepth 4096
namespace AspisR1.ConcreteSpendExtraction

open R0P SpendRelation AspisWideTower AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
abbrev E := WideExact
abbrev embed := ExactBaseProjection.embed

attribute [local irreducible] poseidonPermutation nodeCompress merkleRoot
attribute [local irreducible] ConcreteBinding.candidates

theorem of_production (pub : Public M31Exact) (A : Trace E) (lam chi : E)
    (hshape : PublicOptionShape.canonical pub)
    (hbase : BaseTyped embed.fieldRange A)
    (h : ProductionHolds (SpendDataMap.mapPublic embed pub) lam chi A ∧
      CopyLinkBalance (SpendDataMap.mapPublic embed pub) A) :
    ∃ w : Wspend, Rspend pub w := by
  letI : CharP E P :=
    charP_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap M31Exact E).injective P
  let widePub := SpendDataMap.mapPublic embed pub
  have hwideShape : PublicOptionShape.canonical widePub :=
    (SpendRelationMap.canonical_map_iff embed embed.injective pub).mpr hshape
  obtain ⟨v0, v1, v2, h0, h1, h2, hbalance, e0, e1, e2, hinput⟩ :=
    InputWitness.bounded_of_production P (by norm_num [P]) widePub A lam chi h
  have hfacts := SpendSemantics.of_production P (by norm_num [P]) widePub A lam chi h
  let w := TraceSpendWitness.fromTrace A ⟨v0, h0⟩ ⟨v1, h1⟩ ⟨v2, h2⟩
  have hw : Rspend widePub w := by
    refine ⟨hwideShape, hinput, hbalance, ?_, ?_,
      SpendRelationExtraction.append_of_production P (by norm_num [P])
        widePub A lam chi hwideShape h⟩
    · simpa only [changeCommitment, w, TraceSpendWitness.fromTrace, e2] using hfacts.change
    · cases hv : widePub.variant with
      | privateTransfer =>
          obtain ⟨recipient, hr, _⟩ :=
            PublicOptionShape.private_transfer_shape widePub hv hwideShape
          rw [variantOutput, hv, hr]
          apply congrArg some
          simpa only [recipientCommitment, w, TraceSpendWitness.fromTrace, e1] using
            hfacts.recipient hv recipient hr
      | withdrawal =>
          obtain ⟨amount, _, ha, _⟩ :=
            PublicOptionShape.withdrawal_shape widePub hv hwideShape
          rw [variantOutput, hv, ha]
          apply congrArg some
          exact (hfacts.withdrawal hv amount ha).symm.trans e1
  exact ⟨SpendBaseDescent.projectWitness w,
    SpendBaseDescent.rspend_project pub w
      (TraceSpendWitness.base_coordinates A ⟨v0, h0⟩ ⟨v1, h1⟩ ⟨v2, h2⟩ hbase) hw⟩

theorem candidate_checked_witness
    (pub : Public M31Exact) (hshape : PublicOptionShape.canonical pub)
    (eK : QM31Exact →+* E)
    (c1Packed c2Packed : Fin 262144 → Option (List ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte))
    (t : ConcreteBinding.Tuple E)
    (ht : t ∈ ConcreteBinding.candidates
      (TypedRecoveredWords.word embed eK c1Packed c2Packed))
    (lam chi : E)
    (h : ProductionHolds (SpendDataMap.mapPublic embed pub) lam chi
        (SemSource.rowsOf rowEquiv t) ∧
      CopyLinkBalance (SpendDataMap.mapPublic embed pub) (SemSource.rowsOf rowEquiv t)) :
    ∃ w : Wspend, checkM31 pub w = true := by
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := of_production pub (SemSource.rowsOf rowEquiv t) lam chi hshape
    (CandidateBaseProjection.rows_base_typed eK c1Packed c2Packed t ht) h
  exact ⟨w, (check_eq_true_iff pub w).mpr hw⟩

#print axioms of_production
#print axioms candidate_checked_witness
end AspisR1.ConcreteSpendExtraction
R1ConcreteSpendExtraction.qualification: Retained source alongside hash-matched historical selected object; fresh replay required; no claim of an independently retained original source receipt.

R1TraceSpendWitness.text:
import R1SpendBaseDescent
import R1OutputNotes
import R1InputPair

/-! Build the explicit spend-witness record from the existing trace selectors.
The record construction is noncomputable because `tracePath` already is.
This file proves only that the selected field coordinates are in the base;
it does not prove spend validity from trace gates. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.TraceSpendWitness

open R0P AspisWideTower AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
open AspisR1.SpendRelation AspisR1.SpendBaseDescent

abbrev E := WideExact
abbrev F := ExactBaseProjection.embed.fieldRange

private theorem baseChunk (A : Trace E) (hA : BaseTyped F A)
    (block : Fin 57) (i : Fin 8) : (OutputNotes.chunk A block) i ∈ F := by
  unfold OutputNotes.chunk digestOf poseidonState
  have hi : i.val < 8 := i.isLt
  have hc : (⟨i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 29).val < 26 := by
    change i.val < 26
    omega
  exact hA ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ hc (poseidonBlockRow block 12)

private theorem baseSalt (A : Trace E) (hA : BaseTyped F A)
    (middle last : Fin 57) (i : Fin 8) : (OutputNotes.salt A middle last) i ∈ F := by
  unfold OutputNotes.salt
  split_ifs with hi
  · exact baseChunk A hA middle ⟨i.val + 2, by omega⟩
  · exact baseChunk A hA last ⟨i.val - 6, by omega⟩

/-- The trace-selected spend witness, using the same literal coordinates as
`SpendRelationExtraction.of_production`. -/
noncomputable def fromTrace (A : Trace E) (v0 v1 v2 : Fin (2^30)) : Witness E :=
  { inputValue := v0
    outputValue := v1
    changeValue := v2
    sk := traceSk A
    salt := traceSalt A
    path := tracePath A
    pair := InputPair.leaf A
    recipientOwner := OutputNotes.chunk A 27
    recipientSalt := OutputNotes.salt A 28 29
    changeOwner := OutputNotes.chunk A 30
    changeSalt := OutputNotes.salt A 31 32 }

/-- Every field coordinate selected by `fromTrace` comes from one of the
first 26 trace columns, so `BaseTyped` suffices for all eleven witness groups. -/
theorem base_coordinates (A : Trace E) (v0 v1 v2 : Fin (2^30))
    (hA : BaseTyped F A) : BaseCoordinates (fromTrace A v0 v1 v2) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    have hi : i.val < 8 := i.isLt
    have hc : (⟨i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 29).val < 26 := by
      change i.val < 26
      omega
    exact hA ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ hc 12
  · intro i
    change (traceSalt A i) ∈ F
    by_cases hi : i.val < 6
    · rw [traceSalt, dif_pos hi]
      have hc : (⟨i.val + 2, by omega⟩ : Fin 29).val < 26 := by
        change i.val + 2 < 26
        have hii := i.isLt
        omega
      exact hA ⟨i.val + 2, by omega⟩ hc 44
    · rw [traceSalt, dif_neg hi]
      have hc : (⟨i.val - 6, by omega⟩ : Fin 29).val < 26 := by
        change i.val - 6 < 26
        omega
      exact hA ⟨i.val - 6, by omega⟩ hc 60
  · intro level i
    unfold fromTrace tracePath
    by_cases hz : A 0 (pathBaseRow level) = 0
    · simp [hz]
      have hr : (⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 29).val < 26 := by
        change 8 + i.val < 26
        have hi := i.isLt
        omega
      exact hA ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ hr (succRow (pathBaseRow level))
    · simp [hz]
      have hr : (⟨i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 29).val < 26 := by
        change i.val < 26
        have hi := i.isLt
        omega
      exact hA ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ hr (succRow (pathBaseRow level))
  · intro i
    unfold fromTrace InputPair.leaf AppendNode.left
    exact baseChunk A hA 4 i
  · unfold fromTrace InputPair.leaf
    exact hA 0 (by omega) 1017
  · intro i
    unfold fromTrace InputPair.leaf
    have hr : (⟨2 + i.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 29).val < 26 := by
      change 2 + i.val < 26
      have hi := i.isLt
      omega
    exact hA ⟨2 + i.val, by omega⟩ hr 1017
  · unfold fromTrace InputPair.leaf
    exact hA 1 (by omega) 1017
  · intro i
    unfold fromTrace
    exact baseChunk A hA 27 i
  · intro i
    unfold fromTrace
    exact baseSalt A hA 28 29 i
  · intro i
    unfold fromTrace
    exact baseChunk A hA 30 i
  · intro i
    unfold fromTrace
    exact baseSalt A hA 31 32 i

R1SpendBaseDescent.text:
import R1SpendRelationMap
import R1ExactBaseProjection

/-! Explicit descent of an already valid wide-field witness whose coordinates
belong to the embedded base. The coordinate premise must be obtained from
candidate/trace typing; it is not inferred from spend validity alone. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SpendBaseDescent

open R0P SpendRelation AspisWideTower AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase

abbrev E := WideExact
abbrev F := ExactBaseProjection.embed.fieldRange

structure BaseCoordinates (w : Witness E) : Prop where
  sk : ∀ i, w.sk i ∈ F
  salt : ∀ i, w.salt i ∈ F
  path : ∀ level i, (w.path level).2 i ∈ F
  first : ∀ i, w.pair.firstCommitment i ∈ F
  occupied : w.pair.secondOccupied ∈ F
  second : ∀ i, w.pair.secondCommitment i ∈ F
  inverse : w.pair.secondOccupancyInverse ∈ F
  recipientOwner : ∀ i, w.recipientOwner i ∈ F
  recipientSalt : ∀ i, w.recipientSalt i ∈ F
  changeOwner : ∀ i, w.changeOwner i ∈ F
  changeSalt : ∀ i, w.changeSalt i ∈ F

def projectWitness (w : Witness E) : Wspend :=
  SpendDataMap.witness ExactBaseProjection.project w

private theorem digest_recover (d : R0P.Digest E) (hd : ∀ i, d i ∈ F) :
    SpendDataMap.digest ExactBaseProjection.embed
      (SpendDataMap.digest ExactBaseProjection.project d) = d := by
  funext i
  exact ExactBaseProjection.embed_project_of_mem_fieldRange (hd i)

theorem witness_recover (w : Witness E) (h : BaseCoordinates w) :
    SpendDataMap.witness ExactBaseProjection.embed (projectWitness w) = w := by
  have hsk := digest_recover w.sk h.sk
  have hsalt := digest_recover w.salt h.salt
  have hro := digest_recover w.recipientOwner h.recipientOwner
  have hrs := digest_recover w.recipientSalt h.recipientSalt
  have hco := digest_recover w.changeOwner h.changeOwner
  have hcs := digest_recover w.changeSalt h.changeSalt
  have hpath : SpendDataMap.path ExactBaseProjection.embed
      (SpendDataMap.path ExactBaseProjection.project w.path) = w.path := by
    funext level
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · exact digest_recover (w.path level).2 (h.path level)
  have hpair : SpendDataMap.pair ExactBaseProjection.embed
      (SpendDataMap.pair ExactBaseProjection.project w.pair) = w.pair := by
    have hfirst := digest_recover w.pair.firstCommitment h.first
    have hsecond := digest_recover w.pair.secondCommitment h.second
    have hocc := ExactBaseProjection.embed_project_of_mem_fieldRange h.occupied
    have hinv := ExactBaseProjection.embed_project_of_mem_fieldRange h.inverse
    change { w.pair with
      firstCommitment := SpendDataMap.digest ExactBaseProjection.embed
        (SpendDataMap.digest ExactBaseProjection.project w.pair.firstCommitment)
      secondOccupied := ExactBaseProjection.embed (ExactBaseProjection.project w.pair.secondOccupied)
      secondCommitment := SpendDataMap.digest ExactBaseProjection.embed
        (SpendDataMap.digest ExactBaseProjection.project w.pair.secondCommitment)
      secondOccupancyInverse := ExactBaseProjection.embed
        (ExactBaseProjection.project w.pair.secondOccupancyInverse) } = w.pair
    rw [hfirst, hsecond, hocc, hinv]
  change { w with
    sk := SpendDataMap.digest ExactBaseProjection.embed
      (SpendDataMap.digest ExactBaseProjection.project w.sk)
    salt := SpendDataMap.digest ExactBaseProjection.embed
      (SpendDataMap.digest ExactBaseProjection.project w.salt)
    path := SpendDataMap.path ExactBaseProjection.embed
      (SpendDataMap.path ExactBaseProjection.project w.path)
    pair := SpendDataMap.pair ExactBaseProjection.embed
      (SpendDataMap.pair ExactBaseProjection.project w.pair)
    recipientOwner := SpendDataMap.digest ExactBaseProjection.embed
      (SpendDataMap.digest ExactBaseProjection.project w.recipientOwner)
    recipientSalt := SpendDataMap.digest ExactBaseProjection.embed
      (SpendDataMap.digest ExactBaseProjection.project w.recipientSalt)
    changeOwner := SpendDataMap.digest ExactBaseProjection.embed
      (SpendDataMap.digest ExactBaseProjection.project w.changeOwner)
    changeSalt := SpendDataMap.digest ExactBaseProjection.embed
      (SpendDataMap.digest ExactBaseProjection.project w.changeSalt) } = w
  rw [hsk, hsalt, hpath, hpair, hro, hrs, hco, hcs]

theorem rspend_project (pub : Public M31Exact) (w : Witness E)
    (hbase : BaseCoordinates w)
    (h : Rspend (SpendDataMap.mapPublic ExactBaseProjection.embed pub) w) :
    Rspend pub (projectWitness w) := by
  apply (SpendRelationMap.rspend_map_iff ExactBaseProjection.embed pub (projectWitness w)).mp
  rw [witness_recover w hbase]
  exact h

theorem check_project (pub : Public M31Exact) (w : Witness E)
    (hbase : BaseCoordinates w)
    (h : Rspend (SpendDataMap.mapPublic ExactBaseProjection.embed pub) w) :
    checkM31 pub (projectWitness w) = true :=
  (check_eq_true_iff pub (projectWitness w)).mpr (rspend_project pub w hbase h)

#print axioms witness_recover
#print axioms rspend_project
#print axioms check_project
end AspisR1.SpendBaseDescent

import R0P.MaskDensity

/-! Exact accounting for the unchanged 25-row semantic prefix. This is the
sum of prefix-conditional independent-answer bounds, not a Fiat--Shamir or
adaptive shared-oracle security theorem. No work/grinding factor appears. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SemanticBudget
open R0P R0P.Mask R0P.SemSource R0P.SemD3Glue R0P.SemRounds
open AspisCircleGroupOrder
open scoped BigOperators

/-- Candidate-unioned root caps, in their actual challenge order. -/
def roots (i : Fin 25) : Nat :=
  if i.val = 0 then 217600 else if i.val = 1 then 54400 else
  if i.val = 2 then 2800 else if i.val < 13 then 100 else
  if i.val = 13 then 200 else if i.val = 14 then 100 else 2700

def atom : ℚ := (1 + deltaQ) / (P : ℚ)^4

theorem budget_eq (i : Fin 25) :
    combinedD2BudgetZ i.val = (roots i : ℚ) * atom := by
  unfold combinedD2BudgetZ combinedD2Budget semRoundBudget roots atom
  split_ifs <;> norm_num at *
  all_goals first | omega | ring

/-- Only 25 small scalar entries are evaluated here, not a generated
recurrence or a finite-field/candidate enumeration. -/
theorem roots_sum : ∑ i : Fin 25, roots i = 303100 := by
  norm_num [Fin.sum_univ_succ, roots]

theorem budget_sum : ∑ i : Fin 25, combinedD2BudgetZ i.val = 303100 * atom := by
  simp_rw [budget_eq]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, ← Nat.cast_sum, roots_sum]
  norm_num

#print axioms budget_eq
#print axioms roots_sum
#print axioms budget_sum
end AspisR1.SemanticBudget

import AspisV8R17.AdaptiveOracle
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Field
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

/-! Uniform finite-oracle resampling by a concrete swap bijection.
No assumption that an adaptive execution never repeats an address. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.OracleResampling
noncomputable section
variable {X Y I A : Type*}

def mean [Fintype X] (f : X → ℚ) : ℚ := (∑ x, f x) / Fintype.card X

theorem mean_congr [Fintype X] {f g : X → ℚ} (h : ∀ x, f x = g x) :
    mean f = mean g := by
  unfold mean
  congr 1
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun x _ => h x)

theorem mean_const [Fintype X] [Nonempty X] (c : ℚ) : mean (fun _ : X => c) = c := by
  have hn : (Fintype.card X : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  simp [mean, hn]

theorem mean_equiv [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] (e : X ≃ Y) (f : Y → ℚ) :
    mean (fun x => f (e x)) = mean f := by
  unfold mean
  rw [Equiv.sum_comp e, Fintype.card_congr e]

theorem mean_prod [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] (f : X → Y → ℚ) :
    mean (fun p : X × Y => f p.1 p.2) = mean (fun x => mean (f x)) := by
  simp only [mean, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.card_prod, Nat.cast_mul]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div, div_div]
  congr 1
  ring

theorem mean_comm [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] (f : X → Y → ℚ) :
    mean (fun x => mean (f x)) = mean (fun y => mean (fun x => f x y)) := by
  rw [← mean_prod, ← mean_prod]
  exact (mean_equiv (Equiv.prodComm Y X) (fun p : X × Y => f p.1 p.2)).symm

def swapCell [DecidableEq I] (i : I) : ((I → A) × A) ≃ ((I → A) × A) where
  toFun p := (Function.update p.1 i p.2, p.1 i)
  invFun p := (Function.update p.1 i p.2, p.1 i)
  left_inv p := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext j
      by_cases h : j = i <;> simp [h, Function.update_of_ne]
    · simp
  right_inv p := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · funext j
      by_cases h : j = i <;> simp [h, Function.update_of_ne]
    · simp

theorem resample_cell [Fintype I] [Fintype A] [Nonempty A] [DecidableEq I]
    (i : I) (f : (I → A) → ℚ) :
    mean f = mean (fun a => mean (fun H => f (Function.update H i a))) := by
  have h := mean_equiv (swapCell (A := A) i) (fun p : (I → A) × A => f p.1)
  change mean (fun p : (I → A) × A => f (Function.update p.1 i p.2)) =
    mean (fun p : (I → A) × A => f p.1) at h
  rw [mean_prod (fun H a => f (Function.update H i a)),
    mean_prod (fun (H : I → A) (_ : A) => f H)] at h
  simp only [mean_const] at h
  rw [mean_comm] at h
  exact h.symm

#print axioms mean_congr
#print axioms mean_const
#print axioms mean_equiv
#print axioms mean_prod
#print axioms mean_comm
#print axioms swapCell
#print axioms resample_cell
end
end AspisV8R19.OracleResampling

import R1LiteralSemanticPairs
import R1SelectedSemanticPrefixFacts

/-! Projection facts from a successful literal semantic parse to its
canonical typed-payload rounds. These are model equalities only; they do not
assert acceptance, source correspondence, or probability bounds. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1.LiteralSemanticParserFacts

open AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPairs
open AspisR1.SemanticPayloadView
open AspisR1.SelectedSemanticPrefixFacts
open R0P.Mask

abbrev E := AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPrefix.E

theorem read_lift_eq_rounds
    (eK : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact →+* E)
    (rs : List (AspisR1.LiteralTranscript.Message × AspisR1.LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (out : List (SemMsgZ E × E))
    (word : AspisR1.LiteralTranscript.C2Word)
    (hread : AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPrefix.read eK 0 rs = some out)
    (hlen : rs.length = 25)
    (hc2 : AspisR1.LiteralTranscript.c2At rs = some word) :
    ∃ payloads : (i : Fin 25) → AspisR1.SemanticRecordCodec.RowPayload i,
    ∃ challenges : Fin 25 → E,
      lift out = rounds (fun _ => AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word)
        payloads challenges := by
  obtain ⟨payloads, challenges, hout⟩ :=
    LiteralSemanticPairs.read_eq_pairs eK rs out word hread hlen hc2
  refine ⟨payloads, challenges, ?_⟩
  rw [hout]
  rfl

theorem read_projection_facts
    (eK : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact →+* E)
    (rs : List (AspisR1.LiteralTranscript.Message × AspisR1.LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (out : List (SemMsgZ E × E))
    (word : AspisR1.LiteralTranscript.C2Word)
    (hread : AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPrefix.read eK 0 rs = some out)
    (hlen : rs.length = 25)
    (hc2 : AspisR1.LiteralTranscript.c2At rs = some word) :
    ∃ payloads : (i : Fin 25) → AspisR1.SemanticRecordCodec.RowPayload i,
    ∃ challenges : Fin 25 → E,
      lift out = rounds (fun _ => AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word)
        payloads challenges ∧
      semChalsZ (lift out) = some (List.ofFn challenges) ∧
      c2OfZ (lift out) = some
        (AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word) ∧
      claimOf (lift out) = some (claimAt14 payloads) ∧
      semPolysZ (lift out) = some
        (fun j => SemanticCoefficientCodec.polynomial (coeffAt payloads j)) ∧
      ∀ j, ((SemanticCoefficientCodec.polynomial (coeffAt payloads j) : Polynomial E).natDegree ≤ 27) := by
  obtain ⟨payloads, challenges, hout⟩ :=
    read_lift_eq_rounds eK rs out word hread hlen hc2
  refine ⟨payloads, challenges, hout, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [hout] using
      (SemanticPayloadView.semChalsZ_rounds
        (fun _ => AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word)
        payloads challenges)
  · simpa [hout] using
      (SemanticPayloadView.c2OfZ_rounds
        (fun _ => AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word)
        payloads challenges)
  · simpa [hout] using
      (SemanticPayloadView.claimOf_rounds
        (fun _ => AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word)
        payloads challenges)
  · simpa [hout] using
      (SemanticPayloadView.semPolysZ_rounds
        (fun _ => AspisR1.LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK word)
        payloads challenges)
  · intro j
    exact SemanticPayloadView.polynomial_degree payloads j

#print axioms read_lift_eq_rounds
#print axioms read_projection_facts

end AspisR1.LiteralSemanticParserFacts
end

R1RoundPairing.text:
import R1NaturalProjection
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Eval.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Degree.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Monomial
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.BigOperators
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

/-! Generic algebra for one radix-four round pairing. The formulas mirror the
specified source permutation `[0, 3, 2, 1]` and Horner orders. This file proves
only polynomial degree, evaluation, coefficient-boundary, and Horner
identities; it is not a source-semantics or multi-round soundness result. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1.RoundPairing

open Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

variable {K : Type*} [Field K]

def quarter : K := (4 : K)⁻¹

def dot {n : Nat} (q w : Fin n → K) : K :=
  ∑ i : Fin n, q i * w i

def primalFold {n : Nat} (alpha : K) (q : Fin (4 * n) → K)
    (d : Fin n) : K :=
  ∑ s : Fin 4, q (AspisR1.childIndex d s) * alpha ^ s.val

/-- Rust's source permutation, written as the four entries `[0,3,2,1]`. -/
def sourcePerm : Fin 4 → Fin 4 := ![0, 3, 2, 1]

theorem sourcePerm_val (t : Fin 4) :
    (sourcePerm t).val = (4 - t.val) % 4 := by
  fin_cases t <;> rfl

def dualFold {n : Nat} (alpha : K) (w : Fin (4 * n) → K)
    (d : Fin n) : K :=
  quarter * ∑ t : Fin 4,
    w (AspisR1.childIndex d t) * alpha ^ ((4 - t.val) % 4)

def roundPolynomial {n : Nat} (q w : Fin (4 * n) → K) : K[X] :=
  ∑ d : Fin n, ∑ s : Fin 4, ∑ t : Fin 4,
    monomial (s.val + (4 - t.val) % 4)
      (quarter * q (AspisR1.childIndex d s) * w (AspisR1.childIndex d t))

def primalHorner {n : Nat} (alpha : K) (q : Fin (4 * n) → K)
    (d : Fin n) : K :=
  q (AspisR1.childIndex d 0) + alpha *
    (q (AspisR1.childIndex d 1) + alpha *
      (q (AspisR1.childIndex d 2) + alpha *
        q (AspisR1.childIndex d 3)))

def dualHorner {n : Nat} (alpha : K) (w : Fin (4 * n) → K)
    (d : Fin n) : K :=
  quarter * (w (AspisR1.childIndex d 0) + alpha *
    (w (AspisR1.childIndex d 3) + alpha *
      (w (AspisR1.childIndex d 2) + alpha *
        w (AspisR1.childIndex d 1))))

theorem primalFold_horner {n : Nat} (alpha : K)
    (q : Fin (4 * n) → K) (d : Fin n) :
    primalFold alpha q d = primalHorner alpha q d := by
  rw [primalFold, Fin.sum_univ_four]
  simp [primalHorner]
  ring

theorem dualFold_horner {n : Nat} (alpha : K)
    (w : Fin (4 * n) → K) (d : Fin n) :
    dualFold alpha w d = dualHorner alpha w d := by
  unfold dualFold dualHorner
  apply congrArg (fun z : K => quarter * z)
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
  simp [AspisR1.childIndex]
  ring

theorem round_degree {n : Nat} (q w : Fin (4 * n) → K) :
    (roundPolynomial q w).natDegree ≤ 6 := by
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
  intro d _hd
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
  intro s _hs
  apply Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le_of_forall_le
  intro t _ht
  apply (Polynomial.natDegree_monomial_le _).trans
  have hs := s.isLt
  have ht := Nat.mod_lt (4 - t.val) (by decide : 0 < 4)
  omega

theorem round_eval {n : Nat} (alpha : K)
    (q w : Fin (4 * n) → K) :
    (roundPolynomial q w).eval alpha =
      dot (primalFold alpha q) (dualFold alpha w) := by
  simp only [roundPolynomial, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum,
    Polynomial.eval_monomial, dot, primalFold, dualFold,
    Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, pow_add]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d _hd
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s _hs
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro t _ht
  ring

theorem round_boundary {n : Nat} (q w : Fin (4 * n) → K) :
    (roundPolynomial q w).coeff 0 + (roundPolynomial q w).coeff 4 =
      quarter * dot q w := by
  have reindex : dot q w =
      ∑ d : Fin n, ∑ s : Fin 4,
        q (AspisR1.childIndex d s) * w (AspisR1.childIndex d s) := by
    rw [dot, ← (AspisR1.fibreIndexEquiv n).sum_comp,
      Fintype.sum_prod_type]
    rfl
  rw [reindex, roundPolynomial]
  simp only [Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro d _hd
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_four, Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
  ring

/-- If the degree-zero/four coefficient claim is known, cancel the quarter
factor to recover the original dot product. -/
theorem round_boundary_cancellation {n : Nat}
    (h4 : (4 : K) ≠ 0) (q w : Fin (4 * n) → K) :
    dot q w = 4 *
      ((roundPolynomial q w).coeff 0 + (roundPolynomial q w).coeff 4) := by
  rw [round_boundary]
  dsimp [quarter]
  field_simp [h4]

theorem round_boundary_cancellation_of_claim {n : Nat}
    (h4 : (4 : K) ≠ 0) (q w : Fin (4 * n) → K) (claim : K)
    (hclaim : (roundPolynomial q w).coeff 0 +
      (roundPolynomial q w).coeff 4 = claim) :
    dot q w = 4 * claim := by
  rw [round_boundary_cancellation h4, hclaim]

#print axioms sourcePerm_val
#print axioms primalFold_horner
#print axioms dualFold_horner
#print axioms round_degree
#print axioms round_eval
#print axioms round_boundary
#print axioms round_boundary_cancellation
#print axioms round_boundary_cancellation_of_claim

end AspisR1.RoundPairing

end

R1RhoSamplerBound.text:
import R1QueryResidualBridge
import R0C.ModuloCounting

/-! Independent-answer density of the explicit modulo-reduction sampler
against the concrete query residual set. Input and output encodings are
equivalences, not assumed uniformity laws. Source byte/field correspondence,
Merkle binding and shared-oracle Fiat--Shamir remain separate obligations. -/

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.RhoSamplerBound

open AspisCircleGroupOrder AspisR1.MatchingSupport
open AspisV8R19.OracleResampling AspisV8R19.CausalFirstHitUnionBound

variable {A K E : Type} [Fintype A] [Field K] [Fintype K]
  [Field E] [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Algebra (ZMod P) E]

/-- Balanced reduction has at most floor(B/n)+1 inputs per output. Applying
the 21-root count gives this unconditional fresh-answer residual bound. -/
theorem modulo_bad_mass {B n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n)
    (input : A ≃ Fin B) (output : Fin n ≃ K)
    (iota : K →+* E) (d : Data E) (q : Fin 22 → Fin 262144) :
    mean (fun a : A => indicator
      (output (R0C.ModuloCounting.reduce hn (input a)) ∈
        AspisR1.QueryResidualBridge.rhoBad iota d q)) ≤
      21 * (((B / n + 1 : Nat) : ℚ) / B) := by
  have hmass := R0C.ModuloCounting.event_mass_le
    (fun a : A => output (R0C.ModuloCounting.reduce hn (input a)))
    (((B / n + 1 : Nat) : ℚ) / B)
    (R0C.ModuloCounting.encoded_mass_le hn input output)
    (AspisR1.QueryResidualBridge.rhoBad iota d q)
  apply hmass.trans
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
  · exact_mod_cast AspisR1.QueryResidualBridge.rhoBad_card iota d q
  · positivity

def rhoCap : ℚ :=
  21 * (((2^256 / P^4 + 1 : Nat) : ℚ) / (2^256 : Nat))

/-- Small closed integer/rational arithmetic only; no field enumeration. -/
theorem rhoCap_lt_two_neg_119 : rhoCap < 1 / (2^119 : ℚ) := by
  norm_num [rhoCap, P]

/-- The actual parameter sizes, with the byte ranking and field ranking
left explicit. This is a theorem about the specified encoded modulo map. -/
theorem qm31_parameter_bad_mass
    (input : A ≃ Fin (2^256)) (output : Fin (P^4) ≃ K)
    (iota : K →+* E) (d : Data E) (q : Fin 22 → Fin 262144) :
    mean (fun a : A => indicator
      (output (R0C.ModuloCounting.reduce (by norm_num [P]) (input a)) ∈
        AspisR1.QueryResidualBridge.rhoBad iota d q)) <
      1 / (2^119 : ℚ) :=
  (modulo_bad_mass (by norm_num [P]) input output iota d q).trans_lt
    rhoCap_lt_two_neg_119

#print axioms modulo_bad_mass
#print axioms rhoCap_lt_two_neg_119
#print axioms qm31_parameter_bad_mass

end AspisR1.RhoSamplerBound
end

/-- Adapt one decoded four-byte source word to the corresponding Lean UInt32
digit. This is only the byte decoding bridge; it says nothing about sampler
loop order or rejection behavior. -/
theorem decodedArray_word_toNat (b : Array U8 32#usize) (j : Fin 8) :
    (UInt32.ofNat ((core.num.U32.from_le_bytes
      (four b (4 * j.val) (by omega))).val)).toNat =
      AspisV8R19.SamplerWords.word
        (AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.decodeState b) j := by
  have hsource := AspisV8R19.SamplerWordBridge.source_word
    (AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.decodeState b) j
  rw [AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.array_roundtrip b] at hsource
  rw [hsource, UInt32.toNat_ofNat']
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (AspisV8R19.SamplerWords.word_bound _ _)

#print axioms decodedArray_word_toNat

end AspisR1.SamplerByteWord

import R1LiteralOpeningFunctionalFacts

/-! Prefix projections exposed by a successful common opening-view read.
These are deterministic list facts only. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.LiteralOpeningPrefixFacts

open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript
open AspisR1.LiteralOpeningView

theorem read_prefix_components
    (rs : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (v : LiteralOpeningView.View)
    (hread : LiteralOpeningView.read rs = some v) :
    (rs.take 25).length = 25 ∧
    LiteralTranscript.c1At (rs.take 25) = some v.c1 ∧
    LiteralTranscript.c2At (rs.take 25) = some v.c2 ∧
    LiteralSemanticPrefix.read LiteralOpeningView.eK 0 (rs.take 25) = some v.semantic ∧
    v.word = LiteralTypedWords.word ExactBaseProjection.embed
      LiteralOpeningView.eK v.c1 v.c2 := by
  obtain ⟨hc1, hc2, hsemantic, hword⟩ :=
    LiteralOpeningFunctionalFacts.read_semantic_components rs v hread
  have hreadLength := LiteralSemanticPrefix.read_length
    LiteralOpeningView.eK 0 (rs.take 25) v.semantic hsemantic
  have hprefixLength : (rs.take 25).length = 25 := by
    rw [v.semantic_length] at hreadLength
    exact hreadLength.symm
  have htakeDrop : rs.take 25 ++ rs.drop 25 = rs :=
    List.take_append_drop 25 rs
  have htakePositive : 0 < (rs.take 25).length := by omega
  have hc1Append := LiteralTranscript.c1At_append
    (rs.take 25) (rs.drop 25) htakePositive
  have hc1Prefix : LiteralTranscript.c1At (rs.take 25) = some v.c1 := by
    rw [htakeDrop] at hc1Append
    exact hc1Append.symm.trans hc1
  have htakeC2 : 2 < (rs.take 25).length := by omega
  have hc2Append := LiteralTranscript.c2At_append
    (rs.take 25) (rs.drop 25) htakeC2
  have hc2Prefix : LiteralTranscript.c2At (rs.take 25) = some v.c2 := by
    rw [htakeDrop] at hc2Append
    exact hc2Append.symm.trans hc2
  exact ⟨hprefixLength, hc1Prefix, hc2Prefix, hsemantic, hword⟩

#print axioms read_prefix_components

end AspisR1.LiteralOpeningPrefixFacts
end

R1CanonicalCutWordProjection.text:
import R1CanonicalCutOpening
import R1CanonicalCutTypedProjection
import R1LiteralTypedWords
import R1ExactLeafFieldCodec
import R1TypedRecoveryStability
import R1FoldedRecoveredWord
import R1CanonicalTypedOpening
import R1MerkleIndexGeometry

/-! Construct the typed literal word from the three commitment-time packed
maps, then project strict opening payloads through it. The decode facts below
are exactly outputs of `CanonicalCutOpening` at each corresponding cut. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.CanonicalCutWordProjection

open AspisR1.TypedRecoveredWords
open AspisR1.CanonicalTypedOpening
open AspisR1.TypedRecoveryStability
open AspisR1.FoldedRecoveredWord
open AspisR1.MerkleIndexGeometry
open AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec
open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7

abbrev Byte := AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte

variable {L : Nat}

/-- Commitment-cut C1 and C2 maps are the packed maps used by the typed
recovery projection. -/
def c1Map (represented : List (FS2.Duplex.Addr L × AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep.State))
    (root : AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep.State) : Fin 262144 → Option (List Byte) :=
  TypedRecoveryStability.c1PackedAt represented CanonicalTypedOpening.paths6C1C2 root

def c2Map (represented : List (FS2.Duplex.Addr L × AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep.State))
    (root : AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep.State) : Fin 262144 → Option (List Byte) :=
  TypedRecoveryStability.c2PackedAt represented CanonicalTypedOpening.paths6C1C2 root

def foldedMap (represented : List (FS2.Duplex.Addr L × AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep.State))
    (root : AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep.State) : Fin 65536 → Option (List Byte) :=
  fun leaf => FoldedRecoveredWord.packedAt represented root leaf

/-- At every queried position, the word defined by commitment-cut C1/C2 maps
has the exact C1/C2 slot values of the strict opening payloads; the folded
commitment map yields the corresponding folded slot. The three decode
premises are the conclusions of the checked C1, C2 and folded cut theorems. -/
theorem commitment_cut_word_projects_opening_at
    {E : Type} [Field E]
    (eM : M31Exact →+* E) (eK : QM31Exact →+* E)
    (representedC1 representedC2 representedFolded :
      List (FS2.Duplex.Addr L × AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep.State))
    (rootC1 rootC2 rootFolded : AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep.State)
    (q : Fin 262144)
    (c1 : AspisR1.TypedRecoveredWords.C1)
    (c2 : AspisR1.TypedRecoveredWords.C2)
    (folded : AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.Folded)
    (hc1 : TypedRecoveredWords.decodeC1At (c1Map representedC1 rootC1)
      (queryLeaf (CanonicalCutTypedProjection.queryPosition q)) = some c1)
    (hc2 : TypedRecoveredWords.decodeC2At (c2Map representedC2 rootC2)
      (queryLeaf (CanonicalCutTypedProjection.queryPosition q)) = some c2)
    (hfolded : (foldedMap representedFolded rootFolded (foldedIndex q)).bind
      AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.decodeFolded = some folded) :
    (∀ l : Fin 26,
      LiteralTypedWords.word eM eK (TypedRecoveredWords.c1Value (c1Map representedC1 rootC1))
        (TypedRecoveredWords.c2Value (c2Map representedC2 rootC2))
        ⟨l.val, by have hl := l.isLt; omega⟩
        (CanonicalCutTypedProjection.queryPosition q) =
          eM ((c1 (TypedRecoveredWords.querySlot
            (CanonicalCutTypedProjection.queryPosition q))).1 l)) ∧
    LiteralTypedWords.word eM eK (TypedRecoveredWords.c1Value (c1Map representedC1 rootC1))
      (TypedRecoveredWords.c2Value (c2Map representedC2 rootC2)) ⟨26, by decide⟩
      (CanonicalCutTypedProjection.queryPosition q) =
        eK ((c2 (TypedRecoveredWords.querySlot
          (CanonicalCutTypedProjection.queryPosition q))) ⟨0, by decide⟩) ∧
    LiteralTypedWords.word eM eK (TypedRecoveredWords.c1Value (c1Map representedC1 rootC1))
      (TypedRecoveredWords.c2Value (c2Map representedC2 rootC2)) ⟨27, by decide⟩
      (CanonicalCutTypedProjection.queryPosition q) =
        eK ((c2 (TypedRecoveredWords.querySlot
          (CanonicalCutTypedProjection.queryPosition q))) ⟨1, by decide⟩) ∧
    LiteralTypedWords.word eM eK (TypedRecoveredWords.c1Value (c1Map representedC1 rootC1))
      (TypedRecoveredWords.c2Value (c2Map representedC2 rootC2)) ⟨28, by decide⟩
      (CanonicalCutTypedProjection.queryPosition q) =
        eK ((c1 (TypedRecoveredWords.querySlot
          (CanonicalCutTypedProjection.queryPosition q))).2) ∧
    FoldedRecoveredWord.wordOfPacked (foldedMap representedFolded rootFolded (foldedIndex q)) q =
      folded (FoldedRecoveredWord.foldedSlot q) := by
  exact CanonicalCutTypedProjection.literal_word_from_cut_payloads_at
    eM eK (c1Map representedC1 rootC1) (c2Map representedC2 rootC2)
    (foldedMap representedFolded rootFolded) q c1 c2 folded hc1 hc2 hfolded

#print axioms commitment_cut_word_projects_opening_at

end AspisR1.CanonicalCutWordProjection

R1CanonicalCutOpening.text:
import R1CanonicalTypedOpening
import R1TypedRecoveryStability
import R1LaterTableStability
import R1MerkleIndexGeometry
import R1CommitmentRootFrames
import R1MixedLeafDecoder

/-! Move accepted strict Merkle openings back to the typed packed map at the
first-read commitment cut. Each theorem keeps the concrete read, table,
consistency, length and bad-event premises of the established recovery paths.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.CanonicalCutOpening

open FS FS2.Duplex
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw
open AspisV8PairedCommitment
open AspisR1.CanonicalTypedOpening
open AspisR1.TypedRecoveryStability
open AspisR1.FoldedRecoveredWord
open AspisR1.MerkleIndexGeometry
open AspisR1.MixedLeafDecoder
open AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec
open AspisR1.CanonicalFullTraceRecovery
open AspisR1.CanonicalByteHash
open AspisR1.MixedLeafEncoding
open Merkle32Path Merkle32Leaf MerkleTable MerkleLeafRecovery MerkleRecordedLog

variable {M Cv : Type} {L : Nat}

private def paths6Folded : Fin 65536 → List (Fin 8) :=
  fun leaf => MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val

theorem c1_cut_decode_matches_opening
    (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat)
    (H : Addr L → State) (tr represented : List (Addr L × State))
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈ tr, q.2 = H q.1)
    (hrepresented : ∀ q ∈ represented, q.2 = H q.1)
    (pubBytes : Bytes) (hframe : 75 + pubBytes.length ≤ L)
    (initRoot : State) (hsize : 514 ≤ L) (hnode : 257 ≤ L)
    (hcutRead : Read tr (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe initRoot))
    (hcutTable : TraceTable.replay (emptyTable : Table (Addr L) State) represented =
      tableBefore emptyTable tr (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe initRoot))
    (packed salt : List AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte) (hw : packed.length = 480) (hs : salt.length = 32)
    (leaf : Fin 262144)
    (path : Path (MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val))
    (haccept : (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (AspisR1.Merkle32Leaf.leafInput 0x71 packed salt))).2 = initRoot)
    (hopen : ∀ a, Read (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (AspisR1.Merkle32Leaf.leafInput 0x71 packed salt))).1 a → Read (tr) a)
    (hQ : firstReads emptyTable tr ≤ Qtot)
    (hnoColl : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable tr)
    (hnoChild : ¬ hitsBad
      (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad MerkleChildTargets.pred Qtot) emptyTable tr)
    (hnoRoot : ¬ hitsBad
      (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad CommitmentRootTargets.pred Qtot) emptyTable tr)
    (payload : AspisR1.TypedRecoveredWords.C1) (hdecode : decodeC1 packed = some payload) :
    AspisR1.TypedRecoveredWords.decodeC1At (c1PackedAt represented AspisR1.CanonicalTypedOpening.paths6C1C2 initRoot) leaf = some payload := by
  have hstable := c1_packed_stable p Qtot H tr represented pubBytes hframe initRoot
    hsize hnode hcons hQ hnoColl hnoChild hnoRoot hrepresented hcutRead hcutTable
    AspisR1.CanonicalTypedOpening.paths6C1C2
  rw [hstable]
  have hcons' : ∀ q ∈ tr ++ [], q.2 = H q.1 := by simpa using hcons
  simpa [List.append_nil, AspisR1.CanonicalTypedOpening.paths6C1C2] using
    (c1_decode_of_no_events p Qtot H tr [] hcons' pubBytes hframe hsize hnode
      packed salt hw hs leaf path initRoot hcutRead haccept
      (by simpa using hopen) (by simpa using hQ) (by simpa using hnoColl) (by simpa using hnoChild)
      (by simpa using hnoRoot) payload hdecode)

#print axioms c1_cut_decode_matches_opening

theorem c2_cut_decode_matches_opening
    (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat)
    (H : Addr L → State) (tr represented : List (Addr L × State))
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈ tr, q.2 = H q.1)
    (hrepresented : ∀ q ∈ represented, q.2 = H q.1)
    (state : State) (hframe : 71 ≤ L) (c2Root : State)
    (hsize : 162 ≤ L) (hnode : 257 ≤ L)
    (hcutRead : Read tr (CommitmentRootFrames.c2Addr state c2Root hframe))
    (hcutTable : TraceTable.replay (emptyTable : Table (Addr L) State) represented =
      tableBefore emptyTable tr (CommitmentRootFrames.c2Addr state c2Root hframe))
    (packed salt : List AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte) (hw : packed.length = 128) (hs : salt.length = 32)
    (leaf : Fin 262144)
    (path : Path (MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val))
    (haccept : (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (AspisR1.Merkle32Leaf.leafInput 0xf1 packed salt))).2 = c2Root)
    (hopen : ∀ a, Read (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (AspisR1.Merkle32Leaf.leafInput 0xf1 packed salt))).1 a → Read tr a)
    (hQ : firstReads emptyTable tr ≤ Qtot)
    (hnoColl : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable tr)
    (hnoChild : ¬ hitsBad
      (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad MerkleChildTargets.pred Qtot) emptyTable tr)
    (hnoRoot : ¬ hitsBad
      (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad CommitmentRootTargets.pred Qtot) emptyTable tr)
    (payload : AspisR1.TypedRecoveredWords.C2) (hdecode : decodeC2 packed = some payload) :
    AspisR1.TypedRecoveredWords.decodeC2At (c2PackedAt represented AspisR1.CanonicalTypedOpening.paths6C1C2 c2Root) leaf = some payload := by
  have hstable := c2_packed_stable p Qtot H tr represented state hframe c2Root
    hsize hnode hcons hrepresented hcutRead hQ hnoColl hnoChild hnoRoot hcutTable
    AspisR1.CanonicalTypedOpening.paths6C1C2
  rw [hstable]
  have hcons' : ∀ q ∈ tr ++ [], q.2 = H q.1 := by simpa using hcons
  simpa [List.append_nil, AspisR1.CanonicalTypedOpening.paths6C1C2] using
    (c2_decode_of_no_events p Qtot H tr [] hcons' state hframe hsize hnode
      packed salt hw hs leaf path c2Root hcutRead haccept
      (by simpa using hopen) (by simpa using hQ) (by simpa using hnoColl) (by simpa using hnoChild)
      (by simpa using hnoRoot) payload hdecode)

#print axioms c2_cut_decode_matches_opening

theorem folded_cut_decode_matches_opening
    (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat)
    (H : Addr L → State) (tr represented : List (Addr L × State))
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈ tr, q.2 = H q.1)
    (hrepresented : ∀ q ∈ represented, q.2 = H q.1)
    (state : State) (tail : Bytes) (htail : tail.length = 224)
    (hframe : 294 ≤ L) (foldedRoot : State)
    (hsize : 162 ≤ L) (hnode : 257 ≤ L)
    (hcutRead : Read tr (CommitmentRootFrames.foldedAddr state foldedRoot tail htail hframe))
    (hcutTable : TraceTable.replay (emptyTable : Table (Addr L) State) represented =
      tableBefore emptyTable tr
        (CommitmentRootFrames.foldedAddr state foldedRoot tail htail hframe))
    (packed salt : List AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte) (hw : packed.length = 128) (hs : salt.length = 32)
    (leaf : Fin 65536)
    (path : Path (MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val))
    (haccept : (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (AspisR1.Merkle32Leaf.leafInput 0x72 packed salt))).2 = foldedRoot)
    (hopen : ∀ a, Read (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (AspisR1.Merkle32Leaf.leafInput 0x72 packed salt))).1 a → Read tr a)
    (hQ : firstReads emptyTable tr ≤ Qtot)
    (hnoColl : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable tr)
    (hnoChild : ¬ hitsBad
      (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad MerkleChildTargets.pred Qtot) emptyTable tr)
    (hnoRoot : ¬ hitsBad
      (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad CommitmentRootTargets.pred Qtot) emptyTable tr)
    (payload : AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.Folded) (hdecode : AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.decodeFolded packed = some payload) :
    (FoldedRecoveredWord.packedAt represented foldedRoot leaf).bind AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.decodeFolded =
      some payload := by
  have hstable := AspisR1.LaterTableStability.folded_table_word_of_read p Qtot H tr represented
    state tail htail hframe foldedRoot hsize hnode hcons hrepresented hcutRead hQ
    hnoColl hnoChild hnoRoot hcutTable
  have hpackedStable :
      FoldedRecoveredWord.packedAt represented foldedRoot leaf =
        FoldedRecoveredWord.packedAt tr foldedRoot leaf := by
    unfold FoldedRecoveredWord.packedAt
    exact congrArg (fun f : List (Fin 8) → Option (List AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte × List AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte) =>
      (f (MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val)).map Prod.fst) hstable
  rw [hpackedStable]
  have hcons' : ∀ q ∈ tr ++ [], q.2 = H q.1 := by simpa using hcons
  simpa [List.append_nil] using
    (folded_decode_of_no_events p Qtot H tr [] hcons' state tail htail hframe
      hsize hnode packed salt hw hs leaf path foldedRoot hcutRead haccept
      (by simpa using hopen) (by simpa using hQ) (by simpa using hnoColl) (by simpa using hnoChild)
      (by simpa using hnoRoot) payload hdecode)

#print axioms folded_cut_decode_matches_opening

end AspisR1.CanonicalCutOpening
