R1CanonicalTypedOpening.text:
import R1ThreeCommitmentFullTrace
import R1TypedRecoveryStability
import R1FoldedRecoveredWord
import R1MixedLeafDecoder

/-! Strictly decode accepted C1, C2, and folded leaves after composing the
existing no-event recovery theorem with its later-of-earlier extension. The
six-level path specialization is a representation choice, not a Rust/source
refinement theorem. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.CanonicalTypedOpening

open FS FS2.Duplex
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw
open AspisV8PairedCommitment
open Merkle32Path Merkle32Leaf MerkleTable MerkleLeafRecovery MerkleRecordedLog
open AspisR1.CanonicalRecoveryStability
open AspisR1.ThreeCommitmentFullTrace
open AspisR1.TypedRecoveryStability
open AspisR1.TypedRecoveredWords
open AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec
open AspisR1.FoldedRecoveredWord
open AspisR1.MerkleIndexGeometry
open AspisR1.MixedLeafDecoder
open AspisR1.CanonicalByteHash
open AspisR1.CanonicalFullTraceRecovery

variable {M Cv : Type} {L : Nat}

def paths6C1C2 : Fin 262144 → List (Fin 8) :=
  fun leaf => MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val

def paths6Folded : Fin 65536 → List (Fin 8) :=
  fun leaf => MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val

theorem c1_decode_of_no_events (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat)
    (H : Addr L → State) (pre post : List (Addr L × State))
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈ pre ++ post, q.2 = H q.1)
    (pubBytes : Bytes) (hframe : 75 + pubBytes.length ≤ L)
    (hsize : 514 ≤ L) (hnode : 257 ≤ L)
    (packed salt : List AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte)
    (hw : packed.length = 480) (hs : salt.length = 32)
    (leaf : Fin 262144)
    (path : Path (MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val)) (root : State)
    (hcommit : Read pre (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root))
    (haccept : (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (leafInput 0x71 packed salt))).2 = root)
    (hopen : ∀ a, Read (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (leafInput 0x71 packed salt))).1 a → Read (pre ++ post) a)
    (hQ : firstReads emptyTable (pre ++ post) ≤ Qtot)
    (hnoColl : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable (pre ++ post))
    (hnoChild : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad MerkleChildTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable (pre ++ post))
    (hnoRoot : ¬ hitsBad
      (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad CommitmentRootTargets.pred Qtot) emptyTable
      (pre ++ post))
    (payload : C1) (hdecode : decodeC1 packed = some payload) :
    decodeC1At (c1PackedAt (pre ++ post) paths6C1C2 root) leaf = some payload := by
  have hbefore : recoverAt 0x71 480 pre
      (MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val) root = some (packed, salt) := by
    exact ThreeCommitmentFullTrace.c1_recover_of_no_events p Qtot H pre post hcons
      pubBytes hframe hsize hnode packed salt hw hs path root hcommit haccept hopen
      hQ hnoColl hnoChild hnoRoot
  have hfull := CanonicalRecoveryStability.later_of_earlier 0x71 480 pre post
    (MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val) root (packed, salt) hbefore
  have hpacked : c1PackedAt (pre ++ post) paths6C1C2 root leaf = some packed := by
    simp [c1PackedAt, TypedRecoveryStability.packedAt, paths6C1C2, hfull]
  simp [decodeC1At, hpacked, hdecode]

#print axioms c1_decode_of_no_events

theorem c2_decode_of_no_events (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat)
    (H : Addr L → State) (pre post : List (Addr L × State))
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈ pre ++ post, q.2 = H q.1)
    (state : State) (hframe : 71 ≤ L) (hsize : 162 ≤ L) (hnode : 257 ≤ L)
    (packed salt : List AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte)
    (hw : packed.length = 128) (hs : salt.length = 32)
    (leaf : Fin 262144)
    (path : Path (MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val)) (root : State)
    (hcommit : Read pre (CommitmentRootFrames.c2Addr state root hframe))
    (haccept : (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (leafInput 0xf1 packed salt))).2 = root)
    (hopen : ∀ a, Read (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (leafInput 0xf1 packed salt))).1 a → Read (pre ++ post) a)
    (hQ : firstReads emptyTable (pre ++ post) ≤ Qtot)
    (hnoColl : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable (pre ++ post))
    (hnoChild : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad MerkleChildTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable (pre ++ post))
    (hnoRoot : ¬ hitsBad
      (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad CommitmentRootTargets.pred Qtot) emptyTable
      (pre ++ post))
    (payload : C2) (hdecode : decodeC2 packed = some payload) :
    decodeC2At (c2PackedAt (pre ++ post) paths6C1C2 root) leaf = some payload := by
  have hbefore : recoverAt 0xf1 128 pre
      (MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val) root = some (packed, salt) := by
    exact ThreeCommitmentFullTrace.c2_recover_of_no_events p Qtot H pre post hcons
      state hframe hsize hnode packed salt hw hs path root hcommit haccept hopen
      hQ hnoColl hnoChild hnoRoot
  have hfull := CanonicalRecoveryStability.later_of_earlier 0xf1 128 pre post
    (MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val) root (packed, salt) hbefore
  have hpacked : c2PackedAt (pre ++ post) paths6C1C2 root leaf = some packed := by
    simp [c2PackedAt, TypedRecoveryStability.packedAt, paths6C1C2, hfull]
  simp [decodeC2At, hpacked, hdecode]

#print axioms c2_decode_of_no_events

theorem folded_decode_of_no_events (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat)
    (H : Addr L → State) (pre post : List (Addr L × State))
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈ pre ++ post, q.2 = H q.1)
    (state : State) (tail : Bytes) (htail : tail.length = 224)
    (hframe : 294 ≤ L) (hsize : 162 ≤ L) (hnode : 257 ≤ L)
    (packed salt : List AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte)
    (hw : packed.length = 128) (hs : salt.length = 32)
    (leaf : Fin 65536)
    (path : Path (MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val)) (root : State)
    (hcommit : Read pre
      (CommitmentRootFrames.foldedAddr state root tail htail hframe))
    (haccept : (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (leafInput 0x72 packed salt))).2 = root)
    (hopen : ∀ a, Read (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (leafInput 0x72 packed salt))).1 a → Read (pre ++ post) a)
    (hQ : firstReads emptyTable (pre ++ post) ≤ Qtot)
    (hnoColl : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable (pre ++ post))
    (hnoChild : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad MerkleChildTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable (pre ++ post))
    (hnoRoot : ¬ hitsBad
      (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad CommitmentRootTargets.pred Qtot) emptyTable
      (pre ++ post))
    (payload : AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.Folded)
    (hdecode : decodeFolded packed = some payload) :
    (FoldedRecoveredWord.packedAt (pre ++ post) root leaf).bind decodeFolded =
      some payload := by
  have hbefore : recoverAt 0x72 128 pre
      (MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val) root = some (packed, salt) := by
    exact ThreeCommitmentFullTrace.folded_recover_of_no_events p Qtot H pre post hcons
      state tail htail hframe hsize hnode packed salt hw hs path root hcommit haccept
      hopen hQ hnoColl hnoChild hnoRoot
  have hfull := CanonicalRecoveryStability.later_of_earlier 0x72 128 pre post
    (MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val) root (packed, salt) hbefore
  have hpacked : FoldedRecoveredWord.packedAt (pre ++ post) root leaf = some packed := by
    simp [FoldedRecoveredWord.packedAt, hfull]
  simp [hpacked, hdecode]

#print axioms folded_decode_of_no_events

theorem folded_word_of_no_events (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat)
    (H : Addr L → State) (pre post : List (Addr L × State))
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈ pre ++ post, q.2 = H q.1)
    (state : State) (tail : Bytes) (htail : tail.length = 224)
    (hframe : 294 ≤ L) (hsize : 162 ≤ L) (hnode : 257 ≤ L)
    (packed salt : List AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte)
    (hw : packed.length = 128) (hs : salt.length = 32)
    (leaf : Fin 65536)
    (path : Path (MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val)) (root : State)
    (hcommit : Read pre
      (CommitmentRootFrames.foldedAddr state root tail htail hframe))
    (haccept : (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (leafInput 0x72 packed salt))).2 = root)
    (hopen : ∀ a, Read (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (leafInput 0x72 packed salt))).1 a → Read (pre ++ post) a)
    (hQ : firstReads emptyTable (pre ++ post) ≤ Qtot)
    (hnoColl : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable (pre ++ post))
    (hnoChild : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad MerkleChildTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable (pre ++ post))
    (hnoRoot : ¬ hitsBad
      (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad CommitmentRootTargets.pred Qtot) emptyTable
      (pre ++ post))
    (payload : AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.Folded)
    (hdecode : decodeFolded packed = some payload)
    (i : Fin 262144) (hindex : foldedIndex i = leaf) :
    FoldedRecoveredWord.wordAt (pre ++ post) root i = payload (foldedSlot i) := by
  have hpacked : FoldedRecoveredWord.packedAt (pre ++ post) root leaf = some packed := by
    have hbefore : recoverAt 0x72 128 pre
        (MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val) root = some (packed, salt) := by

        state tail htail hframe hsize hnode packed salt hw hs path root hcommit haccept

    have hfull := CanonicalRecoveryStability.later_of_earlier 0x72 128 pre post
      (MerkleIndexGeometry.slots 6 leaf.val) root (packed, salt) hbefore
    simp [FoldedRecoveredWord.packedAt, hfull]
  unfold FoldedRecoveredWord.wordAt
  rw [hindex]
  exact wordOfPacked_success _ packed payload i hpacked hdecode

import R1CanonicalFullTraceRecovery
import R1CommitmentRootFrames

/-! C1, C2, and folded-root specializations of recovery over an arbitrary
consistent actual trace containing the prior and opening-program reads. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ThreeCommitmentFullTrace

open FS FS2.Duplex
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw
open Merkle32Path Merkle32Leaf MerkleTable MerkleLeafRecovery MerkleRecordedLog

variable {M Cv : Type} {L : Nat}

theorem c1_recover_of_no_events (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat)
    (H : Addr L → State) (pre post : List (Addr L × State))
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈ pre ++ post, q.2 = H q.1)
    (pubBytes : Bytes) (hframe : 75 + pubBytes.length ≤ L)
    (hsize : 514 ≤ L) (hnode : 257 ≤ L)
    (packed salt : Bytes) (hw : packed.length = 480) (hs : salt.length = 32)
    {slots : List (Fin 8)} (path : Path slots) (root : State)
    (hcommit : Read pre (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root))
    (haccept : (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (leafInput 0x71 packed salt))).2 = root)
    (hopen : ∀ a, Read (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (leafInput 0x71 packed salt))).1 a → Read (pre ++ post) a)
    (hQ : firstReads emptyTable (pre ++ post) ≤ Qtot)
    (hnoColl : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable (pre ++ post))
    (hnoChild : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad MerkleChildTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable (pre ++ post))
    (hnoRoot : ¬ hitsBad
      (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad CommitmentRootTargets.pred Qtot) emptyTable
      (pre ++ post)) :
    recover (nodes (CanonicalOracleLog.byteLog pre))
        (leaves 0x71 480 (CanonicalOracleLog.byteLog pre)) slots root =
        some (packed, salt) := by
  have hleaf : (leafInput 0x71 packed salt).length ≤ L := by
    rw [Merkle32Leaf.leaf_input_length 0x71 packed salt hs, hw]
    exact hsize
  exact CanonicalFullTraceRecovery.recover_of_no_events p Qtot H pre post hcons
    0x71 480 packed salt hw hs hleaf hnode path root CommitmentRootTargets.pred
    (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root) 0 hcommit
    (CommitmentRootFrames.pred_c1 pubBytes hframe root) haccept hopen hQ
    hnoColl hnoChild hnoRoot

theorem c2_recover_of_no_events (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat)
    (H : Addr L → State) (pre post : List (Addr L × State))
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈ pre ++ post, q.2 = H q.1)
    (state : State) (hframe : 71 ≤ L) (hsize : 162 ≤ L) (hnode : 257 ≤ L)
    (packed salt : Bytes) (hw : packed.length = 128) (hs : salt.length = 32)
    {slots : List (Fin 8)} (path : Path slots) (root : State)
    (hcommit : Read pre (CommitmentRootFrames.c2Addr state root hframe))
    (haccept : (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (leafInput 0xf1 packed salt))).2 = root)
    (hopen : ∀ a, Read (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (leafInput 0xf1 packed salt))).1 a → Read (pre ++ post) a)
    (hQ : firstReads emptyTable (pre ++ post) ≤ Qtot)
    (hnoColl : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable (pre ++ post))
    (hnoChild : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad MerkleChildTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable (pre ++ post))
    (hnoRoot : ¬ hitsBad
      (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad CommitmentRootTargets.pred Qtot) emptyTable
      (pre ++ post)) :
    recover (nodes (CanonicalOracleLog.byteLog pre))
        (leaves 0xf1 128 (CanonicalOracleLog.byteLog pre)) slots root =
        some (packed, salt) := by
  have hleaf : (leafInput 0xf1 packed salt).length ≤ L := by
    rw [Merkle32Leaf.leaf_input_length 0xf1 packed salt hs, hw]
    exact hsize
  exact CanonicalFullTraceRecovery.recover_of_no_events p Qtot H pre post hcons
    0xf1 128 packed salt hw hs hleaf hnode path root CommitmentRootTargets.pred
    (CommitmentRootFrames.c2Addr state root hframe) 0 hcommit
    (CommitmentRootFrames.pred_c2 state root hframe) haccept hopen hQ
    hnoColl hnoChild hnoRoot

theorem folded_recover_of_no_events (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat)
    (H : Addr L → State) (pre post : List (Addr L × State))
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈ pre ++ post, q.2 = H q.1)
    (state : State) (tail : Bytes) (htail : tail.length = 224)
    (hframe : 294 ≤ L) (hsize : 162 ≤ L) (hnode : 257 ≤ L)
    (packed salt : Bytes) (hw : packed.length = 128) (hs : salt.length = 32)
    {slots : List (Fin 8)} (path : Path slots) (root : State)
    (hcommit : Read pre
      (CommitmentRootFrames.foldedAddr state root tail htail hframe))
    (haccept : (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (leafInput 0x72 packed salt))).2 = root)
    (hopen : ∀ a, Read (eval H (CanonicalMerkleProgram.program path
      (leafInput 0x72 packed salt))).1 a → Read (pre ++ post) a)
    (hQ : firstReads emptyTable (pre ++ post) ≤ Qtot)
    (hnoColl : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable (pre ++ post))
    (hnoChild : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad MerkleChildTargets.pred Qtot)

    (hnoRoot : ¬ hitsBad
      (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad CommitmentRootTargets.pred Qtot) emptyTable
      (pre ++ post)) :
    recover (nodes (CanonicalOracleLog.byteLog pre))
        (leaves 0x72 128 (CanonicalOracleLog.byteLog pre)) slots root =
        some (packed, salt) := by
  have hleaf : (leafInput 0x72 packed salt).length ≤ L := by
    rw [Merkle32Leaf.leaf_input_length 0x72 packed salt hs, hw]
    exact hsize
  exact CanonicalFullTraceRecovery.recover_of_no_events p Qtot H pre post hcons
    0x72 128 packed salt hw hs hleaf hnode path root CommitmentRootTargets.pred
    (CommitmentRootFrames.foldedAddr state root tail htail hframe) 1 hcommit
    (CommitmentRootFrames.pred_folded state root tail htail hframe) haccept hopen hQ
    hnoColl hnoChild hnoRoot

#print axioms c1_recover_of_no_events
#print axioms c2_recover_of_no_events
#print axioms folded_recover_of_no_events

import R1C1TableStability
import R1LaterTableStability
import R1TypedRecoveredWords

/-! Compose the existing first-read table stability results with the total
typed-word projection.  Paths are supplied by the caller; no geometry or
source correspondence is asserted here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.TypedRecoveryStability

open FS FS2.Duplex
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw
open AspisV8PairedCommitment
open AspisR1.CanonicalRecoveryStability
open AspisR1.TypedRecoveredWords

variable {M Cv : Type} {L : Nat}

def packedAt (tag : AspisR1.Merkle32Path.Byte) (width : Nat)
    (tr : List (Addr L × State)) (slots : List (Fin 8)) (root : State) :
    Option (List AspisR1.Merkle32Path.Byte) :=
  (recoverAt tag width tr slots root).map Prod.fst

def c1PackedAt (tr : List (Addr L × State))
    (paths : Fin 262144 → List (Fin 8)) (root : State) :
    Fin 262144 → Option (List AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte) :=
  fun leaf => packedAt 0x71 480 tr (paths leaf) root

def c2PackedAt (tr : List (Addr L × State))
    (paths : Fin 262144 → List (Fin 8)) (root : State) :
    Fin 262144 → Option (List AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte) :=
  fun leaf => packedAt 0xf1 128 tr (paths leaf) root

theorem c1_packed_stable (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat)
    (H : Addr L → State) (tr represented : List (Addr L × State))
    (pubBytes : Bytes) (hframe : 75 + pubBytes.length ≤ L)
    (root : State) (hsize : 514 ≤ L) (hnode : 257 ≤ L)
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈ tr, q.2 = H q.1)
    (hQ : firstReads emptyTable tr ≤ Qtot)
    (hnoColl : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable tr)
    (hnoChild : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad MerkleChildTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable tr)
    (hnoRoot : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad CommitmentRootTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable tr)
    (hrepresented : ∀ q ∈ represented, q.2 = H q.1)
    (hread : Read tr (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root))
    (htable : TraceTable.replay emptyTable represented =
      tableBefore emptyTable tr (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root))
    (paths : Fin 262144 → List (Fin 8)) :
    c1PackedAt represented paths root = c1PackedAt tr paths root := by
  funext leaf
  unfold c1PackedAt packedAt
  exact congrArg (fun o => o.map Prod.fst)
    (congrFun (C1TableStability.c1_table_word_of_read p Qtot H tr represented
      pubBytes hframe root hsize hnode hcons hQ hnoColl hnoChild hnoRoot
      hrepresented hread htable) (paths leaf))

theorem c2_packed_stable (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat)
    (H : Addr L → State) (tr represented : List (Addr L × State))
    (state : State) (hframe : 71 ≤ L) (root : State)
    (hsize : 162 ≤ L) (hnode : 257 ≤ L)
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈ tr, q.2 = H q.1)
    (hrepresented : ∀ q ∈ represented, q.2 = H q.1)
    (hread : Read tr (CommitmentRootFrames.c2Addr state root hframe))
    (hQ : firstReads emptyTable tr ≤ Qtot)
    (hnoColl : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable tr)
    (hnoChild : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad MerkleChildTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable tr)
    (hnoRoot : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad CommitmentRootTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable tr)
    (htable : TraceTable.replay (emptyTable : Table (Addr L) State) represented =
      tableBefore emptyTable tr (CommitmentRootFrames.c2Addr state root hframe))
    (paths : Fin 262144 → List (Fin 8)) :
    c2PackedAt represented paths root = c2PackedAt tr paths root := by
  funext leaf
  unfold c2PackedAt packedAt
  exact congrArg (fun o => o.map Prod.fst)
    (congrFun (LaterTableStability.c2_table_word_of_read p Qtot H tr represented
      state hframe root hsize hnode hcons hrepresented hread hQ hnoColl hnoChild hnoRoot htable)
      (paths leaf))

theorem typed_word_stable {E : Type} [Field E] (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat)
    (H : Addr L → State) (tr representedC1 representedC2 : List (Addr L × State))
    (pubBytes : Bytes) (hinitFrame : 75 + pubBytes.length ≤ L)
    (initRoot : State) (hinitSize : 514 ≤ L)
    (c2State : State) (hc2Frame : 71 ≤ L) (c2Root : State) (hc2Size : 162 ≤ L)
    (hnode : 257 ≤ L)
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈ tr, q.2 = H q.1)
    (hQ : firstReads emptyTable tr ≤ Qtot)
    (hnoColl : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable tr)
    (hnoChild : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad MerkleChildTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable tr)
    (hnoRoot : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad CommitmentRootTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable tr)
    (hrepresentedC1 : ∀ q ∈ representedC1, q.2 = H q.1)
    (hrepresentedC2 : ∀ q ∈ representedC2, q.2 = H q.1)
    (hinitRead : Read tr (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hinitFrame initRoot))
    (hc2Read : Read tr (CommitmentRootFrames.c2Addr c2State c2Root hc2Frame))
    (hinitTable : TraceTable.replay emptyTable representedC1 =
      tableBefore emptyTable tr (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hinitFrame initRoot))
    (hc2Table : TraceTable.replay (emptyTable : Table (Addr L) State) representedC2 =
      tableBefore emptyTable tr (CommitmentRootFrames.c2Addr c2State c2Root hc2Frame))
    (paths : Fin 262144 → List (Fin 8))
    (eM : AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.M31Exact →+* E)
    (eK : AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.QM31Exact →+* E) :
    TypedRecoveredWords.word eM eK
      (c1PackedAt representedC1 paths initRoot) (c2PackedAt representedC2 paths c2Root) =
    TypedRecoveredWords.word eM eK
      (c1PackedAt tr paths initRoot) (c2PackedAt tr paths c2Root) := by
  rw [c1_packed_stable p Qtot H tr representedC1 pubBytes hinitFrame initRoot
    hinitSize hnode hcons hQ hnoColl hnoChild hnoRoot hrepresentedC1 hinitRead hinitTable paths]
  rw [c2_packed_stable p Qtot H tr representedC2 c2State hc2Frame c2Root
    hc2Size hnode hcons hrepresentedC2 hc2Read hQ hnoColl hnoChild hnoRoot hc2Table paths]

theorem word_typed_full {E : Type} [Field E]
    (tr : List (Addr L × State)) (paths : Fin 262144 → List (Fin 8))
    (initRoot c2Root : State)
    (eM : AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.M31Exact →+* E)
    (eK : AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.QM31Exact →+* E) :
    AspisR1.CandidateDescent.WordTyped
      (TypedRecoveredWords.laneSubfield eM eK)
      (TypedRecoveredWords.word eM eK
        (c1PackedAt tr paths initRoot) (c2PackedAt tr paths c2Root)) :=
  TypedRecoveredWords.word_typed eM eK _ _

#print axioms c1_packed_stable
#print axioms c2_packed_stable
#print axioms typed_word_stable
#print axioms word_typed_full

end AspisR1.TypedRecoveryStability

R1C1TableStability.text:
import R1CanonicalTableRecovery
import R1C1BeforeFrameStability
import R1FirstReadCut

/-! C1 recovery can be compared through the finite table at the first
initialization-frame read. The table identity is an explicit premise here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.C1TableStability

open FS FS2.Duplex
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw
open AspisR1.CanonicalRecoveryStability

variable {M Cv : Type} {L : Nat}

theorem c1_table_word_stable (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat)
    (H : Addr L → State) (pre post represented : List (Addr L × State))
    (pubBytes : Bytes) (hframe : 75 + pubBytes.length ≤ L)
    (root answer : State) (hsize : 514 ≤ L) (hnode : 257 ≤ L)
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈
      (pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post,
      q.2 = H q.1)
    (hQ : firstReads emptyTable
      ((pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post) ≤ Qtot)
    (hnoColl : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable
      ((pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post))
    (hnoChild : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad MerkleChildTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable ((pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post))
    (hnoRoot : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad CommitmentRootTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable ((pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post))
    (hrepresented : ∀ q ∈ represented, q.2 = H q.1)
    (hfirst : PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root ∉ pre.map Prod.fst)
    (htable : TraceTable.replay emptyTable represented =
      tableBefore emptyTable
        ((pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post)
        (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root)) :
    (fun slots => recoverAt 0x71 480 represented slots root) =
      (fun slots => recoverAt 0x71 480
        ((pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post)
        slots root) := by
  have hconsCut : ∀ q ∈ pre ++ (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer) :: post,
      q.2 = H q.1 := by
    simpa [List.append_assoc] using hcons
  have hQCut : firstReads emptyTable
      (pre ++ (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer) :: post) ≤ Qtot := by
    simpa [List.append_assoc] using hQ
  have hnoCollCut : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable
      (pre ++ (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer) :: post) := by
    simpa [List.append_assoc] using hnoColl
  have htableCut : TraceTable.replay emptyTable represented =
      tableBefore emptyTable
        (pre ++ (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer) :: post)
        (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root) := by
    simpa [List.append_assoc] using htable
  have hcut := CanonicalTableRecovery.represented_before_cut p Qtot H
    pre post represented (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root) answer
    hfirst hconsCut hrepresented hQCut hnoCollCut htableCut 0x71 480
  have hpre : (fun slots => recoverAt 0x71 480 pre slots root) =
      (fun slots => recoverAt 0x71 480 represented slots root) := by
    funext slots
    exact hcut slots root
  calc
    (fun slots => recoverAt 0x71 480 represented slots root) =
        (fun slots => recoverAt 0x71 480 pre slots root) := hpre.symm
    _ = fun slots => recoverAt 0x71 480
        ((pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post)
        slots root :=
      C1BeforeFrameStability.c1_word_stable p Qtot H pre post pubBytes hframe
        root answer hsize hnode hcons hQ hnoColl hnoChild hnoRoot

theorem c1_table_word_of_read (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat)
    (H : Addr L → State) (tr represented : List (Addr L × State))
    (pubBytes : Bytes) (hframe : 75 + pubBytes.length ≤ L)
    (root : State) (hsize : 514 ≤ L) (hnode : 257 ≤ L)
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈ tr, q.2 = H q.1)
    (hQ : firstReads emptyTable tr ≤ Qtot)
    (hnoColl : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable tr)
    (hnoChild : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad MerkleChildTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable tr)
    (hnoRoot : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad CommitmentRootTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable tr)
    (hrepresented : ∀ q ∈ represented, q.2 = H q.1)
    (hread : Read tr (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root))
    (htable : TraceTable.replay emptyTable represented =
      tableBefore emptyTable tr (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root)) :
    (fun slots => recoverAt 0x71 480 represented slots root) =
      (fun slots => recoverAt 0x71 480 tr slots root) := by
  let frame := PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root
  obtain ⟨pre, answer, post, hrep, hfirst⟩ :=
    FirstReadCut.first_read_cut tr frame hread
  have hcons' : ∀ q ∈ (pre ++ [(frame, answer)]) ++ post, q.2 = H q.1 := by
    intro q hq
    apply hcons q
    simpa [hrep] using hq
  have hQ' : firstReads emptyTable ((pre ++ [ (frame, answer) ]) ++ post) ≤ Qtot := by
    simpa [hrep] using hQ
  have hnoColl' : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable
      ((pre ++ [ (frame, answer) ]) ++ post) := by
    simpa [hrep] using hnoColl
  have hnoChild' : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad MerkleChildTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable ((pre ++ [ (frame, answer) ]) ++ post) := by
    simpa [hrep] using hnoChild
  have hnoRoot' : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad CommitmentRootTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable ((pre ++ [ (frame, answer) ]) ++ post) := by
    simpa [hrep] using hnoRoot
  have htable' : TraceTable.replay emptyTable represented =
      tableBefore emptyTable ((pre ++ [(frame, answer)]) ++ post) frame := by
    simpa [hrep] using htable
  have hstable := c1_table_word_stable p Qtot H pre post represented pubBytes hframe
    root answer hsize hnode hcons' hQ' hnoColl' hnoChild' hnoRoot' hrepresented hfirst htable'
  simpa [hrep] using hstable

#print axioms c1_table_word_stable
#print axioms c1_table_word_of_read

end AspisR1.C1TableStability

R1C1BeforeFrameStability.text:
import R1CanonicalRecoveryStability
import R1InitialFrameNoMerkle
import R1CommitmentRootFrames

/-! C1 finite-table recovery is unchanged by appending the literal public
initialization frame before the arbitrary continuation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.C1BeforeFrameStability

open FS FS2.Duplex
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw
open Merkle32Path Merkle32Leaf MerkleTable MerkleLeafRecovery MerkleRecordedLog
open CanonicalByteHash

variable {M Cv : Type} {L : Nat}

theorem c1_recover_stable (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat)
    (H : Addr L → State) (pre post : List (Addr L × State))
    (pubBytes : Bytes) (hframe : 75 + pubBytes.length ≤ L)
    (root answer : State) (hsize : 514 ≤ L) (hnode : 257 ≤ L)
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈
      (pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post,
      q.2 = H q.1)
    (hQ : firstReads emptyTable
      ((pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post) ≤ Qtot)
    (hnoColl : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable
      ((pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post))
    (hnoChild : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad MerkleChildTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable ((pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post))
    (hnoRoot : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad CommitmentRootTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable ((pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post))
    (slots : List (Fin 8)) :
    CanonicalRecoveryStability.recoverAt 0x71 480 pre slots root =
      CanonicalRecoveryStability.recoverAt 0x71 480
        ((pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post)
        slots root := by
  let frame := PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root
  let midpre := pre ++ [(frame, answer)]
  have hcommit : Read midpre frame := by
    change frame ∈ midpre.map Prod.fst
    simp [midpre, frame, List.map_append]
  have hstable := CanonicalRecoveryStability.recover_stable p Qtot H midpre post
    hcons 0x71 480 hsize hnode slots root CommitmentRootTargets.pred frame 0
    hcommit (CommitmentRootFrames.pred_c1 pubBytes hframe root) hQ
    hnoColl hnoChild hnoRoot
  have hremove := InitialFrameNoMerkle.recover_unchanged 0x71 480 pre pubBytes
    hframe root answer slots root
  change CanonicalRecoveryStability.recoverAt 0x71 480 midpre slots root =
    CanonicalRecoveryStability.recoverAt 0x71 480 pre slots root at hremove
  calc
    CanonicalRecoveryStability.recoverAt 0x71 480 pre slots root =
        CanonicalRecoveryStability.recoverAt 0x71 480 midpre slots root := hremove.symm
    _ = CanonicalRecoveryStability.recoverAt 0x71 480 (midpre ++ post) slots root := hstable
    _ = CanonicalRecoveryStability.recoverAt 0x71 480
          ((pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post)
          slots root := by rfl

theorem c1_word_stable (p : Params M Cv L) (Qtot : Nat)
    (H : Addr L → State) (pre post : List (Addr L × State))
    (pubBytes : Bytes) (hframe : 75 + pubBytes.length ≤ L)
    (root answer : State) (hsize : 514 ≤ L) (hnode : 257 ≤ L)
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈
      (pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post,
      q.2 = H q.1)
    (hQ : firstReads emptyTable
      ((pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post) ≤ Qtot)
    (hnoColl : ¬ hitsBad (badColl p Qtot) emptyTable
      ((pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post))
    (hnoChild : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad MerkleChildTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable ((pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post))
    (hnoRoot : ¬ hitsBad (ParsedTargetsCollision.bad CommitmentRootTargets.pred Qtot)
      emptyTable ((pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post)) :
    (fun slots => CanonicalRecoveryStability.recoverAt 0x71 480 pre slots root) =
      (fun slots => CanonicalRecoveryStability.recoverAt 0x71 480
        ((pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hframe root, answer)]) ++ post)
        slots root) := by
  funext slots
  exact c1_recover_stable p Qtot H pre post pubBytes hframe root answer hsize hnode
    hcons hQ hnoColl hnoChild hnoRoot slots

#print axioms c1_recover_stable
#print axioms c1_word_stable

end AspisR1.C1BeforeFrameStability

R1InitialFrameNoMerkle.text:
import R1PublicInitFrame
import R1MerkleLogExtension

/-! The public initialization frame is disjoint from the literal node and
leaf input grammars by its first byte. Consequently appending that singleton
does not change the finite recorded Merkle tables. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.InitialFrameNoMerkle

open FS2.Duplex
open AspisV8PairedCommitment
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisR1.Merkle32Path AspisR1.Merkle32Leaf
open AspisR1.CanonicalByteAddress AspisR1.CanonicalOracleLog
open AspisR1.MerkleRecordedLog AspisR1.MerkleLeafRecovery

theorem node_parse_none (pubBytes : Bytes) (root : State) :
    MerkleNodeCodec.parse (PublicInitFrame.frame pubBytes root) = none := by
  cases hparse : MerkleNodeCodec.parse (PublicInitFrame.frame pubBytes root) with
  | none => rfl
  | some children =>
      have hshape := MerkleNodeCodec.parse_sound hparse
      have hheads := congrArg List.head? hshape
      have hnode : (Merkle32Path.nodeInput children).head? =
          some (0x18 : Merkle32Path.Byte) := by simp [Merkle32Path.nodeInput]
      have hframe : (PublicInitFrame.frame pubBytes root).head? =
          some (85 : Merkle32Path.Byte) := by
        simp [PublicInitFrame.frame, PublicInitFrame.pre,
          AspisR1.TrailingStateFrame.frame, PublicInitFrame.domain]
      rw [hnode, hframe] at hheads
      have hneq : (0x18 : Merkle32Path.Byte) ≠ 85 := by decide
      exact (hneq (Option.some.inj hheads)).elim

theorem leaf_parse_none (tag : Merkle32Path.Byte) (width : Nat)
    (pubBytes : Bytes) (root : State) :
    MerkleLeafCodec.parse tag width (PublicInitFrame.frame pubBytes root) = none := by
  cases hparse : MerkleLeafCodec.parse tag width (PublicInitFrame.frame pubBytes root) with
  | none => rfl
  | some data =>
      have hshape := (MerkleLeafCodec.parse_sound tag width
        (PublicInitFrame.frame pubBytes root) data hparse).2.2
      have hheads := congrArg List.head? hshape
      have hleaf : (Merkle32Leaf.leafInput tag data.1 data.2).head? =
          some (0x10 : Merkle32Path.Byte) := by simp [Merkle32Leaf.leafInput]
      have hframe : (PublicInitFrame.frame pubBytes root).head? =
          some (85 : Merkle32Path.Byte) := by
        simp [PublicInitFrame.frame, PublicInitFrame.pre,
          AspisR1.TrailingStateFrame.frame, PublicInitFrame.domain]
      rw [hleaf, hframe] at hheads
      have hneq : (0x10 : Merkle32Path.Byte) ≠ 85 := by decide
      exact (hneq (Option.some.inj hheads)).elim

theorem singleton_byteLog {L : Nat} (pubBytes : Bytes)
    (hL : 75 + pubBytes.length ≤ L) (root answer : State) :
    CanonicalOracleLog.byteLog
      [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hL root, answer)] =
        [(PublicInitFrame.frame pubBytes root, answer)] := by
  have hcanonical : CanonicalByteAddress.Canonical
      (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hL root) := by
    unfold PublicInitFrame.addr
    exact CanonicalByteAddress.canonical_ofBytes _ _
  have hbytes : (PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hL root).toBytes =
      PublicInitFrame.frame pubBytes root := by
    simp [PublicInitFrame.addr, FS2.Duplex.Addr.toBytes_ofBytes]
  simp [CanonicalOracleLog.byteLog, CanonicalOracleLog.canonicalTrace,
    MerkleRecordedTargets.byteLog, hcanonical, hbytes]

theorem nodes_unchanged {L : Nat} (pre : List (FS2.Duplex.Addr L × State))
    (pubBytes : Bytes) (hL : 75 + pubBytes.length ≤ L) (root answer : State) :
    MerkleRecordedLog.nodes
        (CanonicalOracleLog.byteLog
          (pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hL root, answer)])) =
      MerkleRecordedLog.nodes (CanonicalOracleLog.byteLog pre) := by
  rw [MerkleLogExtension.canonical_byteLog_append, singleton_byteLog,
    MerkleLogExtension.nodes_append]
  simp [MerkleRecordedLog.nodes, node_parse_none]

theorem leaves_unchanged {L : Nat} (tag : Merkle32Path.Byte) (width : Nat)
    (pre : List (FS2.Duplex.Addr L × State)) (pubBytes : Bytes)
    (hL : 75 + pubBytes.length ≤ L) (root answer : State) :
    MerkleRecordedLog.leaves tag width
        (CanonicalOracleLog.byteLog
          (pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hL root, answer)])) =
      MerkleRecordedLog.leaves tag width (CanonicalOracleLog.byteLog pre) := by
  rw [MerkleLogExtension.canonical_byteLog_append, singleton_byteLog,
    MerkleLogExtension.leaves_append]
  simp [MerkleRecordedLog.leaves, leaf_parse_none]

theorem recover_unchanged {L : Nat} (tag : Merkle32Path.Byte) (width : Nat)
    (pre : List (FS2.Duplex.Addr L × State)) (pubBytes : Bytes)
    (hL : 75 + pubBytes.length ≤ L) (frameRoot answer : State)
    (slots : List (Fin 8)) (lookupRoot : Merkle32Path.Digest) :
    MerkleLeafRecovery.recover
      (MerkleRecordedLog.nodes
        (CanonicalOracleLog.byteLog
          (pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hL frameRoot, answer)])))
      (MerkleRecordedLog.leaves tag width
        (CanonicalOracleLog.byteLog
          (pre ++ [(PublicInitFrame.addr pubBytes hL frameRoot, answer)])))
      slots lookupRoot =
    MerkleLeafRecovery.recover
      (MerkleRecordedLog.nodes (CanonicalOracleLog.byteLog pre))
      (MerkleRecordedLog.leaves tag width (CanonicalOracleLog.byteLog pre))
      slots lookupRoot := by
  rw [nodes_unchanged, leaves_unchanged]

#print axioms node_parse_none
#print axioms leaf_parse_none
#print axioms singleton_byteLog
#print axioms nodes_unchanged
#print axioms leaves_unchanged
#print axioms recover_unchanged

end AspisR1.InitialFrameNoMerkle

R1CanonicalCutTypedProjection.text:
import R1LiteralTypedWords
import R1TypedRecoveredWords
import R1FoldedRecoveredWord
import R1MerkleIndexGeometry
import R1ExactLeafFieldCodec

/-! Pointwise projection of the strict payloads recovered at common Merkle
cuts. A query cell is the zero-extended original index; the C1/C2 and folded leaf
indices have the same numeric value, and the within-leaf slot is the same modulo-four value.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.CanonicalCutTypedProjection

open AspisR1.TypedRecoveredWords
open AspisR1.LiteralTypedWords
open AspisR1.MixedLeafDecoder
open AspisR1.MixedLeafEncoding
open AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec
open AspisR1.FoldedRecoveredWord
open AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec
open AspisR1.MerkleIndexGeometry
open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7

/-- View a folded/query index as an original semantic-word index. -/
def queryPosition (q : Fin 262144) : Fin 1048576 :=
  ⟨q.val, by have h := q.isLt; omega⟩

theorem queryLeaf_queryPosition_val (q : Fin 262144) :
    (queryLeaf (queryPosition q)).val = (foldedIndex q).val := rfl

theorem querySlot_queryPosition (q : Fin 262144) :
    querySlot (queryPosition q) = foldedSlot q := by
  apply Fin.ext
  rfl

theorem decoded_cut_payloads_project_at
    {E : Type} [Field E]
    (eM : M31Exact →+* E) (eK : QM31Exact →+* E)
    (c1Packed c2Packed : Fin 262144 → Option (List AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte))
    (foldedPacked : Fin 65536 → Option (List AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte))
    (q : Fin 262144) (c1 : AspisR1.TypedRecoveredWords.C1) (c2 : AspisR1.TypedRecoveredWords.C2) (folded : AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.Folded)
    (hc1 : AspisR1.TypedRecoveredWords.decodeC1At c1Packed (queryLeaf (queryPosition q)) = some c1)
    (hc2 : AspisR1.TypedRecoveredWords.decodeC2At c2Packed (queryLeaf (queryPosition q)) = some c2)
    (hfolded : (foldedPacked (foldedIndex q)).bind
      AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.decodeFolded = some folded) :
    (∀ l : Fin 26,
      TypedRecoveredWords.word eM eK c1Packed c2Packed
        ⟨l.val, by have hl := l.isLt; omega⟩ (queryPosition q) =
          eM ((c1 (querySlot (queryPosition q))).1 l)) ∧
    TypedRecoveredWords.word eM eK c1Packed c2Packed ⟨26, by decide⟩ (queryPosition q) =
      eK ((c2 (querySlot (queryPosition q))) ⟨0, by decide⟩) ∧
    TypedRecoveredWords.word eM eK c1Packed c2Packed ⟨27, by decide⟩ (queryPosition q) =
      eK ((c2 (querySlot (queryPosition q))) ⟨1, by decide⟩) ∧
    TypedRecoveredWords.word eM eK c1Packed c2Packed ⟨28, by decide⟩ (queryPosition q) =
      eK ((c1 (querySlot (queryPosition q))).2) ∧
    FoldedRecoveredWord.wordOfPacked (foldedPacked (foldedIndex q)) q =
      folded (foldedSlot q) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro l
    exact TypedRecoveredWords.word_c1_base_of_decode eM eK c1Packed c2Packed
      (queryPosition q) l c1 hc1
  · exact TypedRecoveredWords.word_c2_first_of_decode eM eK c1Packed c2Packed
        (queryPosition q) c2 hc2
  · exact TypedRecoveredWords.word_c2_second_of_decode eM eK c1Packed c2Packed
        (queryPosition q) c2 hc2
  · exact TypedRecoveredWords.word_c1_tail_of_decode eM eK c1Packed c2Packed
        (queryPosition q) c1 hc1
  · have hsuccess : ∃ bytes,
        foldedPacked (foldedIndex q) = some bytes ∧
          AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.decodeFolded bytes = some folded := by
      cases hp : foldedPacked (foldedIndex q) with
      | none => simp [hp] at hfolded
      | some bytes => exact ⟨bytes, rfl, by simpa [hp] using hfolded⟩
    rcases hsuccess with ⟨bytes, hbytes, hdecoded⟩
    exact FoldedRecoveredWord.wordOfPacked_success _ bytes folded q hbytes hdecoded


/-- The same pointwise conclusions, phrased for `LiteralTypedWords.word`.
The C1/C2 words here are exactly the commitment-time decoders' total
zero-default values, via the established definitional recovery bridge. -/
theorem literal_word_from_cut_payloads_at
    {E : Type} [Field E]
    (eM : M31Exact →+* E) (eK : QM31Exact →+* E)
    (c1Packed c2Packed : Fin 262144 → Option (List AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte))
    (foldedPacked : Fin 65536 → Option (List AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte))
    (q : Fin 262144) (c1 : AspisR1.TypedRecoveredWords.C1)
    (c2 : AspisR1.TypedRecoveredWords.C2) (folded : AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.Folded)
    (hc1 : AspisR1.TypedRecoveredWords.decodeC1At c1Packed
      (queryLeaf (queryPosition q)) = some c1)
    (hc2 : AspisR1.TypedRecoveredWords.decodeC2At c2Packed
      (queryLeaf (queryPosition q)) = some c2)
    (hfolded : (foldedPacked (foldedIndex q)).bind
      AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.decodeFolded = some folded) :
    (∀ l : Fin 26,
      LiteralTypedWords.word eM eK (TypedRecoveredWords.c1Value c1Packed)
        (TypedRecoveredWords.c2Value c2Packed)
        ⟨l.val, by have hl := l.isLt; omega⟩ (queryPosition q) =
          eM ((c1 (querySlot (queryPosition q))).1 l)) ∧
    LiteralTypedWords.word eM eK (TypedRecoveredWords.c1Value c1Packed)
      (TypedRecoveredWords.c2Value c2Packed) ⟨26, by decide⟩ (queryPosition q) =
        eK ((c2 (querySlot (queryPosition q))) ⟨0, by decide⟩) ∧
    LiteralTypedWords.word eM eK (TypedRecoveredWords.c1Value c1Packed)
      (TypedRecoveredWords.c2Value c2Packed) ⟨27, by decide⟩ (queryPosition q) =
        eK ((c2 (querySlot (queryPosition q))) ⟨1, by decide⟩) ∧
    LiteralTypedWords.word eM eK (TypedRecoveredWords.c1Value c1Packed)
      (TypedRecoveredWords.c2Value c2Packed) ⟨28, by decide⟩ (queryPosition q) =
        eK ((c1 (querySlot (queryPosition q))).2) ∧
    FoldedRecoveredWord.wordOfPacked (foldedPacked (foldedIndex q)) q =
      folded (foldedSlot q) := by
  simpa only [LiteralTypedWords.word_recovered_eq] using
    (decoded_cut_payloads_project_at eM eK c1Packed c2Packed foldedPacked
      q c1 c2 folded hc1 hc2 hfolded)

#print axioms literal_word_from_cut_payloads_at

#print axioms queryLeaf_queryPosition_val
#print axioms querySlot_queryPosition
#print axioms decoded_cut_payloads_project_at

end AspisR1.CanonicalCutTypedProjection

R0P.SemRounds.text:
import R0P.SemClosed
import R0P.SemBadSets
import Mathlib.Tactic.LinearCombination
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

/-! The 24 semantic challenge rounds of the fixed pair-forest model.

Challenge order follows the lead's FS integration design: λ, χ, θ,
ten zerocheck coordinates, μ, then ten sumcheck challenges. The α event
is literally the recursive `Sumcheck.badAlpha` disjunct; the already
checked prover degree is used only for its cardinality bound. The λ event
uses the fixed leading coefficient of `LogUpAssembly.productDifference`.
No probability claim or Rust-to-model refinement is asserted here.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R0P.Sumcheck
open Polynomial

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- The honest partial-sum function at a specified round and prefix.
The recursion restricts exactly one leading coordinate per prefix entry. -/
def alphaRoundPartial : (n : Nat) → ((Fin n → K) → K) →
    (i : Fin n) → (Fin i.val → K) → K → K
  | 0, _, i => i.elim0
  | n+1, G, i => Fin.cases
      (fun _ x => bsum n (fun v => G (Fin.cons x v)))
      (fun j pref x => alphaRoundPartial n
        (fun v => G (Fin.cons (pref ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ j.val⟩) v))
        j (Fin.tail pref) x) i

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms alphaRoundPartial

/-- The actual transcript prefix, excluding the round's own challenge. -/
def alphaRoundPrefix {n : Nat} (α : Fin n → K) (i : Fin n) : Fin i.val → K :=
  fun j => α (Fin.castLE i.isLt.le j)

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms alphaRoundPrefix

/-- One exact disjunct of `badAlpha`, retaining its existential honest
polynomial and every degree, evaluation and nonzero-difference condition. -/
def alphaRound (d n : Nat) (G : (Fin n → K) → K)
    (polys : Fin n → K[X]) (i : Fin n) (pref : Fin i.val → K) (x : K) : Prop :=
  ∃ h : K[X], h.natDegree ≤ d ∧
    (∀ y, h.eval y = alphaRoundPartial n G i pref y) ∧
    polys i ≠ h ∧ (polys i - h).eval x = 0

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms alphaRound

theorem alphaRound_zero (d n : Nat) (G : (Fin (n+1) → K) → K)
    (polys : Fin (n+1) → K[X]) (α : Fin (n+1) → K) :
    alphaRound d (n+1) G polys 0 (alphaRoundPrefix α 0) (α 0) ↔
      ∃ h : K[X], h.natDegree ≤ d ∧
        (∀ x, h.eval x = bsum n (fun v => G (Fin.cons x v))) ∧
        polys 0 ≠ h ∧ (polys 0 - h).eval (α 0) = 0 := by
  rfl

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms alphaRound_zero

theorem alphaRound_succ (d n : Nat) (G : (Fin (n+1) → K) → K)
    (polys : Fin (n+1) → K[X]) (α : Fin (n+1) → K) (i : Fin n) :
    alphaRound d (n+1) G polys i.succ (alphaRoundPrefix α i.succ) (α i.succ) ↔
      alphaRound d n (fun v => G (Fin.cons (α 0) v)) (Fin.tail polys) i
        (alphaRoundPrefix (Fin.tail α) i) ((Fin.tail α) i) := by
  rfl

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms alphaRound_succ

/-- The recursive transcript event is exactly the union of its per-round
disjuncts at the corresponding transcript prefixes and current challenges. -/
theorem badAlpha_iff_exists_round (d : Nat) : ∀ (n : Nat)
    (G : (Fin n → K) → K) (polys : Fin n → K[X]) (α : Fin n → K),
    badAlpha d n G polys α ↔
      ∃ i : Fin n, alphaRound d n G polys i (alphaRoundPrefix α i) (α i) := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro G polys α
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact False.elim h
      · rintro ⟨i, _⟩
        exact i.elim0
  | succ n ih =>
      intro G polys α
      constructor
      · intro h
        rcases h with hhead | htail
        · exact ⟨0, (alphaRound_zero d n G polys α).mpr hhead⟩
        · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ :=
            (ih (fun v => G (Fin.cons (α 0) v)) (Fin.tail polys) (Fin.tail α)).mp htail
          exact ⟨i.succ, (alphaRound_succ d n G polys α i).mpr hi⟩
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ i hi
        · intro hhead
          exact Or.inl ((alphaRound_zero d n G polys α).mp hhead)
        · intro j htail
          exact Or.inr
            ((ih (fun v => G (Fin.cons (α 0) v)) (Fin.tail polys) (Fin.tail α)).mpr
              ⟨j, (alphaRound_succ d n G polys α j).mp htail⟩)

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms badAlpha_iff_exists_round

noncomputable section
open Classical

/-- The literal round event has at most `d` roots when the prover's round
polynomial also has degree at most `d`. Honest witnesses need not be unique:
their evaluations agree with the same partial-sum function. -/
theorem alphaRound_card [Fintype K] (d n : Nat) (G : (Fin n → K) → K)
    (polys : Fin n → K[X]) (i : Fin n) (pref : Fin i.val → K)
    (hpd : (polys i).natDegree ≤ d) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (alphaRound d n G polys i pref)).card ≤ d := by
  classical
  by_cases hex : ∃ x, alphaRound d n G polys i pref x
  · obtain ⟨_x₀, h₀, hd₀, heval₀, hne₀, _hroot₀⟩ := hex
    have hnonzero : polys i - h₀ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hne₀
    have hdegree : (polys i - h₀).natDegree ≤ d :=
      (Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le _ _).trans (max_le hpd hd₀)
    have hsub : Finset.univ.filter (alphaRound d n G polys i pref) ⊆
        Finset.univ.filter (fun x : K => (polys i - h₀).eval x = 0) := by
      intro x hx
      obtain ⟨h, _hd, heval, _hne, hroot⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
      refine Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ x, ?_⟩
      have heq : h.eval x = h₀.eval x := (heval x).trans (heval₀ x).symm
      simpa only [Polynomial.eval_sub, heq] using hroot
    exact (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans
      (R0P.SemBadSets.univariate_bad_card (polys i - h₀) hnonzero d hdegree)
  · have hempty : Finset.univ.filter (alphaRound d n G polys i pref) = ∅ := by
      apply Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff.mpr
      intro x _hx hx
      exact hex ⟨x, hx⟩
    rw [hempty, Finset.card_empty]
    exact Nat.zero_le d

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms alphaRound_card

end

end R0P.Sumcheck

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- Every polynomial checked by an accepted transcript has the checked
round degree bound. This also applies to polynomials selected by a strategy. -/
theorem accept_polys_degree (d : Nat) : ∀ (n : Nat)
    (G : (Fin n → K) → K) (c : K) (polys : Fin n → K[X]) (α : Fin n → K),
    accept d n G c polys α → ∀ i : Fin n, (polys i).natDegree ≤ d := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro G c polys α _hacc i
      exact i.elim0
  | succ n ih =>
      intro G c polys α hacc i
      obtain ⟨hhead, _hsum, htail⟩ := hacc
      refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ i
      · exact hhead
      · intro j
        exact ih (fun v => G (Fin.cons (α 0) v)) ((polys 0).eval (α 0))
          (Fin.tail polys) (Fin.tail α) htail j

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms accept_polys_degree

/-- An adaptive accepted false claim supplies one of the literal transcript
round events. No converse between these two events is asserted. -/
theorem badAlphaStrategy_imp_exists_round (d n : Nat)
    (G : (Fin n → K) → K) (c : K)
    (strat : (i : Fin n) → (Fin i.val → K) → K[X]) (α : Fin n → K)
    (hdeg : IndDeg d n G)
    (hbad : R0P.SemBadSets.badAlphaStrategy d n G c strat α) :
    ∃ i : Fin n, alphaRound d n G (R0P.SemBadSets.strategyPolys strat α) i
      (alphaRoundPrefix α i) (α i) := by
  apply (badAlpha_iff_exists_round d n G (R0P.SemBadSets.strategyPolys strat α) α).mp
  exact sound d n G c (R0P.SemBadSets.strategyPolys strat α) α hdeg hbad.1 hbad.2

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms badAlphaStrategy_imp_exists_round

def lambdaRoundBad (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (lam : K) : Prop :=
  prodPolys pub t ≠ consPolys pub t ∧

def chiRoundBad (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (lam chi : K) : Prop :=
  chi = 0 ∨ chi ∈ poleSet t lam ∨
    (numer (valueSet pub t lam) (signedCount pub t lam) ≠ 0 ∧
      (numer (valueSet pub t lam) (signedCount pub t lam)).eval chi = 0)

private noncomputable def roundRootProduct (S : Multiset (K[X])) : (K[X])[X] :=
  (S.map (fun q => (X : Polynomial (K[X])) - C q)).prod

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms roundRootProduct

private theorem roundRootProduct_coeff_degree (S : Multiset (K[X]))
    (hS : ∀ q ∈ S, q.natDegree ≤ 16) (j : Nat) :
    ((roundRootProduct S).coeff j).natDegree ≤ 16 * S.card := by
  classical
  induction S using Multiset.induction_on generalizing j with
  | empty =>
      by_cases hj : j = 0
      · subst j
        simp [roundRootProduct]
      · simp [roundRootProduct, Polynomial.coeff_one, hj]
  | cons q S ih =>
      have hq : q.natDegree ≤ 16 := hS q (by simp)
      have hS' : ∀ x ∈ S, x.natDegree ≤ 16 := by
        intro x hx
        exact hS x (by simp [hx])
      by_cases hj : j = 0
      · subst j
        have hb := ih hS' 0
        simp only [roundRootProduct, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, Multiset.card_cons]
        change ((((X : Polynomial (K[X])) - C q) * roundRootProduct S).coeff 0).natDegree ≤
          16 * (S.card + 1)
        rw [Polynomial.mul_coeff_zero]
        have hcoeff0 : ((X : Polynomial (K[X])) - C q).coeff 0 = -q := by simp
        rw [hcoeff0]
        calc
          _ ≤ (-q).natDegree + ((roundRootProduct S).coeff 0).natDegree :=
            Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le
          _ ≤ 16 + 16 * S.card := Nat.add_le_add (by simpa using hq) hb
          _ = 16 * (S.card + 1) := by omega
      · obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hj
        have hb := ih hS' k
        have hb' := ih hS' (k + 1)
        simp only [roundRootProduct, Multiset.map_cons, Multiset.prod_cons, Multiset.card_cons]
        change ((((X : Polynomial (K[X])) - C q) * roundRootProduct S).coeff (k + 1)).natDegree ≤
          16 * (S.card + 1)
        rw [Polynomial.coeff_X_sub_C_mul]
        have hmul : (q * (roundRootProduct S).coeff (k + 1)).natDegree ≤
            16 + 16 * S.card := by
          calc
            _ ≤ q.natDegree + ((roundRootProduct S).coeff (k + 1)).natDegree :=
              Polynomial.natDegree_mul_le
            _ ≤ 16 + 16 * S.card := Nat.add_le_add hq hb'
        calc
          _ ≤ max ((roundRootProduct S).coeff k).natDegree
              (q * (roundRootProduct S).coeff (k + 1)).natDegree := Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le _ _
          _ ≤ 16 * (S.card + 1) := by omega

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms roundRootProduct_coeff_degree

private theorem round_poly_degree_le_16 (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K)
    (hprod : ∀ q ∈ prodPolys pub t, q.natDegree ≤ 16)
    (hcons : ∀ q ∈ consPolys pub t, q.natDegree ≤ 16) :
    (productDifference pub t).leadingCoeff.natDegree ≤
      16 * max (prodPolys pub t).card (consPolys pub t).card := by
  let S := prodPolys pub t
  let T := consPolys pub t
  have hS : ∀ q ∈ S, q.natDegree ≤ 16 := hprod
  have hT : ∀ q ∈ T, q.natDegree ≤ 16 := hcons
  have hcoeffS := roundRootProduct_coeff_degree S hS (productDifference pub t).natDegree
  have hcoeffT := roundRootProduct_coeff_degree T hT (productDifference pub t).natDegree
  change ((roundRootProduct S - roundRootProduct T).coeff
    (roundRootProduct S - roundRootProduct T).natDegree).natDegree ≤ _
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_sub]
  calc
    _ ≤ max ((roundRootProduct S).coeff (productDifference pub t).natDegree).natDegree
        ((roundRootProduct T).coeff (productDifference pub t).natDegree).natDegree :=
      Polynomial.natDegree_sub_le _ _
    _ ≤ max (16 * S.card) (16 * T.card) :=
      max_le (hcoeffS.trans (le_max_left _ _)) (hcoeffT.trans (le_max_right _ _))
    _ = 16 * max S.card T.card := by
      rcases le_total S.card T.card with h | h
      · rw [max_eq_right h, max_eq_right (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 16 h)]
      · rw [max_eq_left h, max_eq_left (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 16 h)]

#print axioms round_poly_degree_le_16

    (compressPoly tuple).natDegree ≤ 16 := by

theorem lambdaRoundBad_card [Fintype K] (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (lambdaRoundBad pub t)).card ≤ 2176 := by
  classical
  by_cases hneq : prodPolys pub t ≠ consPolys pub t
  · have hprod : ∀ q ∈ prodPolys pub t, q.natDegree ≤ 16 := by
      intro q hq
      change q ∈ (enabledLinks pub).map (fun l => compressPoly (copyProducerTuple t l)) at hq
      obtain ⟨l, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hq
      exact round_compress_degree _
    have hcons : ∀ q ∈ consPolys pub t, q.natDegree ≤ 16 := by
      intro q hq
      change q ∈ (enabledLinks pub).map (fun l => compressPoly (copyConsumerTuple t l)) at hq
      obtain ⟨l, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hq
      exact round_compress_degree _
    have hrootdiff := SemBadSets.product_difference_coeff
      (prodPolys pub t) (consPolys pub t) hneq hprod hcons
    have hdiff : productDifference pub t ≠ 0 := by
      apply sub_ne_zero.mpr
      exact hrootdiff.1
    have hlead : (productDifference pub t).leadingCoeff ≠ 0 :=
      Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hdiff
    have hdegree := round_poly_degree_le_16 pub t hprod hcons
    have hcards := round_poly_multiset_card_le_136 pub t
    have hdegree' : (productDifference pub t).leadingCoeff.natDegree ≤ 2176 := by
      have hm : max (prodPolys pub t).card (consPolys pub t).card ≤ 136 :=
        max_le hcards.1 hcards.2
      have hscale := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 16 hm
      norm_num at hscale ⊢
      exact hdegree.trans hscale
    have hinc : (Finset.univ.filter (lambdaRoundBad pub t)) ⊆
        Finset.univ.filter (fun lam : K => (productDifference pub t).leadingCoeff.eval lam = 0) := by
      intro lam hlam
      exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hlam).2.2⟩
    calc
      _ ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun lam : K =>
          (productDifference pub t).leadingCoeff.eval lam = 0)).card := Finset.card_le_card hinc
      _ ≤ 2176 := SemBadSets.univariate_bad_card _ hlead 2176 hdegree'
  · have hempty : Finset.univ.filter (lambdaRoundBad pub t) = ∅ := by
      ext lam
      simp [lambdaRoundBad, hneq]
    rw [hempty]
    simp

theorem chiRoundBad_card [Fintype K] (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (lam : K) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (chiRoundBad pub t lam)).card ≤ 544 := by
  classical
  let D := valueSet pub t lam
  let m := signedCount pub t lam
  let N := numer D m
  let R := N.roots.toFinset
  let target : Finset K := ({0} ∪ poleSet t lam) ∪ R
  have hroot : R.card ≤ 271 := by
    by_cases hN : N = 0
    · simp [R, N, hN]
    · have hb := numer_nonzero_bounds D m hN
      have hcard : R.card ≤ N.roots.card := Multiset.toFinset_card_le N.roots
      have hsize : D.card ≤ 272 := by exact round_value_set_card_le_272 pub t lam
      have hroots : N.roots.card ≤ D.card - 1 := hb.2
      have hroots' : N.roots.card ≤ 271 := by omega
      exact hcard.trans hroots'
  have hpole : (poleSet t lam).card ≤ 272 := round_pole_set_card_le_272 t lam
  have hsubset : (Finset.univ.filter (chiRoundBad pub t lam)) ⊆ target := by
    intro x hx
    have hx' := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2
    rcases hx' with hzero | hpole | hnum
    · simp only [target, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton]
      exact Or.inl (Or.inl hzero)
    · simp only [target, Finset.mem_union]
      exact Or.inl (Or.inr hpole)
    · have hr : x ∈ R := by
        change x ∈ N.roots.toFinset
        rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_roots hnum.1]
        exact hnum.2
      exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (Or.inr hr)
  have htarget : target.card ≤ 544 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ({0} : Finset K).card + (poleSet t lam).card + R.card := by
        calc
          _ ≤ ({0} ∪ poleSet t lam).card + R.card :=
            Finset.card_union_le ({0} ∪ poleSet t lam) R
          _ ≤ ({0} : Finset K).card + (poleSet t lam).card + R.card :=
            Nat.add_le_add_right
              (Finset.card_union_le ({0} : Finset K) (poleSet t lam)) R.card
      _ ≤ 1 + 272 + 271 := by
        simp only [Finset.card_singleton]
        omega
      _ = 544 := by norm_num
  exact (Finset.card_le_card hsubset).trans htarget

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

local instance (p : Prop) : Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable p

/-- Collapse the first challenge coordinate of a Boolean function by multilinear
interpolation, leaving a function on the Boolean tail. -/
def mleRestrict (n : Nat) (f : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → K) (x : K) :
    (Fin n → Bool) → K :=
  fun b => (1 - x) * f (Fin.cons false b) + x * f (Fin.cons true b)

/-- The finite Boolean vector consisting of the coordinates before `i`. -/
def zcPrefix {n : Nat} (z : Fin n → K) (i : Fin n) : Fin i.val → K :=
  fun j => z ⟨j.val, Nat.lt_trans j.isLt i.isLt⟩

/-- The first coordinate at which partial interpolation of a nonzero Boolean
function becomes the zero function. -/
def zcRound : (n : Nat) → ((Fin n → Bool) → K) →
    (i : Fin n) → (Fin i.val → K) → K → Prop
  | 0, _, i => i.elim0
  | n + 1, f, i =>
      Fin.cases
        (fun _ x => f ≠ 0 ∧ mleRestrict n f x = 0)
        (fun j pref x =>
          zcRound n (mleRestrict n f (pref ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ j.val⟩))
            j (Fin.tail pref) x)
        i

#print axioms mleRestrict

theorem mle_smul (n : Nat) (a : K) (f : (Fin n → Bool) → K) (z : Fin n → K) :
    mle n (fun b => a * f b) z = a * mle n f z := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [mle]
      rw [ih, ih]
      ring

#print axioms mle_smul

theorem mle_add (n : Nat) (f g : (Fin n → Bool) → K) (z : Fin n → K) :
    mle n (fun b => f b + g b) z = mle n f z + mle n g z := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [mle]
      rw [ih, ih]
      ring

#print axioms mle_add

theorem mle_restrict (n : Nat) (f : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → K) (x : K)
    (z : Fin n → K) :
    mle n (mleRestrict n f x) z =
      (1 - x) * mle n (fun b => f (Fin.cons false b)) z +
        x * mle n (fun b => f (Fin.cons true b)) z := by
  change mle n (fun b => (1 - x) * f (Fin.cons false b) +
    x * f (Fin.cons true b)) z = _
  rw [mle_add, mle_smul, mle_smul]

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms mle_restrict

  simp only [mle]
  simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.tail_cons]
  rw [mle_restrict]

theorem zcPrefix_succ {n : Nat} (z : Fin (n + 1) → K) (i : Fin n) :
    zcPrefix z i.succ = Fin.cons (z 0) (zcPrefix (Fin.tail z) i) := by
  funext j
  refine Fin.cases ?_ ?_ j
  · simp [zcPrefix]
  · intro j
    change z ⟨j.val + 1, _⟩ = z (Fin.succ ⟨j.val, _⟩)
    congr 1

#print axioms zcPrefix_succ

theorem zcRound_succ (n : Nat) (f : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → K) (i : Fin n)
    (pref : Fin (i.val + 1) → K) (x : K) :
    zcRound (n + 1) f i.succ pref x =
    zcRound n (mleRestrict n f (pref ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ i.val⟩)) i (Fin.tail pref) x := by
  rfl

#print axioms zcRound_succ

theorem zcRound_exists_split (n : Nat) (f : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → K)
    (z : Fin (n + 1) → K) :
    (∃ i : Fin (n + 1), zcRound (n + 1) f i (zcPrefix z i) (z i)) ↔
      (f ≠ 0 ∧ mleRestrict n f (z 0) = 0) ∨
        (∃ i : Fin n,
          zcRound n (mleRestrict n f (z 0)) i (zcPrefix (Fin.tail z) i)
            (Fin.tail z i)) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with hzero | ⟨j, rfl⟩
    · subst i
      left
      simpa [zcRound, zcPrefix] using hi
    · right
      rw [zcRound_succ, zcPrefix_succ] at hi
      exact ⟨j, hi⟩
  · rintro (⟨hf, hzero⟩ | ⟨i, hi⟩)
    · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      simpa [zcRound, zcPrefix] using And.intro hf hzero
    · refine ⟨i.succ, ?_⟩
      rw [zcRound_succ, zcPrefix_succ]
      exact hi

#print axioms zcRound_exists_split

theorem mle_zero_of_fun_eq_zero (n : Nat) (z : Fin n → K)
    (f : (Fin n → Bool) → K) (hf : f = 0) : mle n f z = 0 := by
  subst f
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      change (1 - z 0) * mle n (0 : (Fin n → Bool) → K) (Fin.tail z) +
        z 0 * mle n (0 : (Fin n → Bool) → K) (Fin.tail z) = 0
      rw [ih]
      ring

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms mle_zero_of_fun_eq_zero

/-- The roundwise collapse event identifies precisely the nonzero Boolean
functions whose multilinear extension vanishes at the challenge point. -/
theorem zc_rounds_iff (n : Nat) (f : (Fin n → Bool) → K) (z : Fin n → K) :
    (f ≠ 0 ∧ mle n f z = 0) ↔
      ∃ i : Fin n, zcRound n f i (zcPrefix z i) (z i) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hf, hz⟩
        have hzero : f = 0 := by
          funext b
          have hb : b = (fun i : Fin 0 => i.elim0) := by
            funext i
            exact Fin.elim0 i
          rw [hb]
          change f (fun i : Fin 0 => i.elim0) = 0 at hz
          exact hz
        exact (hf hzero).elim
      · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
        exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ n ih =>
      let x := z 0
      let tail := Fin.tail z
      let g := mleRestrict n f x
      have hz : z = Fin.cons x tail := by
        exact (Fin.cons_self_tail z).symm
      rw [hz]
      rw [mle_cons_restrict]
      rw [zcRound_exists_split]
      simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.tail_cons]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hf, hzero⟩
        by_cases hg : g = 0
        · exact Or.inl ⟨hf, by
            change g = 0
            exact hg⟩
        · exact Or.inr ((ih g tail).1 ⟨hg, by simpa [g, x, tail] using hzero⟩)
      · rintro (⟨hf, hg⟩ | htail)
        · refine ⟨hf, ?_⟩
          simpa [g, x] using (mle_zero_of_fun_eq_zero n tail g hg)
        · obtain ⟨hg, hzero⟩ := (ih g tail).2 htail
          have hf : f ≠ 0 := by
            intro h
            have : g = 0 := by
              change mleRestrict n f x = 0
              rw [h]
              funext b
              change (1 - x) * 0 + x * 0 = 0
              ring
            exact hg this
          exact ⟨hf, by simpa [g, x, tail] using hzero⟩

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms zc_rounds_iff

/-- At a fixed Boolean witness where `f` is nonzero, at most one challenge
can collapse the entire Boolean tail function to zero. -/
theorem zc_head_roots_card [Fintype K] {n : Nat}
    (f : (Fin (n + 1) → Bool) → K) (b : Fin (n + 1) → Bool) (hb : f b ≠ 0) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : K => mleRestrict n f x = 0)).card ≤ 1 := by
  classical
  rw [Finset.card_le_one_iff]
  intro x y hx hy
  let t := Fin.tail b
  let a := f (Fin.cons false t)
  let c := f (Fin.cons true t)
  have hbcons : b = Fin.cons (b 0) t := by
    change b = Fin.cons (b 0) (Fin.tail b)
    exact (Fin.cons_self_tail b).symm
  have ha_or_hc : a ≠ 0 ∨ c ≠ 0 := by
    have hb' : f (Fin.cons (b 0) t) ≠ 0 := by rw [← hbcons]; exact hb
    by_cases hbit : b 0
    · right
      simpa [c, t, hbit] using hb'
    · left
      simpa [a, t, hbit] using hb'
  have hxeq : (1 - x) * a + x * c = 0 := by
    have h := congrFun (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2 t
    simpa [mleRestrict, a, c, t] using h
  have hyeq : (1 - y) * a + y * c = 0 := by
    have h := congrFun (Finset.mem_filter.mp hy).2 t
    simpa [mleRestrict, a, c, t] using h
  have hx' : a + x * (c - a) = 0 := by linear_combination hxeq
  have hy' : a + y * (c - a) = 0 := by linear_combination hyeq
  have hprod : (x - y) * (c - a) = 0 := by linear_combination hx' - hy'
  have hca : c - a ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    have hca' : c = a := sub_eq_zero.mp hzero
    rcases ha_or_hc with ha | hc
    · rw [hca'] at hxeq
      have ha0 : a = 0 := by linear_combination hxeq
      exact ha ha0
    · rw [hca'] at hc
      rw [hca'] at hxeq
      have hc0 : a = 0 := by linear_combination hxeq
      exact hc hc0
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with hxy | hxy
  · exact sub_eq_zero.mp hxy
  · exact (hca hxy).elim

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms zc_head_roots_card

/-- For any fixed coordinate and already-chosen prefix, the next challenge
values causing a zero collapse form a set of size at most one. -/
theorem zcRound_card [Fintype K] : ∀ (n : Nat)
    (f : (Fin n → Bool) → K) (i : Fin n) (pref : Fin i.val → K),
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : K => zcRound n f i pref x)).card ≤ 1 := by
  classical
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro f i
      exact Fin.elim0 i
  | succ n ih =>
      intro f i pref
      rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with hzero | ⟨j, rfl⟩
      · subst i
        by_cases hf : f = 0
        · have hfilter :
              Finset.univ.filter (fun x : K => zcRound (n + 1) f 0 pref x) = ∅ := by
            ext x
            simp [zcRound, hf]
          simp [hfilter]
        · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b : Fin (n + 1) → Bool, f b ≠ 0 := by
            by_contra h
            have hz : ∀ b : Fin (n + 1) → Bool, f b = 0 := by
              intro b
              by_contra hfb
              exact h ⟨b, hfb⟩
            apply hf
            funext b
            exact hz b
          have hsubset :
              Finset.univ.filter (fun x : K => zcRound (n + 1) f 0 pref x) ⊆
                Finset.univ.filter (fun x : K => mleRestrict n f x = 0) := by
            intro x hx
            simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hx ⊢
            have he : f ≠ 0 ∧ mleRestrict n f x = 0 := by
              exact hx
            exact he.2
          exact (Finset.card_le_card hsubset).trans (zc_head_roots_card f b hb)
      · let pref' : Fin (j.val + 1) → K := pref
        simpa only [zcRound_succ] using
          ih (mleRestrict n f (pref' ⟨0, Nat.zero_lt_succ j.val⟩)) j (Fin.tail pref')

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms zcRound_card

end R0P.SemRounds
end

noncomputable section
namespace R0P
open Polynomial Sumcheck SemRounds
local instance (p : Prop) : Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable p
variable {K : Type} [Field K]
local instance : DecidableEq K := Classical.decEq K

/-- Total lookup for an earlier-challenge prefix. Every lookup used by a
round is strictly before that round; the other entries are unused padding. -/
def semPrefixVal {n : Nat} (pref : Fin n → K) (k : Nat) : K :=
  if h : k < n then pref ⟨k, h⟩ else 0

/-- A consecutive coordinate slice of a challenge prefix. -/
def semSlice {n : Nat} (pref : Fin n → K) (start len : Nat) : Fin len → K :=
  fun j => semPrefixVal pref (start + j.val)

/-- Challenges strictly earlier than the specified semantic round. -/
def semPrefix (r : Fin 24 → K) (i : Fin 24) : Fin i.val → K :=
  fun j => r (Fin.castLE i.isLt.le j)

/-- The source's per-candidate budgets, in the 24-round challenge order. -/
def semRoundBudget (i : Fin 24) : Nat :=
  if i.val = 0 then 2176 else if i.val = 1 then 544 else
  if i.val = 2 then 28 else if i.val < 13 then 1 else
  if i.val = 13 then 2 else 27

/-- The degree check already performed before an alpha challenge is drawn.
This is a premise of the counting theorem only. -/
def semRoundDegreeChecked
    (strat : (Fin 14 → K) → (j : Fin 10) → (Fin j.val → K) → K[X])
    (i : Fin 24) (pref : Fin i.val → K) : Prop :=
  if h : 14 ≤ i.val then
    let j : Fin 10 := ⟨i.val - 14, by omega⟩
    (strat (semSlice pref 0 14) j (semSlice pref 14 j.val)).natDegree ≤ 27
  else True

/-- The exact semantic-round events. The virtual polynomial is fixed by the
first fourteen challenges; the adaptive prover polynomial sees only earlier
alpha challenges. The current challenge is supplied separately. -/
def semRoundBad {F : Subfield K} (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (G : (Fin 14 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (strat : (Fin 14 → K) → (j : Fin 10) → (Fin j.val → K) → K[X])
    (i : Fin 24) (pref : Fin i.val → K) (x : K) : Prop :=
  if h0 : i.val = 0 then lambdaRoundBad pub t x else
  if h1 : i.val = 1 then chiRoundBad pub t (semPrefixVal pref 0) x else
  if h2 : i.val = 2 then
    BadTheta (laneOf t pub (semPrefixVal pref 0) (semPrefixVal pref 1) B) x else
  if hz : i.val < 13 then
    let j : Fin 10 := ⟨i.val - 3, by omega⟩
    zcRound 10
      (lanesComp (semPrefixVal pref 2)
        (laneOf t pub (semPrefixVal pref 0) (semPrefixVal pref 1) B))
      j (semSlice pref 3 j.val) x else
  if hm : i.val = 13 then
    BadMu
      (mle 10 (lanesComp (semPrefixVal pref 2)
        (laneOf t pub (semPrefixVal pref 0) (semPrefixVal pref 1) B)) (semSlice pref 3 10))
      (bsumB 10 (fun b => t 26 (rowOf b)))
      (bsumB 10 (fun b =>
        (1 - copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel (rowOf b)))) * t 26 (rowOf b))) x else
    let j : Fin 10 := ⟨i.val - 14, by omega⟩
    let pref14 := semSlice pref 0 14
    let apref := semSlice pref 14 j.val
    alphaRound 27 10 (G pref14) (fun _ => strat pref14 j apref) j apref x

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms semPrefixVal
set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms semSlice
set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms semPrefix
set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms semRoundBudget
set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms semRoundDegreeChecked
set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms semRoundBad

/-- Per-candidate root counts with the source's pre-challenge degree check
used only for the alpha counting case. -/
theorem semRoundBad_card [Fintype K] {F : Subfield K}
    (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (G : (Fin 14 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (strat : (Fin 14 → K) → (j : Fin 10) → (Fin j.val → K) → K[X])
    (i : Fin 24) (pref : Fin i.val → K)
    (hchecked : semRoundDegreeChecked strat i pref) :
    (Finset.univ.filter (semRoundBad t pub B G strat i pref)).card ≤ semRoundBudget i := by
  unfold semRoundBad semRoundBudget
  split_ifs with h0 h1 h2 hz hm
  · exact lambdaRoundBad_card pub t
  · exact chiRoundBad_card pub t (semPrefixVal pref 0)
  · exact SemBadSets.badTheta_card _
  · exact zcRound_card 10 _ _ _
  · exact SemBadSets.badMu_card _ _ _
  · have hi : 14 ≤ i.val := by omega
    have hp := hchecked
    simp only [semRoundDegreeChecked, dif_pos hi] at hp
    exact alphaRound_card 27 10 _ _ _ _ hp

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms semRoundBad_card

end R0P
end

namespace R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

private theorem semPrefixVal_actual (r : Fin 24 → K) (i : Fin 24)
    (k : Nat) (hk : k < i.val) :
    semPrefixVal (semPrefix r i) k = r ⟨k, hk.trans i.isLt⟩ := by
  simp only [semPrefixVal, dif_pos hk, semPrefix]
  rfl

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms semPrefixVal_actual

private theorem semSlice_actual (r : Fin 24 → K) (start len : Nat)
    (hbound : start + len ≤ 24) (j : Fin len) :
    semSlice r start len j = r ⟨start + j.val, by omega⟩ := by
  have hj : start + j.val < 24 := by omega
  simp only [semSlice, semPrefixVal, dif_pos hj]

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms semSlice_actual

private theorem semSlice_prefix_actual (r : Fin 24 → K) (i : Fin 24)
    (start len : Nat) (hbound : start + len ≤ i.val) :
    semSlice (semPrefix r i) start len = semSlice r start len := by
  funext j
  have hj : start + j.val < i.val := by omega
  have hj24 : start + j.val < 24 := hj.trans i.isLt
  simp only [semSlice, semPrefixVal, dif_pos hj, dif_pos hj24, semPrefix]
  rfl

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms semSlice_prefix_actual

private theorem semRoundBad_zero {F : Subfield K} (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (G : (Fin 14 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (strat : (Fin 14 → K) → (j : Fin 10) → (Fin j.val → K) → K[X])
    (r : Fin 24 → K) (x : K) :
    semRoundBad t pub B G strat 0 (semPrefix r 0) x ↔ lambdaRoundBad pub t x := by
  simp [semRoundBad]

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms semRoundBad_zero

private theorem semRoundBad_one {F : Subfield K} (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (G : (Fin 14 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (strat : (Fin 14 → K) → (j : Fin 10) → (Fin j.val → K) → K[X])
    (r : Fin 24 → K) (x : K) :
    semRoundBad t pub B G strat 1 (semPrefix r 1) x ↔ chiRoundBad pub t (r 0) x := by

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms semRoundBad_one

private theorem semRoundBad_two {F : Subfield K} (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (G : (Fin 14 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (strat : (Fin 14 → K) → (j : Fin 10) → (Fin j.val → K) → K[X])
    (r : Fin 24 → K) (x : K) :
    semRoundBad t pub B G strat 2 (semPrefix r 2) x ↔
      BadTheta (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B) x := by

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms semRoundBad_two

private theorem semRoundBad_zc {F : Subfield K} (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (G : (Fin 14 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (strat : (Fin 14 → K) → (j : Fin 10) → (Fin j.val → K) → K[X])
    (r : Fin 24 → K) (j : Fin 10) (x : K) :
    semRoundBad t pub B G strat ⟨3 + j.val, by omega⟩
        (semPrefix r ⟨3 + j.val, by omega⟩) x ↔
      zcRound 10 (lanesComp (r 2) (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B))
        j (zcPrefix (semSlice r 3 10) j) x := by
  let i : Fin 24 := ⟨3 + j.val, by omega⟩
  change semRoundBad t pub B G strat i (semPrefix r i) x ↔ _
  have h0 : i.val ≠ 0 := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have h1 : i.val ≠ 1 := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have h2 : i.val ≠ 2 := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have hz : i.val < 13 := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have hj : (⟨i.val - 3, by dsimp [i]; omega⟩ : Fin 10) = j := by
    apply Fin.ext
    dsimp [i]
    omega
  have hp0 : semPrefixVal (semPrefix r i) 0 = r 0 :=
    semPrefixVal_actual r i 0 (by dsimp [i]; omega)
  have hp1 : semPrefixVal (semPrefix r i) 1 = r 1 :=
    semPrefixVal_actual r i 1 (by dsimp [i]; omega)
  have hp2 : semPrefixVal (semPrefix r i) 2 = r 2 :=
    semPrefixVal_actual r i 2 (by dsimp [i]; omega)
  have hslice : semSlice (semPrefix r i) 3 j.val = zcPrefix (semSlice r 3 10) j := by
    rw [semSlice_prefix_actual r i 3 j.val (by dsimp [i]; omega)]
    rfl
  simp only [semRoundBad, dif_neg h0, dif_neg h1, dif_neg h2, dif_pos hz,
    hp0, hp1, hp2]
  have hview := congrArg (fun k : Fin 10 =>
    zcRound 10 (lanesComp (r 2) (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B))
      k (semSlice (semPrefix r i) 3 k.val) x) hj
  rw [hslice] at hview
  exact Iff.of_eq hview
