#print axioms semRoundBad_zc

private theorem semRoundBad_mu {F : Subfield K} (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (G : (Fin 14 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (strat : (Fin 14 → K) → (j : Fin 10) → (Fin j.val → K) → K[X])
    (r : Fin 24 → K) (x : K) :
    semRoundBad t pub B G strat 13 (semPrefix r 13) x ↔
      BadMu
        (mle 10 (lanesComp (r 2) (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B)) (semSlice r 3 10))
        (bsumB 10 (fun b => t 26 (rowOf b)))
        (bsumB 10 (fun b =>
          (1 - copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel (rowOf b)))) * t 26 (rowOf b))) x := by
  have h0 : (13 : Fin 24).val ≠ 0 := by decide
  have h1 : (13 : Fin 24).val ≠ 1 := by decide
  have h2 : (13 : Fin 24).val ≠ 2 := by decide
  have hz : ¬ (13 : Fin 24).val < 13 := by decide
  have hm : (13 : Fin 24).val = 13 := rfl
  have hp0 : semPrefixVal (semPrefix r 13) 0 = r 0 :=
    semPrefixVal_actual r 13 0 (by decide)
  have hp1 : semPrefixVal (semPrefix r 13) 1 = r 1 :=
    semPrefixVal_actual r 13 1 (by decide)
  have hp2 : semPrefixVal (semPrefix r 13) 2 = r 2 :=
    semPrefixVal_actual r 13 2 (by decide)
  have hslice := semSlice_prefix_actual r 13 3 10 (by decide)
  simp only [semRoundBad, dif_neg h0, dif_neg h1, dif_neg h2, dif_neg hz,
    dif_pos hm, hp0, hp1, hp2, hslice]

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms semRoundBad_mu

private theorem semRoundBad_alpha {F : Subfield K} (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (G : (Fin 14 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (strat : (Fin 14 → K) → (j : Fin 10) → (Fin j.val → K) → K[X])
    (r : Fin 24 → K) (j : Fin 10) (x : K) :
    semRoundBad t pub B G strat ⟨14 + j.val, by omega⟩
        (semPrefix r ⟨14 + j.val, by omega⟩) x ↔
      alphaRound 27 10 (G (semSlice r 0 14))
        (SemBadSets.strategyPolys (strat (semSlice r 0 14)) (semSlice r 14 10))
        j (alphaRoundPrefix (semSlice r 14 10) j) x := by
  let i : Fin 24 := ⟨14 + j.val, by omega⟩
  change semRoundBad t pub B G strat i (semPrefix r i) x ↔ _
  have h0 : i.val ≠ 0 := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have h1 : i.val ≠ 1 := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have h2 : i.val ≠ 2 := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have hz : ¬ i.val < 13 := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have hm : i.val ≠ 13 := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have hj : (⟨i.val - 14, by dsimp [i]; omega⟩ : Fin 10) = j := by
    apply Fin.ext
    dsimp [i]
    omega
  have hpre14 : semSlice (semPrefix r i) 0 14 = semSlice r 0 14 :=
    semSlice_prefix_actual r i 0 14 (by dsimp [i]; omega)
  have hapre : semSlice (semPrefix r i) 14 j.val =
      alphaRoundPrefix (semSlice r 14 10) j := by
    rw [semSlice_prefix_actual r i 14 j.val (by dsimp [i]; omega)]
    rfl
  simp only [semRoundBad, dif_neg h0, dif_neg h1, dif_neg h2, dif_neg hz,
    dif_neg hm, hpre14]
  have hview := congrArg (fun k : Fin 10 =>
    alphaRound 27 10 (G (semSlice r 0 14))
      (fun _ => strat (semSlice r 0 14) k (semSlice (semPrefix r i) 14 k.val))
      k (semSlice (semPrefix r i) 14 k.val) x) hj
  rw [hapre] at hview
  exact Iff.of_eq hview

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms semRoundBad_alpha

/-- Avoiding every source-ordered round event avoids all five bad events
consumed by the closed semantic theorem. -/
theorem semRounds_cover {F : Subfield K} (t : Trace K) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (G : (Fin 14 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (strat : (Fin 14 → K) → (j : Fin 10) → (Fin j.val → K) → K[X])
    (r : Fin 24 → K)
    (hrounds : ∀ i, ¬ semRoundBad t pub B G strat i (semPrefix r i) (r i)) :
    (¬ BadLogUp pub t (r 0) (r 1)) ∧
    (¬ BadTheta (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B) (r 2)) ∧
    (¬ BadZc (lanesComp (r 2) (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B)) (semSlice r 3 10)) ∧
    (¬ BadMu
      (mle 10 (lanesComp (r 2) (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B)) (semSlice r 3 10))
      (bsumB 10 (fun b => t 26 (rowOf b)))
      (bsumB 10 (fun b =>
        (1 - copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel (rowOf b)))) * t 26 (rowOf b))) (r 13)) ∧
    (¬ BadAlpha 27 10 (G (semSlice r 0 14))
      (SemBadSets.strategyPolys (strat (semSlice r 0 14)) (semSlice r 14 10))
      (semSlice r 14 10)) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hbad
    rcases (badLogUp_rounds_iff pub t (r 0) (r 1)).mp hbad with hchi | hlam
    · exact hrounds 1 ((semRoundBad_one t pub B G strat r (r 1)).mpr hchi)
    · exact hrounds 0 ((semRoundBad_zero t pub B G strat r (r 0)).mpr hlam)
  · intro hbad
    exact hrounds 2 ((semRoundBad_two t pub B G strat r (r 2)).mpr hbad)
  · rintro ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, hzero⟩
    have hfun : lanesComp (r 2) (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B) ≠ 0 := by
      intro heq
      exact hb (congrFun heq b)
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (zc_rounds_iff 10
      (lanesComp (r 2) (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B)) (semSlice r 3 10)).mp ⟨hfun, hzero⟩
    rw [semSlice_actual r 3 10 (by decide) j] at hj
    exact hrounds ⟨3 + j.val, by omega⟩
      ((semRoundBad_zc t pub B G strat r j _).mpr hj)
  · intro hbad
    exact hrounds 13 ((semRoundBad_mu t pub B G strat r (r 13)).mpr hbad)
  · intro hbad
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (badAlpha_iff_exists_round 27 10 (G (semSlice r 0 14))
      (SemBadSets.strategyPolys (strat (semSlice r 0 14)) (semSlice r 14 10))
      (semSlice r 14 10)).mp hbad
    rw [semSlice_actual r 14 10 (by decide) j] at hj
    exact hrounds ⟨14 + j.val, by omega⟩
      ((semRoundBad_alpha t pub B G strat r j _).mpr hj)

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms semRounds_cover

/-- The closed semantic theorem with source-ordered round-event exclusions.
Only the five bad-set hypotheses are supplied through `semRounds_cover`. -/
theorem semantic_sound_rounds (P : Nat) [CharP K P] (hP : P = 2 ^ 31 - 1)
    (F : Subfield K) (B : PackBasis F) (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K)
    (hA : BaseTyped F t) (hpub : PublicBase F pub)
    (r : Fin 24 → K) (G : (Fin 14 → K) → (Fin 10 → K) → K)
    (strat : (Fin 14 → K) → (j : Fin 10) → (Fin j.val → K) → K[X])
    (hG : ∀ b, G (semSlice r 0 14) (ofBool b) =
      eqwB 10 (semSlice r 3 10) b * lanesComp (r 2) (laneOf t pub (r 0) (r 1) B) b +
      r 13 * t 26 (rowOf b) +
      (r 13) ^ 2 * ((1 - copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel (rowOf b)))) * t 26 (rowOf b)))
    (hdeg : IndDeg 27 10 (G (semSlice r 0 14)))
    (hacc : accept 27 10 (G (semSlice r 0 14)) 0
      (SemBadSets.strategyPolys (strat (semSlice r 0 14)) (semSlice r 14 10)) (semSlice r 14 10))
    (hrounds : ∀ i, ¬ semRoundBad t pub B G strat i (semPrefix r i) (r i)) :
    ProductionHolds pub (r 0) (r 1) t ∧ CopyLinkBalance pub t := by
  obtain ⟨hlc, htheta, hzc, hmu, halpha⟩ := semRounds_cover t pub B G strat r hrounds
  exact semantic_sound_closed P hP F B pub t hA hpub
    (r 0) (r 1) (r 2) (r 13) (semSlice r 3 10) hlc
    (G (semSlice r 0 14))
    (SemBadSets.strategyPolys (strat (semSlice r 0 14)) (semSlice r 14 10))
    (semSlice r 14 10) hG hdeg hacc halpha hmu hzc htheta

set_option pp.fullNames true in
#print axioms semantic_sound_rounds

end R0P

AspisV8R19.R417Q22SuccessLaw.text:
import AspisV8R19.R411EqualLegalQueryMass
import AspisV8R19.R412LegalQueryEnumeration
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp

/-! The bounded independent-answer q22 kernel has a uniform successful
marginal, multiplied by its actual success mass. Failure is not conditioned
away; no law for the shared source oracle or publication is asserted. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.R417Q22SuccessLaw
open R407Q22CandidateKernel R411EqualLegalQueryMass R412LegalQueryEnumeration
open OracleResampling Q22WordScan Q22SamplerInvariants
noncomputable section
open scoped BigOperators

theorem mean_sum {X Y : Type} [Fintype X] [Fintype Y] (f : Y → X → ℚ) :
    mean (fun x => ∑ y, f y x) = ∑ y, mean (f y) := by
  simp only [mean, ← Finset.sum_div]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

theorem mean_scale {X : Type} [Fintype X] (f : X → ℚ) (c : ℚ) :
    mean (fun x => f x*c) = mean f*c := by
  simp only [mean, ← Finset.sum_mul]
  ring

theorem kernel_sum {Y : Type} [Fintype Y] (n : Nat) (q : ScanState)
    (f : Y → Except Nat (List Nat) → ℚ) :
    candidateKernel n q (fun r => ∑ y, f y r) = ∑ y, candidateKernel n q (f y) := by
  induction n generalizing q with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hd : q.draws < 64
      · simp only [candidateKernel, if_pos hd]
        rw [← mean_sum]
        apply mean_congr
        intro a
        split_ifs with hs
        · rfl
        · exact ih _
      · simp only [candidateKernel, if_neg hd]

theorem kernel_scale (n : Nat) (q : ScanState)
    (f : Except Nat (List Nat) → ℚ) (c : ℚ) :
    candidateKernel n q (fun r => f r*c) = candidateKernel n q f*c := by
  induction n generalizing q with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hd : q.draws < 64
      · simp only [candidateKernel, if_pos hd]
        rw [← mean_scale]
        apply mean_congr
        intro a
        split_ifs with hs
        · rfl
        · exact ih _
      · simp only [candidateKernel, if_neg hd]

theorem kernel_congr_valid (n : Nat) (q : ScanState) (hq : Valid q)
    (f g : Except Nat (List Nat) → ℚ)
    (heq : ∀ r, ResultValid r → f r = g r) :
    candidateKernel n q f = candidateKernel n q g := by
  induction n generalizing q with
  | zero => exact heq _ (finish_valid q hq)
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hd : q.draws < 64
      · simp only [candidateKernel, if_pos hd]
        apply mean_congr
        intro a
        have hv : Valid (scan q (List.ofFn (fun j => (a j).val))).1 := by
          apply scan_valid q _ hq
          intro x hx
          rcases List.mem_ofFn.mp hx with ⟨j, rfl⟩
          exact (a j).isLt
        split_ifs with hs
        · exact heq _ (finish_valid _ hv)
        · exact ih _ hv
      · simpa only [candidateKernel, if_neg hd] using heq _ (finish_valid q hq)

set_option linter.constructorNameAsVariable false in
theorem kernel_expansion (n : Nat) (test : Except Nat (List Nat) → ℚ)
    (herr : ∀ k, test (.error k) = 0) :
    candidateKernel n ⟨[],0⟩ test =
      ∑ u : LegalQuery, atomMass n (enumQuery u)*test (.ok (enumQuery u)) := by
  classical
  rw [kernel_congr_valid n ⟨[],0⟩ (by simp [Valid]) test
    (fun r => ∑ u : LegalQuery, if r = .ok (enumQuery u) then test (.ok (enumQuery u)) else 0)
    (fun r hr => test_eq_legal_sum r hr test herr), kernel_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro u hu
  have hf : (fun r : Except Nat (List Nat) =>
      if r = .ok (enumQuery u) then test (.ok (enumQuery u)) else 0) =
      (fun r => (if r = .ok (enumQuery u) then (1 : ℚ) else 0)*test (.ok (enumQuery u))) := by
    funext r
    split_ifs <;> simp
  rw [hf, kernel_scale]
  rfl

def successMass (n : Nat) : ℚ := candidateKernel n ⟨[],0⟩
  (fun r => match r with | .ok _ => 1 | .error _ => 0)

theorem success_mass_atom (n : Nat) (u : LegalQuery) :
    successMass n = atomMass n (enumQuery u)*(Fintype.card LegalQuery : ℚ) := by
  rw [successMass, kernel_expansion n _ (by intro k; rfl)]
  have heq : ∀ v : LegalQuery, atomMass n (enumQuery v) = atomMass n (enumQuery u) := by
    intro v
    exact equal_legal_atom_mass n v.1 u.1 v.2 u.2
  simp only [heq, mul_one, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  ring

theorem uniform_success (n : Nat) (u : LegalQuery)
    (test : Except Nat (List Nat) → ℚ) (herr : ∀ k, test (.error k) = 0) :
    candidateKernel n ⟨[],0⟩ test =
      successMass n * mean (fun v : LegalQuery => test (.ok (enumQuery v))) := by
  letI : Nonempty LegalQuery := ⟨u⟩
  have hc : (Fintype.card LegalQuery : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast (ne_of_gt (Fintype.card_pos))
  rw [kernel_expansion n test herr, success_mass_atom n u, mean]
  have heq : ∀ v : LegalQuery, atomMass n (enumQuery v) = atomMass n (enumQuery u) := by
    intro v
    exact equal_legal_atom_mass n v.1 u.1 v.2 u.2
  simp only [heq, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  field_simp

#print axioms mean_sum
#print axioms mean_scale
#print axioms kernel_sum
#print axioms kernel_scale
#print axioms kernel_congr_valid
#print axioms kernel_expansion
#print axioms success_mass_atom
#print axioms uniform_success
end
end AspisV8R19.R417Q22SuccessLaw

AspisV8R19.R411EqualLegalQueryMass.text:
import AspisV8R19.R409Q22Relabeling
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Fintype

/-! Equal unconditional atom masses for all legal ordered q22 lists in the
bounded independent-answer kernel. Failure mass is retained; no conditioning
on publication, source oracle freshness, or numerical loss is claimed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.R411EqualLegalQueryMass
open R409Q22Relabeling R407Q22CandidateKernel
noncomputable section

def atomMass (n : Nat) (xs : List Nat) : ℚ :=
  candidateKernel n ⟨[],0⟩ (fun r => if r = .ok xs then 1 else 0)

theorem rename_preimage (f : Nat ≃ Nat) (xs : List Nat)
    (r : Except Nat (List Nat)) :
    renameResult f r = .ok (xs.map f) ↔ r = .ok xs := by
  cases r with
  | error n => simp [renameResult]
  | ok ys =>
      simp only [renameResult,Except.ok.injEq]
      exact ⟨fun h => (List.map_injective_iff.mpr f.injective) h,
        fun h => congrArg (List.map f) h⟩

theorem atom_mass_permutation (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (2^18))) (n : Nat)
    (xs : List Nat) : atomMass n (xs.map (extend e)) = atomMass n xs := by
  unfold atomMass
  rw [empty_kernel_invariant e n]
  simp_rw [rename_preimage]

theorem equal_legal_atom_mass (n : Nat) (xs ys : Fin 22 → Fin (2^18))
    (hx : Function.Injective xs) (hy : Function.Injective ys) :
    atomMass n (List.ofFn (fun i => (xs i).val)) =
      atomMass n (List.ofFn (fun i => (ys i).val)) := by
  obtain ⟨e,he⟩ := Equiv.Perm.exists_extending_pair xs ys hx hy
  have hm : (List.ofFn (fun i => (xs i).val)).map (extend e) =
      List.ofFn (fun i => (ys i).val) := by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    congr 1
    funext i
    change extend e (xs i).val = (ys i).val
    rw [extend_value,he]
  exact ((atom_mass_permutation e n _).symm).trans (congrArg (atomMass n) hm)

#print axioms rename_preimage
#print axioms atom_mass_permutation
#print axioms equal_legal_atom_mass
end
end AspisV8R19.R411EqualLegalQueryMass

AspisV8R19.R409Q22Relabeling.text:
import AspisV8R19.R407Q22CandidateKernel
import Mathlib.Logic.Equiv.Basic

/-! Exact relabeling symmetry of the bounded q22 independent-answer kernel.
Stopping, error counts, and the 64-draw limit remain unchanged. This is not
yet a successful-query uniformity or shared-oracle probability bound. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.R409Q22Relabeling
open Q22WordScan R407Q22CandidateKernel OracleResampling
noncomputable section

def renameState (f : Nat ≃ Nat) (q : ScanState) : ScanState :=
  ⟨q.accepted.map f,q.draws⟩

def renameResult (f : Nat ≃ Nat) : Except Nat (List Nat) → Except Nat (List Nat)
  | .error n => .error n
  | .ok xs => .ok (xs.map f)

theorem keep_rename (f : Nat ≃ Nat) (xs : List Nat) (x : Nat) :
    keep (xs.map f) (f x) = (keep xs x).map f := by
  have hm : f x ∈ xs.map f ↔ x ∈ xs := by
    constructor
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨y,hy,he⟩ := List.mem_map.mp h
      exact (f.injective he) ▸ hy
    · exact List.mem_map_of_mem
  by_cases h : x ∈ xs <;> simp [keep,hm,h]

theorem scan_rename (f : Nat ≃ Nat) (q : ScanState) (xs : List Nat) :
    scan (renameState f q) (xs.map f) =
      (renameState f (scan q xs).1,(scan q xs).2) := by
  induction xs generalizing q with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      by_cases stop : q.accepted.length = 22 ∨ q.draws = 64
      · simp [scan,renameState,stop]
      · simp only [List.map_cons,scan,renameState,List.length_map,if_neg stop]
        rw [keep_rename]
        exact ih ⟨keep q.accepted x,q.draws+1⟩

theorem finish_rename (f : Nat ≃ Nat) (q : ScanState) :
    finish (renameState f q) = renameResult f (finish q) := by
  by_cases h : q.accepted.length = 22 <;> simp [finish,renameState,renameResult,h]

def extend (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (2^18))) : Equiv.Perm Nat :=
  e.extendDomain Fin.equivSubtype

theorem extend_value (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (2^18))) (x : Fin (2^18)) :
    extend e x.val = (e x).val := by
  exact e.extendDomain_apply_image (Fin.equivSubtype (n := 2^18)) x

def blockPerm (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (2^18))) :
    Equiv.Perm (Fin 8 → Fin (2^18)) := Equiv.piCongrRight (fun _ => e)

theorem block_values (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (2^18))) (c : Fin 8 → Fin (2^18)) :
    List.ofFn (fun j => (blockPerm e c j).val) =
      (List.ofFn (fun j => (c j).val)).map (extend e) := by
  rw [List.map_ofFn]
  congr 1
  funext j
  exact (extend_value e (c j)).symm

theorem candidate_kernel_rename (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (2^18))) (n : Nat)
    (q : ScanState) (test : Except Nat (List Nat) → ℚ) :
    candidateKernel n (renameState (extend e) q) test =
      candidateKernel n q (fun r => test (renameResult (extend e) r)) := by
  induction n generalizing q with
  | zero => simp only [candidateKernel,finish_rename]
  | succ n ih =>
      have hdraw : (renameState (extend e) q).draws = q.draws := rfl
      by_cases hd : q.draws < 64
      · simp only [candidateKernel,hdraw,if_pos hd]
        rw [← mean_equiv (blockPerm e) (fun c : Fin 8 → Fin (2^18) =>
          let r := scan (renameState (extend e) q) (List.ofFn (fun j => (c j).val))
          if r.2 then test (finish r.1) else candidateKernel n r.1 test)]
        apply mean_congr
        intro c
        rw [block_values,scan_rename]
        simp only [finish_rename,ih]
      · simp only [candidateKernel,hdraw,if_neg hd]
        exact congrArg test (finish_rename (extend e) q)

theorem empty_kernel_invariant (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin (2^18))) (n : Nat)
    (test : Except Nat (List Nat) → ℚ) :
    candidateKernel n ⟨[],0⟩ test =
      candidateKernel n ⟨[],0⟩ (fun r => test (renameResult (extend e) r)) :=
  candidate_kernel_rename e n ⟨[],0⟩ test

#print axioms keep_rename
#print axioms scan_rename
#print axioms finish_rename
#print axioms extend_value
#print axioms block_values
#print axioms candidate_kernel_rename
#print axioms empty_kernel_invariant
end
end AspisV8R19.R409Q22Relabeling

import AspisV8R19.R406SamplerWordDistribution
import AspisV8R19.R402Q22IndependentLaw

/-! Exact bounded q22 result kernel under the independent-answer interpreter.
Every block has eight uniform 18-bit words; the source scan, stopping flag,
64-draw limit, and error count are retained. No shared-oracle law is asserted. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.R407Q22CandidateKernel
open DuplexFrames SourceDuplexStep SourceOraclePrograms Q22WordScan SamplerWords
open MemoizedProgramLaw OracleProgramOps AdaptiveFirstReadLaw OracleResampling
noncomputable section

def candidateKernel : Nat → ScanState → (Except Nat (List Nat) → ℚ) → ℚ
  | 0,q,test => test (finish q)
  | n+1,q,test =>
      if q.draws < 64 then mean (fun candidates : Fin 8 → Fin (2^18) =>
        let r := scan q (List.ofFn (fun j => (candidates j).val))
        if r.2 then test (finish r.1) else candidateKernel n r.1 test)
      else test (finish q)

theorem loop_candidate_kernel (n : Nat) (s : State) (q : ScanState)
    (test : Except Nat (List Nat) → ℚ) :
    independentMean (Q22SamplerProgram.loopProgram n s q) (fun view => test view.2.1) =
      candidateKernel n q test := by
  induction n generalizing s q with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      by_cases hd : q.draws < 64
      · simp only [Q22SamplerProgram.loopProgram, candidateKernel, if_pos hd,
          independentMean_bind, squeezeProgram, independentMean]
        rw [← R406SamplerWordDistribution.uniform_candidates (fun xs =>
          let r := scan q xs
          if r.2 then test (finish r.1) else candidateKernel n r.1 test)]
        apply mean_congr
        intro out
        by_cases hs : (scan q (words 18 out)).2 = true
        · simp only [hs, ↓reduceIte, independentMean]
          exact mean_const _
        · have hf : (scan q (words 18 out)).2 = false := by
            cases h : (scan q (words 18 out)).2 <;> simp_all
          simp only [hf, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]
          simp_rw [ih]
          exact mean_const _
      · simp only [Q22SamplerProgram.loopProgram, candidateKernel, if_neg hd,
          independentMean]

theorem challenge_candidate_kernel (s : State)
    (test : Except Nat (List Nat) → ℚ) :
    independentMean (Q22SamplerProgram.challengeProgram s) (fun view => test view.2.1) =
      candidateKernel 8 ⟨[],0⟩ test := loop_candidate_kernel 8 s ⟨[],0⟩ test

#print axioms loop_candidate_kernel
#print axioms challenge_candidate_kernel
end
end AspisV8R19.R407Q22CandidateKernel

AspisV8R19.R402Q22IndependentLaw.text:
import AspisV8R19.AdaptiveFirstReadLaw
import AspisV8R19.Q22SamplerProgram

/-! State irrelevance of the complete bounded q22 result kernel in the
independent-answer interpreter. Errors and stopping remain in the result.
This does not assert source/shared-oracle freshness or uniform query tuples. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.R402Q22IndependentLaw
open DuplexFrames SourceDuplexStep SourceOraclePrograms Q22WordScan
open MemoizedProgramLaw OracleProgramOps AdaptiveFirstReadLaw
open AspisV8PairedCommitment
noncomputable section

theorem loop_state_irrelevance (n : Nat) (q : ScanState) (s s' : State)
    (test : Except Nat (List Nat) → ℚ) :
    independentMean (Q22SamplerProgram.loopProgram n s q) (fun view => test view.2.1) =
      independentMean (Q22SamplerProgram.loopProgram n s' q) (fun view => test view.2.1) := by
  cases n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n =>
      by_cases hd : q.draws < 64
      · simp only [Q22SamplerProgram.loopProgram, if_pos hd,
          independentMean_bind, squeezeProgram, independentMean]
      · simp only [Q22SamplerProgram.loopProgram, if_neg hd, independentMean]

theorem challenge_state_irrelevance (s s' : State)
    (test : Except Nat (List Nat) → ℚ) :
    independentMean (Q22SamplerProgram.challengeProgram s) (fun view => test view.2.1) =
      independentMean (Q22SamplerProgram.challengeProgram s') (fun view => test view.2.1) :=
  loop_state_irrelevance 8 ⟨[],0⟩ s s' test

theorem fresh_table_kernel (s s' : State)
    (t t' : Table Bytes State)
    (fresh : FreshFrom (Q22SamplerProgram.challengeProgram s) t)
    (fresh' : FreshFrom (Q22SamplerProgram.challengeProgram s') t')
    (test : Except Nat (List Nat) → ℚ) :
    lazyMean (Q22SamplerProgram.challengeProgram s) t (fun view => test view.2.1) =
      lazyMean (Q22SamplerProgram.challengeProgram s') t' (fun view => test view.2.1) := by
  rw [lazyMean_eq_independentMean _ _ fresh,
    lazyMean_eq_independentMean _ _ fresh']
  exact challenge_state_irrelevance s s' test

#print axioms loop_state_irrelevance
#print axioms challenge_state_irrelevance
#print axioms fresh_table_kernel
end
end AspisV8R19.R402Q22IndependentLaw

R1TraceWitnessExtract.text:
import R1ComputableTraceWitness
import R1TraceValueDecode
import R1ConcreteSpendExtraction

/-! Executable reconstruction and checking of a spend witness from one trace.
This is not the full-log extractor: commitment recovery and complete efficient
list decoding must still supply the candidate trace. Returned witnesses are
always checked; completeness here assumes the stated production facts. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxRecDepth 4096
namespace AspisR1.TraceWitnessExtract

open R0P SpendRelation AspisWideTower AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
abbrev E := WideExact
abbrev embed := ExactBaseProjection.embed

def extract (pub : Public M31Exact) (A : Trace E) : Option Wspend :=
  match TraceValueDecode.decode A with
  | none => none
  | some values =>
      let w := ComputableTraceWitness.fromTrace A values.1 values.2.1 values.2.2
      if checkM31 pub w = true then some w else none

theorem returned_checked (pub : Public M31Exact) (A : Trace E) (w : Wspend)
    (h : extract pub A = some w) : checkM31 pub w = true := by
  cases hd : TraceValueDecode.decode A with
  | none => simp [extract, hd] at h
  | some values =>
      simp only [extract, hd] at h
      split at h
      next hc =>
        have hw := Option.some.inj h
        exact hw ▸ hc
      next hc => contradiction

theorem returned_valid (pub : Public M31Exact) (A : Trace E) (w : Wspend)
    (h : extract pub A = some w) : Rspend pub w :=
  (check_eq_true_iff pub w).mp (returned_checked pub A w h)

attribute [local irreducible] poseidonPermutation nodeCompress merkleRoot
attribute [local irreducible] ConcreteBinding.candidates

theorem complete_of_production (pub : Public M31Exact) (A : Trace E) (lam chi : E)
    (hshape : PublicOptionShape.canonical pub)
    (hbase : BaseTyped embed.fieldRange A)
    (h : ProductionHolds (SpendDataMap.mapPublic embed pub) lam chi A ∧
      CopyLinkBalance (SpendDataMap.mapPublic embed pub) A) :
    ∃ w : Wspend, extract pub A = some w ∧ Rspend pub w := by
  letI : CharP E P :=
    charP_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap M31Exact E).injective P
  let widePub := SpendDataMap.mapPublic embed pub
  have hwideShape : PublicOptionShape.canonical widePub :=
    (SpendRelationMap.canonical_map_iff embed embed.injective pub).mpr hshape
  obtain ⟨v0, v1, v2, h0, h1, h2, hbalance, e0, e1, e2, hinput⟩ :=
    InputWitness.bounded_of_production P (by norm_num [P]) widePub A lam chi h
  have hfacts := SpendSemantics.of_production P (by norm_num [P]) widePub A lam chi h
  let ww := TraceSpendWitness.fromTrace A ⟨v0, h0⟩ ⟨v1, h1⟩ ⟨v2, h2⟩
  have hw : Rspend widePub ww := by
    refine ⟨hwideShape, hinput, hbalance, ?_, ?_,
      SpendRelationExtraction.append_of_production P (by norm_num [P])
        widePub A lam chi hwideShape h⟩
    · simpa only [changeCommitment, ww, TraceSpendWitness.fromTrace, e2] using hfacts.change
    · cases hv : widePub.variant with
      | privateTransfer =>
          obtain ⟨recipient, hr, _⟩ :=
            PublicOptionShape.private_transfer_shape widePub hv hwideShape
          rw [variantOutput, hv, hr]
          apply congrArg some
          simpa only [recipientCommitment, ww, TraceSpendWitness.fromTrace, e1] using
            hfacts.recipient hv recipient hr
      | withdrawal =>
          obtain ⟨amount, _, ha, _⟩ :=
            PublicOptionShape.withdrawal_shape widePub hv hwideShape
          rw [variantOutput, hv, ha]
          apply congrArg some
          exact (hfacts.withdrawal hv amount ha).symm.trans e1
  let w := ComputableTraceWitness.fromTrace A ⟨v0, h0⟩ ⟨v1, h1⟩ ⟨v2, h2⟩
  have hwvalid : Rspend pub w := by
    rw [show w = SpendBaseDescent.projectWitness ww from
      ComputableTraceWitness.fromTrace_eq_projected_existing A _ _ _ hbase]
    exact SpendBaseDescent.rspend_project pub ww
      (TraceSpendWitness.base_coordinates A _ _ _ hbase) hw
  have hcheck : checkM31 pub w = true := (check_eq_true_iff pub w).mpr hwvalid
  have hdecode := TraceValueDecode.decode_of_values A
    (⟨v0, h0⟩ : Fin (2^30)) ⟨v1, h1⟩ ⟨v2, h2⟩ e0 e1 e2
  refine ⟨w, ?_, hwvalid⟩
  simp only [extract, hdecode]
  change (if checkM31 pub w = true then some w else none) = some w
  rw [if_pos hcheck]

theorem complete_of_candidate
    (pub : Public M31Exact) (hshape : PublicOptionShape.canonical pub)
    (eK : QM31Exact →+* E)
    (c1Packed c2Packed : Fin 262144 → Option (List ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte))
    (t : ConcreteBinding.Tuple E)
    (ht : t ∈ ConcreteBinding.candidates
      (TypedRecoveredWords.word embed eK c1Packed c2Packed))
    (lam chi : E)
    (h : ProductionHolds (SpendDataMap.mapPublic embed pub) lam chi
        (SemSource.rowsOf rowEquiv t) ∧
      CopyLinkBalance (SpendDataMap.mapPublic embed pub) (SemSource.rowsOf rowEquiv t)) :
    ∃ w : Wspend, extract pub (SemSource.rowsOf rowEquiv t) = some w ∧ Rspend pub w :=
  complete_of_production pub (SemSource.rowsOf rowEquiv t) lam chi hshape
    (CandidateBaseProjection.rows_base_typed eK c1Packed c2Packed t ht) h

#print axioms returned_checked
#print axioms returned_valid
#print axioms complete_of_production
#print axioms complete_of_candidate
end AspisR1.TraceWitnessExtract

import R1TraceSpendWitness
import R1SpendBaseDescent
import R1SpendDataMap
import R1ExactBaseProjection

/-! A computable M31 witness selector from a wide trace. The branch test is
performed after explicit base projection; the theorem below shows this agrees
with the existing noncomputable wide-field path selector when the trace is
base-typed. This constructs data only and proves no spend validity. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.ComputableTraceWitness

open R0P
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
open AspisWideTower
open AspisR1.SpendRelation

abbrev E := WideExact
abbrev F := AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed.fieldRange

def pathFromTrace (A : Trace E) : Fin 24 → Bool × Digest M31Exact :=
  fun level =>
    let b := pathBaseRow level
    let left : Digest M31Exact := fun i =>
      AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project
        (A ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ (succRow b))
    let right : Digest M31Exact := fun i =>
      AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project
        (A ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ (succRow b))
    if AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project (A 0 b) = 0 then
      (false, right)
    else
      (true, left)

def fromTrace (A : Trace E) (v0 v1 v2 : Fin (2^30)) : Wspend :=
  { inputValue := v0
    outputValue := v1
    changeValue := v2
    sk := SpendDataMap.digest AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project (traceSk A)
    salt := SpendDataMap.digest AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project (traceSalt A)
    path := pathFromTrace A
    pair := SpendDataMap.pair AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project (AspisR1.InputPair.leaf A)
    recipientOwner := SpendDataMap.digest AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project
      (AspisR1.OutputNotes.chunk A 27)
    recipientSalt := SpendDataMap.digest AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project
      (AspisR1.OutputNotes.salt A 28 29)
    changeOwner := SpendDataMap.digest AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project
      (AspisR1.OutputNotes.chunk A 30)
    changeSalt := SpendDataMap.digest AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project
      (AspisR1.OutputNotes.salt A 31 32) }

theorem pathFromTrace_eq (A : Trace E) (hA : BaseTyped F A) :
    pathFromTrace A =
      SpendDataMap.path AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project (tracePath A) := by
  funext level
  let b := pathBaseRow level
  have hzero : AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project (A 0 b) = 0 ↔ A 0 b = 0 := by
    constructor
    · intro hp
      have hc : A 0 b ∈ F := hA 0 (by decide) b
      have he := AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed_project_of_mem_fieldRange hc
      rw [hp] at he
      simpa using he.symm
    · intro hz
      rw [hz]
      rfl
  classical
  by_cases hz : A 0 b = 0
  · have hp : AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project (A 0 b) = 0 := hzero.mpr hz
    have hleft : pathFromTrace A level = (false, fun i =>
        AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project
          (A ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ (succRow b))) := by
      simp [pathFromTrace, b, hp]
    have hright : SpendDataMap.path AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project
        (tracePath A) level = (false, fun i =>
          AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project
            (A ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ (succRow b))) := by
      simp [SpendDataMap.path, tracePath, b, hz]
      rfl
    rw [hleft, hright]
  · have hp : AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project (A 0 b) ≠ 0 :=
      fun h => hz (hzero.mp h)
    have hleft : pathFromTrace A level = (true, fun i =>
        AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project
          (A ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ (succRow b))) := by
      simp [pathFromTrace, b, hp]
    have hright : SpendDataMap.path AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project
        (tracePath A) level = (true, fun i =>
          AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.project
            (A ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ (succRow b))) := by
      simp [SpendDataMap.path, tracePath, b, hz]
      rfl
    rw [hleft, hright]

theorem fromTrace_eq_projected_existing (A : Trace E) (v0 v1 v2 : Fin (2^30))
    (hA : BaseTyped F A) :
    fromTrace A v0 v1 v2 =
      AspisR1.SpendBaseDescent.projectWitness
        (AspisR1.TraceSpendWitness.fromTrace A v0 v1 v2) := by
  rw [fromTrace, AspisR1.SpendBaseDescent.projectWitness,
    SpendDataMap.witness, pathFromTrace_eq A hA]
  rfl

#print axioms pathFromTrace_eq
#print axioms fromTrace_eq_projected_existing

end AspisR1.ComputableTraceWitness

import R1LiteralTerminalSpend
import R1LiteralOpeningRunGood
import R1LiteralQueryRhoTranscriptSupport
import R1LiteralPairingChecks

/-! A transcript-indexed wrapper for the conditional literal terminal theorem.
Good, accepted pairing and matching-set cardinality are derived from the
no-hit transcript and the explicit coefficient/query check equations. This does not claim source refinement,
accepted-reader coverage, or probability closure. -/

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1.LiteralTerminalRunSpend

open R0P R0P.Mask R0P.SemSource R0P.SemRounds R0C.SemStatement
open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
open AspisWideTower AspisCircleGroupOrder SpendRelation
open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7

attribute [local irreducible] LiteralClassifier.bad MatchingSupport.Good
  MatchingSupport.AcceptedPairing MatchingSupport.matchingSet
  MatchingSupport.match0 QueryResidualBridge.residuals sumcheckChecksZ

theorem checked_witness_of_transcript_read_noHit
    (decoder : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder)
    (H : LiteralByteProtocol.Address → LiteralByteProtocol.State)
    (pub : LiteralTranscript.Public)
    (pf : LiteralByteProtocol.Proof)
    (n : Nat) (hn : 33 ≤ n)
    (decoded : R0P.Public SemanticPublicWire.M31)
    (v : LiteralOpeningView.View)
    (d : MatchingSupport.Data AspisWideTower.WideExact)
    (hpub : SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic pub.pubBytes = some decoded)
    (hmatching : LiteralMatchingData.read
      ((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder).transcript H pub pf n).rounds = some d)
    (hview : LiteralOpeningView.read
      ((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder).transcript H pub pf n).rounds = some v)
    (hno : ¬ GenericNoHit.hitFrom LiteralClassifier.bad pub []
      ((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder).transcript H pub pf n).rounds)
    (hpairing : LiteralPairingChecks.checks
      ((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder).transcript H pub pf n).rounds)
    (m31 : LiteralTranscript.Message) (xs : List Nat)
    (s31 : LiteralByteProtocol.State) (m32 : LiteralTranscript.Message)
    (rho : AspisWideTower.WideExact) (s32 : LiteralByteProtocol.State)
    (h31 : ((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder).transcript H pub pf n).rounds[31]? =
      some (m31, (TranscriptView.Value.queries (.ok xs), s31)))
    (h32 : ((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder).transcript H pub pf n).rounds[32]? =
      some (m32, (TranscriptView.Value.ordinary rho, s32)))
    (hvalid31 : LiteralTranscript.valid 31 m31)
    (hvalid32 : LiteralTranscript.valid 32 m32)
    (q : Fin 22 → Fin 262144)
    (hdecode : LiteralQueryRead.decode xs = some q)
    (hfirst : ∀ j, MatchingSupport.match0 d (q j))
    (hbatch : ∑ j : Fin 22,
      (LiteralOpeningView.eK (SelectedChallengeMap.rhoOf rho)) ^ j.val *
        QueryResidualBridge.residuals d q j = 0)
    (claim : AspisWideTower.WideExact)
    (polys : Fin 10 → Polynomial AspisWideTower.WideExact)
    (hclaim : claimOf
      (SelectedSemanticPrefixFacts.lift v.semantic) = some claim)
    (hpolys : semPolysZ
      (SelectedSemanticPrefixFacts.lift v.semantic) = some polys)
    (checks : sumcheckChecksZ (maskClaimsR0 ConcretePackBasis.basis)
      (SpendDataMap.mapPublic ExactBaseProjection.embed decoded)
      ConcretePackBasis.basis
      (fun j => (v.semantic.map Prod.snd).getD j.val 0)
      ((v.semantic.map Prod.snd).getD 14 0) claim
      (fun j => (v.semantic.map Prod.snd).getD (15 + j.val) 0) polys
      (fun j l => d.Y ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ l) (d.Y 3)) :
    ∃ w : Wspend, checkM31 decoded w = true := by
  let rs := ((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder).transcript H pub pf n).rounds
  have hgood : MatchingSupport.Good d :=
    LiteralOpeningRunGood.good_of_transcript_read_noHit
      decoder H pub pf n (by omega) d hmatching hno
  have haccepted : MatchingSupport.AcceptedPairing d :=
    (LiteralPairingChecks.acceptedPairing_iff_checks rs d hmatching).mpr hpairing
  have hlen : 33 ≤ rs.length := by
    have hround : rs.length = n :=
      LiteralByteRunFacts.transcript_round decoder H pub pf n
    omega
  have hcard := LiteralQueryRhoTranscriptSupport.large_support_of_read_noHit
    pub rs hlen d hmatching hno m31 xs s31 m32 rho s32 h31 h32
    hvalid31 hvalid32 q hdecode hfirst hbatch
  exact LiteralTerminalSpend.checked_witness_of_read_noHit
    pub decoded rs v d hpub hmatching hview hno hgood haccepted hcard
    claim polys hclaim hpolys checks

#print axioms checked_witness_of_transcript_read_noHit

end AspisR1.LiteralTerminalRunSpend
end

import R1LiteralOpeningPrefixFacts
import R1LiteralSemanticParserFacts
import R1LiteralSemanticExcludedLift
import R1GenericNoHitIndex
import R1LiteralMatchingSemanticData
import R1LiteralTypedWords
import R1LiteralTypedContext
import R1LiteralSpendExtraction
import R1SemanticPrefix
import R1LiteralSemanticTerminalBridge
import R1PublicBaseMap
import R1SpendDataMap
import R1SemanticPublicWire

/-! Conditional composition of literal readers with the existing semantic
terminal extractor. Accepted pairing, matching-set size, and semantic check
equations remain explicit premises. Source refinement, accepted-reader
coverage, and probability closure are not established here. -/

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1.LiteralTerminalSpend

open R0P R0P.Mask R0P.SemSource R0P.SemRounds R0C.SemStatement
open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
open AspisWideTower AspisCircleGroupOrder SpendRelation
open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7

attribute [local irreducible] AspisR0.ListsResponses.Lambda LambdaRows
  AspisR1.InitialResponses.Lambda ConcreteBinding.candidates
  LiteralClassifier.bad semanticBadZ MatchingSupport.Good
  MatchingSupport.AcceptedPairing MatchingSupport.matchingSet sumcheckChecksZ
  SelectedOpeningFunctionals.functionals SelectedOpeningFunctionals.rawBase
  SelectedOpeningFunctionals.rows RawOpening.withRows

abbrev E := WideExact
abbrev embed := ExactBaseProjection.embed
abbrev eK := LiteralSemanticView.eK

theorem checked_witness_of_read_noHit
    (pub : LiteralTranscript.Public)
    (decoded : R0P.Public SemanticPublicWire.M31)
    (rs : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (v : LiteralOpeningView.View)
    (d : MatchingSupport.Data E)
    (hpub : SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic pub.pubBytes = some decoded)
    (hmatching : LiteralMatchingData.read rs = some d)
    (hview : LiteralOpeningView.read rs = some v)
    (hno : ¬ GenericNoHit.hitFrom LiteralClassifier.bad pub [] rs)
    (hgood : MatchingSupport.Good d)
    (haccepted : MatchingSupport.AcceptedPairing d)
    (hcard : 9558 ≤ (MatchingSupport.matchingSet d).card)
    (claim : E) (polys : Fin 10 → Polynomial E)
    (hclaim : claimOf (SelectedSemanticPrefixFacts.lift v.semantic) = some claim)
    (hpolys : semPolysZ (SelectedSemanticPrefixFacts.lift v.semantic) = some polys)
    (checks : sumcheckChecksZ (maskClaimsR0 ConcretePackBasis.basis)
      (SpendDataMap.mapPublic embed decoded) ConcretePackBasis.basis
      (fun j => (v.semantic.map Prod.snd).getD j.val 0)
      ((v.semantic.map Prod.snd).getD 14 0) claim
      (fun j => (v.semantic.map Prod.snd).getD (15 + j.val) 0) polys
      (fun j l => d.Y ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ l) (d.Y 3)) :
    ∃ w : Wspend, checkM31 decoded w = true := by
  let rs25 := rs.take 25

  -- Prefix readers, the recovered C2 identity and semantic payload parsing.
  have hprefix := LiteralOpeningPrefixFacts.read_prefix_components
    rs v hview
  rcases hprefix with ⟨hlen25, hc1, hc2, hsem, hword⟩
  have hno25 : ¬ GenericNoHit.hitFrom LiteralClassifier.bad pub [] rs25 :=
    GenericNoHitIndex.noHit_take LiteralClassifier.bad pub rs 25 hno
  have hexcluded := LiteralSemanticExcludedLift.excluded_lift
    pub decoded v.c1 rs25 v.semantic hpub hc1 hsem hno25
  obtain ⟨payloads, challenges, _hrounds, _hsemChals, hc2Z,
      _hclaimRows, _hpolysRows, _hdegree⟩ :=
    LiteralSemanticParserFacts.read_projection_facts eK rs25 v.semantic v.c2
      hsem hlen25 hc2

  -- The fixed literal semantic context and its C2 callback reproduce W.
  let x := LiteralTypedContext.context embed eK
    (SpendDataMap.mapPublic embed decoded)
    (PublicBaseMap.mapPublic_base embed decoded) v.c1 (fun _ => 0)
  let S := LiteralTypedWords.laneSubfield embed eK
  let F := embed.fieldRange
  let B := ConcretePackBasis.basis
  let cs := v.semantic.map Prod.snd
  let hw : InitialWord E := (LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK v.c2).1
  let gw : InitialWord E := (LiteralSemanticPrefix.c2Pair eK v.c2).2
  have htransport : x.transport = AspisR1.rowEquiv := rfl
  have hpubTyped : PublicBase F x.pub := x.pubBase
  obtain ⟨common, hcommon, hW, hF, hF0⟩ :=
    LiteralMatchingSemanticData.read_matches_view rs d hmatching
  have hcommonEq : common = v := Option.some.inj (hcommon.symm.trans hview)
  subst common
  have hWliteral : d.W = LiteralTypedWords.word embed eK v.c1 v.c2 :=
    hW.trans hword
  have htyped : CandidateDescent.WordTyped S d.W := by
    rw [hWliteral]
    exact LiteralTypedWords.word_typed embed eK v.c1 v.c2
  have hpair : R0P.SemSource.c2Words x hw gw =
      LiteralTypedWords.word embed eK v.c1 v.c2 :=
    LiteralSemanticPayloadBridge.pair_c2Words
      embed eK (SpendDataMap.mapPublic embed decoded)
      (PublicBaseMap.mapPublic_base embed decoded) v.c1 v.c2 (fun _ => 0)
  have hwords : d.W = R0P.SemSource.c2Words x hw gw :=
    hWliteral.trans hpair.symm
  have hlanesF : ∀ l : Fin 29, l.val < 26 → S l = F := by
    intro l hl
    simp [S, F, LiteralTypedWords.laneSubfield,
      TypedRecoveredWords.laneSubfield, hl]

  -- The reader supplies the selected functionals. The generic bridge
  -- transports the matching predicates before specializing the field.
  obtain ⟨hviewF, hviewF0⟩ :=
    LiteralOpeningFunctionalFacts.read_functionals rs v hview

  -- Apply the old semantic terminal theorem with precisely its hypotheses.
  have hchecks' : sumcheckChecksZ (maskClaimsR0 B) x.pub B
      (fun j => cs.getD j.val 0) (cs.getD 14 0) claim
      (fun j => cs.getD (15 + j.val) 0) polys
      (fun j l => d.Y ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ l) (d.Y 3) := checks
  letI : CharP E AspisCircleGroupOrder.P :=
    charP_of_injective_algebraMap (algebraMap M31Exact E).injective AspisCircleGroupOrder.P
  -- Use the concrete carrier here: a local abbreviation makes the Point
  -- subtype conversion normalize the concrete tower unnecessarily.
  have terminal0 := LiteralSemanticTerminalBridge.large_matching_extracts_of_literal_prefix
    (E := AspisWideTower.WideExact) AspisCircleGroupOrder.P (by norm_num [AspisCircleGroupOrder.P])
    S F hlanesF B x htransport hpubTyped d htyped
  have terminalPoint := terminal0 (v.circlePoints 0)
  have terminalRounds := terminalPoint (SelectedSemanticPrefixFacts.lift v.semantic)
  have terminalChallenges := terminalRounds
    (by simpa [SelectedSemanticPrefixFacts.lift] using v.semantic_length)
    cs (by simpa [cs] using SelectedSemanticPrefixFacts.semChalsZ_lift v.semantic)
  have terminal1 := terminalChallenges claim hclaim polys hpolys
  have terminal2 := terminal1 hw gw
    (by simpa [hw, gw] using hc2Z) hwords
  have terminal3 := terminal2 (by
    intro i sm hmsg
    exact hexcluded i sm hmsg)
  have hresult := terminal3 v.circlePoints (hF.trans hviewF) (hF0.trans hviewF0)
    hgood haccepted hcard hchecks'
  rcases hresult with ⟨t, ht, ⟨hproduction, hcopy⟩, _⟩

  -- The checked extracted candidate is transported back to the M31 checker.
  have hshape : PublicOptionShape.canonical decoded :=
    SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic_canonical pub.pubBytes decoded hpub
  have hcandidate : t ∈ ConcreteBinding.candidates
      (LiteralTypedWords.word embed eK v.c1 v.c2) := by
    rw [hWliteral] at ht
    exact ht
  exact LiteralSpendExtraction.candidate_checked_witness decoded hshape
    eK v.c1 v.c2 t hcandidate (cs.getD 0 0) (cs.getD 1 0)
    ⟨hproduction, hcopy⟩

#print axioms checked_witness_of_read_noHit

end AspisR1.LiteralTerminalSpend
end

import R1LiteralQueryRhoSupport
import R1LiteralReadStability
import R1GenericNoHitIndex

/-! List plumbing for specializing the query/rho support implication to a
full literal transcript. This remains a deterministic model statement. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1.LiteralQueryRhoTranscriptSupport

open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript
open AspisR1.TranscriptView
open AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep

attribute [local irreducible] LiteralClassifier.bad MatchingSupport.matchingSet
  MatchingSupport.match0 QueryResidualBridge.residuals

theorem atQuery_current_eq_read
    (pub : LiteralTranscript.Public)
    (rs : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (hlen : 32 ≤ rs.length) :
    LiteralMatchingData.atQuery ⟨pub, rs.take 31⟩ (rs[31]'(by omega)).1 =
      LiteralMatchingData.read rs := by
  have h31 : (rs.take 31).length = 31 := by simp; omega
  have h32 : (rs.take 32).length = 32 := by simp; omega
  have hstable := LiteralReadStability.matchingData_append_stable
    (rs.take 32) (rs.drop 32) (by omega)
  have hdecomp : rs.take 32 ++ rs.drop 32 = rs := List.take_append_drop 32 rs
  rw [hdecomp] at hstable
  have htake : rs.take 32 = rs.take 31 ++ [rs[31]'(by omega)] := by
    rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem (by omega)]
  rw [LiteralMatchingData.atQuery, LiteralOpeningEvents.withMessage]
  rw [hstable, htake]
  have hc := LiteralQueryContext.matchingData_challenge_independent
    (rs.take 31) (rs[31]'(by omega)).1 (rs[31]'(by omega)).2
    (Value.ordinary 0, 0) h31
  simpa only using hc.symm

theorem large_support_of_read_noHit
    (pub : LiteralTranscript.Public)
    (rs : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (hlen : 33 ≤ rs.length)
    (d : MatchingSupport.Data AspisWideTower.WideExact)
    (hread : LiteralMatchingData.read rs = some d)
    (hno : ¬ GenericNoHit.hitFrom LiteralClassifier.bad pub [] rs)
    (m31 : LiteralTranscript.Message) (xs : List Nat)
    (s31 : State) (m32 : LiteralTranscript.Message)
    (rho : AspisWideTower.WideExact) (s32 : State)
    (h31 : rs[31]? = some (m31, (Value.queries (.ok xs), s31)))
    (h32 : rs[32]? = some (m32, (Value.ordinary rho, s32)))
    (hvalid31 : LiteralTranscript.valid 31 m31)
    (hvalid32 : LiteralTranscript.valid 32 m32)
    (q : Fin 22 → Fin 262144)
    (hdecode : LiteralQueryRead.decode xs = some q)
    (hfirst : ∀ j, MatchingSupport.match0 d (q j))
    (hbatch : ∑ j : Fin 22,
      (LiteralOpeningView.eK (SelectedChallengeMap.rhoOf rho)) ^ j.val *
        QueryResidualBridge.residuals d q j = 0) :
    9558 ≤ (MatchingSupport.matchingSet d).card := by
  let P : LiteralTranscript.Prefix := ⟨pub, rs.take 31⟩
  have hround : P.round = 31 := by simp [P, FS.Prefix.round]; omega
  have hi31 : 31 < rs.length := by omega
  have hi32 : 32 < rs.length := by omega
  have hentry31 : rs[31]'hi31 = (m31, (Value.queries (.ok xs), s31)) := by
    exact Option.some.inj ((List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi31).symm.trans h31)
  have hentry32 : rs[32]'hi32 = (m32, (Value.ordinary rho, s32)) := by
    exact Option.some.inj ((List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi32).symm.trans h32)
  have hdata : LiteralMatchingData.atQuery P m31 = some d := by
    have hd := atQuery_current_eq_read pub rs (by omega)
    rw [hentry31] at hd
    exact hd.trans hread
  have hno31 : ¬ LiteralClassifier.bad P m31
      (Value.queries (.ok xs), s31) := by
    have h := GenericNoHitIndex.not_bad_at_index LiteralClassifier.bad pub rs 31 hi31 hno
    simpa only [P, hentry31] using h
  let P32 := P.ext m31 (Value.queries (.ok xs), s31)
  have hno32 : ¬ LiteralClassifier.bad P32 m32
      (Value.ordinary rho, s32) := by
    have h := GenericNoHitIndex.not_bad_at_index LiteralClassifier.bad pub rs 32 hi32 hno
    have htake32 : rs.take 32 = P32.rounds := by
      rw [List.take_succ_eq_append_getElem (by omega)]
      simp only [P32, P, FS.Prefix.ext, hentry31]
    rw [htake32, hentry32] at h
    exact h
  exact LiteralQueryRhoSupport.large_support P m31 m32 xs s31 s32 rho d q
    hround hvalid31 hvalid32 hdata hdecode hno31 hno32 hfirst hbatch

#print axioms atQuery_current_eq_read
#print axioms large_support_of_read_noHit

end AspisR1.LiteralQueryRhoTranscriptSupport
end

R1LiteralQueryRhoSupport.text:
import R1LiteralQueryBinding
import R1LiteralRhoBinding
import R1LiteralQueryCurrentRead
import R1LiteralQueryContext

/-! The two final no-hit conditions and the actual residual checks force
large matching support for the same literal data. This is a deterministic
conditional implication; accepted-execution coverage and probability are
separate obligations. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.LiteralQueryRhoSupport

open scoped BigOperators
open LiteralTranscript
open AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
abbrev E := LiteralTranscript.E
-- This proof transports predicates, without evaluating the underlying words.
attribute [local irreducible] MatchingSupport.matchingSet QueryResidualBridge.rhoBad
  QueryResidualBridge.residuals MatchingSupport.match0
  LiteralClassifier.bad LiteralQueryDensity.bad LiteralRhoDensity.bad

theorem large_support (P : Prefix) (m31 m32 : Message)
    (xs : List Nat) (s31 s32 : State) (v : E)
    (d : MatchingSupport.Data E) (q : Fin 22 → Fin 262144)
    (hround : P.round = 31)
    (hv31 : LiteralTranscript.valid 31 m31)
    (hv32 : LiteralTranscript.valid 32 m32)
    (hdata : LiteralMatchingData.atQuery P m31 = some d)
    (hdecode : LiteralQueryRead.decode xs = some q)
    (hno31 : ¬ LiteralClassifier.bad P m31
      (TranscriptView.Value.queries (.ok xs), s31))
    (hno32 : ¬ LiteralClassifier.bad
      (P.ext m31 (TranscriptView.Value.queries (.ok xs), s31)) m32
      (TranscriptView.Value.ordinary v, s32))
    (hfirst : ∀ j, MatchingSupport.match0 d (q j))
    (hbatch : ∑ j : Fin 22,
      (LiteralOpeningView.eK (SelectedChallengeMap.rhoOf v)) ^ j.val *
        QueryResidualBridge.residuals d q j = 0) :
    9558 ≤ (MatchingSupport.matchingSet d).card := by
  let P32 := P.ext m31 (TranscriptView.Value.queries (.ok xs), s31)
  have hlen : P.rounds.length = 31 := hround
  have hr32 : P32.round = 32 := by
    simp only [P32, FS.Prefix.round, FS.Prefix.ext, List.length_append,
      List.length_singleton, hlen]
  have hd32 : LiteralMatchingData.beforeRho P32 = some d := by
    rw [LiteralQueryContext.beforeRho_ext_eq_atQuery P m31 _ hround]
    exact hdata
  have hq32 : LiteralQueryRead.queriesAt P32.rounds 31 = some q :=
    LiteralQueryCurrentRead.queriesAt_current P m31 xs s31 q hround hdecode
  have hrho : SelectedChallengeMap.rhoOf v ∉
      QueryResidualBridge.rhoBad LiteralOpeningView.eK d q := by
    intro hbad
    apply hno32
    exact (LiteralRhoBinding.rho_event_iff P32 m32 v s32 d q hr32 hv32 hd32 hq32).mpr hbad
  have hmatches := QueryResidualBridge.queries_match LiteralOpeningView.eK d q
    (SelectedChallengeMap.rhoOf v) hrho hfirst hbatch
  by_contra hsmall
  have hcard : (MatchingSupport.matchingSet d).card ≤ 9557 := by omega
  have hquery := (LiteralQueryBinding.query_event_iff P m31 xs q d s31
    hround hv31 hdata hdecode).mpr ⟨hcard, hmatches⟩
  apply hno31
  simpa only [LiteralClassifier.bad, hround, Nat.reduceLT, if_false] using hquery

#print axioms large_support

end AspisR1.LiteralQueryRhoSupport
end

R1LiteralQueryBinding.text:
import R1LiteralQueryReadFacts
import R1LiteralQueryDensity

/-! Identify the literal row-31 event with the finite query-set event once the
strict query reader and matching-data reader both succeed. This is a
conditional event identity only; no sampler, acceptance, or extraction claim
is made here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1.LiteralQueryBinding

open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript
open AspisR1.TranscriptView
open AspisR1.LiteralQueryRead
open AspisR1.LiteralQueryReadFacts
open AspisR1.LiteralQueryDensity
open AspisR1.UnifiedQueryDensity
open AspisR1.MatchingSupport

theorem query_event_iff
    (P : LiteralTranscript.Prefix) (m : LiteralTranscript.Message)
    (xs : List Nat) (q : Fin 22 → Fin 262144)
    (d : MatchingSupport.Data AspisWideTower.WideExact)
    (state : AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep.State)
    (hround : P.round = 31)
    (hvalid : LiteralTranscript.valid 31 m)
    (hdata : LiteralMatchingData.atQuery P m = some d)
    (hdecode : LiteralQueryRead.decode xs = some q) :
    LiteralQueryDensity.bad P m
      (TranscriptView.Value.queries (.ok xs), state) ↔
      ((MatchingSupport.matchingSet d).card ≤ 9557 ∧
        ∀ j : Fin 22, q j ∈ MatchingSupport.matchingSet d) := by
  have hset := LiteralQueryReadFacts.chalSet_eq_univ_image xs q hdecode
  have hcard := LiteralQueryReadFacts.chalSet_card_eq_22 xs q hdecode
  have himage_card : (Finset.univ.image q).card = 22 := by
    rw [← hset]
    exact hcard
  have hlen : (LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix P).rounds.length = 31 := by
    simpa only [LiteralTranscript.erasePrefix, List.length_map, FS.Prefix.round] using hround
  cases m with
  | initial root word => simp [LiteralTranscript.valid] at hvalid
  | c2 bytes word => simp [LiteralTranscript.valid] at hvalid
  | second bytes word => simp [LiteralTranscript.valid] at hvalid
  | payload bytes =>
      simp only [LiteralQueryDensity.bad, hround, hvalid, true_and,
        UnifiedQueryDensity.queryBad, hlen, LiteralTranscript.erase,
        LiteralQueryDensity.selectedSet, hdata, Option.map_some]
      rw [hset, himage_card]
      simp only [true_and]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hc, hsub⟩
        exact ⟨hc, fun j => hsub (Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, rfl⟩)⟩
      · rintro ⟨hc, hq⟩
        refine ⟨hc, ?_⟩
        intro x hx
        rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hx with ⟨j, _, rfl⟩
        exact hq j

#print axioms query_event_iff

end AspisR1.LiteralQueryBinding
end

R1LiteralQueryReadFacts.text:
import R1LiteralQueryRead
import R0C.V3.Q22Law

/-! Deterministic set view of a successful literal q22 list. This connects the
ordered strict reader to the old verifier's set-valued query projection; it
does not prove that an execution produces a valid query list. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1.LiteralQueryReadFacts

open AspisR1.LiteralQueryRead
open AspisV8R19.R412LegalQueryEnumeration
open R0C.V3

theorem chalSet_eq_univ_image (xs : List Nat)
    (q : Fin 22 → Fin 262144)
    (hdecode : LiteralQueryRead.decode xs = some q) :
    Q22.chalSet (.ok xs) = Finset.univ.image q := by
  obtain ⟨horder, hinj⟩ := LiteralQueryRead.decode_success xs q hdecode
  have hvalid : xs.Nodup ∧ xs.length = 22 ∧ ∀ x ∈ xs, x < 262144 := by
    unfold LiteralQueryRead.decode at hdecode
    split_ifs at hdecode with h
    · exact h
  let u : LegalQuery := legalOfList xs hvalid.1 hvalid.2.1 hvalid.2.2
  have henum : enumQuery u = xs :=
    enum_legalOfList xs hvalid.1 hvalid.2.1 hvalid.2.2
  have hcoords : (fun j : Fin 22 => (u.val j).val) =
      (fun j : Fin 22 => (q j).val) := by
    apply List.ofFn_injective
    calc
      List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 22 => (u.val j).val) = xs := henum
      _ = List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 22 => (q j).val) := horder.symm
  change (R0C.QuerySampler.querySet xs).map
      ⟨Fin.cast (by norm_num), Fin.cast_injective _⟩ = Finset.univ.image q
  rw [← henum, R0C.QuerySampler.querySet_enum]
  ext x
  simp only [Finset.mem_map, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨j, rfl⟩, hy⟩
    refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
    apply Fin.ext
    have hyv := congrArg Fin.val hy
    simpa only [Fin.val_cast] using (congrFun hcoords j).symm.trans hyv
  · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨u.val j, ⟨j, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    apply Fin.ext
    exact congrFun hcoords j

theorem chalSet_card_eq_22 (xs : List Nat)
    (q : Fin 22 → Fin 262144)
    (hdecode : LiteralQueryRead.decode xs = some q) :
    (Q22.chalSet (.ok xs)).card = 22 := by
  rw [chalSet_eq_univ_image xs q hdecode]
  rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (LiteralQueryRead.decode_success xs q hdecode).2]
  simp

#print axioms chalSet_eq_univ_image
#print axioms chalSet_card_eq_22

end AspisR1.LiteralQueryReadFacts
end

R1LiteralQueryCurrentRead.text:
import R1LiteralQueryRead

/-! A successfully decoded query challenge is visible at its current
round-31 prefix extension. This is positional list plumbing only. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1.LiteralQueryCurrentRead

open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript
open AspisR1.TranscriptView

theorem queriesAt_current
    (P : LiteralTranscript.Prefix) (m : LiteralTranscript.Message)
    (xs : List Nat) (state : AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep.State) (q : Fin 22 → Fin 262144)
    (hround : P.round = 31)
    (hdecode : LiteralQueryRead.decode xs = some q) :
    LiteralQueryRead.queriesAt
      (P.ext m (Value.queries (.ok xs), state)).rounds 31 = some q := by
  have hlen : P.rounds.length = 31 := hround
  change LiteralQueryRead.queriesAt
    (P.rounds ++ [(m, (Value.queries (.ok xs), state))]) 31 = some q
  unfold LiteralQueryRead.queriesAt
  rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by omega : P.rounds.length ≤ 31)]
  rw [hlen, Nat.sub_self]
  simp [hdecode]

#print axioms queriesAt_current

end AspisR1.LiteralQueryCurrentRead
end

R1LiteralQueryContext.text:
import R1LiteralReadStability

/-! The row-31 query sampler cannot change the matching support it is testing:
the data reader uses that row's message, but not that row's challenge. This is
prefix coherence only, separate from acceptance and query-sampler validity. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LiteralQueryContext

open LiteralTranscript

theorem current_readAt_challenge_independent {A : Type}
    (rs : List (Message × Challenge)) (m : Message) (c c' : Challenge)
    (decode : AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Bytes → Option A) :
    LiteralOpeningStages.readAt (rs ++ [(m, c)]) rs.length decode =
      LiteralOpeningStages.readAt (rs ++ [(m, c')]) rs.length decode := by
  simp only [LiteralOpeningStages.readAt, List.getElem?_append,
    Nat.lt_irrefl, if_false, Nat.sub_self, List.getElem?_cons_zero, Option.bind_some]

theorem matchingData_challenge_independent
    (rs : List (Message × Challenge)) (m : Message) (c c' : Challenge)
    (hlen : rs.length = 31) :
    LiteralMatchingData.read (rs ++ [(m, c)]) =
      LiteralMatchingData.read (rs ++ [(m, c')]) := by
  have hlast := current_readAt_challenge_independent rs m c c'
    (OpeningRecordCodec.decode .final)
  rw [hlen] at hlast
  unfold LiteralMatchingData.read
  rw [LiteralReadStability.openingView_append_stable rs _ (by omega),
    LiteralReadStability.openingView_append_stable rs _ (by omega),
    LiteralOpeningStages.readSecond_append_stable rs _ (by omega),
    LiteralOpeningStages.readSecond_append_stable rs _ (by omega), hlast,
    LiteralTranscript.vAt_append rs _ (by omega),
    LiteralTranscript.vAt_append rs _ (by omega),
    LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt_append rs _ 27 (by omega),
    LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt_append rs _ 27 (by omega),
    LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt_append rs _ 28 (by omega),
    LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt_append rs _ 28 (by omega),
    LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt_append rs _ 29 (by omega),
    LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt_append rs _ 29 (by omega),
    LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt_append rs _ 30 (by omega),
    LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt_append rs _ 30 (by omega)]

theorem beforeRho_ext_eq_atQuery (P : Prefix) (m : Message) (c : Challenge)
    (hround : P.round = 31) :
    LiteralMatchingData.beforeRho (P.ext m c) = LiteralMatchingData.atQuery P m := by
  exact matchingData_challenge_independent P.rounds m c _ hround

#print axioms current_readAt_challenge_independent
#print axioms matchingData_challenge_independent
#print axioms beforeRho_ext_eq_atQuery

end AspisR1.LiteralQueryContext

R1LiteralReadStability.text:
import R1LiteralMatchingData
import R1LiteralChallengeRead

/-! Appending entries after the last inspected index preserves the existing
literal opening/matching readers. These are list-coherence facts only. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.LiteralReadStability

open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript

theorem openingView_append_stable
    (rs tail : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (h : 26 < rs.length) :
    LiteralOpeningView.read (rs ++ tail) = LiteralOpeningView.read rs := by
  have htake : (rs ++ tail).take 25 = rs.take 25 := by
    simp only [List.take_append, Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le (show 25 ≤ rs.length by omega),
      List.take_zero, List.append_nil]
  have hlen : (rs.take 25).length = 25 := by
    simp only [List.length_take, Nat.min_eq_left (show 25 ≤ rs.length by omega)]
  cases hc1 : LiteralTranscript.c1At rs <;>
    cases hc2 : LiteralTranscript.c2At rs
  all_goals
    simp only [LiteralOpeningView.read, htake, hlen, dif_pos,
      LiteralTranscript.c1At_append rs tail (by omega),
      LiteralTranscript.c2At_append rs tail (by omega),
      LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt_append rs tail 25 (by omega),
      LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt_append rs tail 26 h,
      hc1, hc2, Option.bind_eq_bind, Option.bind_none, Option.bind_some]
  split
  · rename_i ha
    split
    · rfl
    · rename_i b hb
      have hfalse : some b = none := hb.symm.trans
        ((congrArg (LiteralSemanticPrefix.read LiteralOpeningView.eK 0) htake).symm.trans ha)
      contradiction
  · rename_i a ha
    split
    · rename_i hb
      have hfalse : some a = none := ha.symm.trans
        ((congrArg (LiteralSemanticPrefix.read LiteralOpeningView.eK 0) htake).trans hb)
      contradiction
    · rename_i b hb
      have hab : a = b := Option.some.inj (ha.symm.trans
        ((congrArg (LiteralSemanticPrefix.read LiteralOpeningView.eK 0) htake).trans hb))
      subst b
      rfl

theorem matchingData_append_stable
    (rs tail : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (h : 31 < rs.length) :
    LiteralMatchingData.read (rs ++ tail) = LiteralMatchingData.read rs := by
  unfold LiteralMatchingData.read
  rw [openingView_append_stable rs tail (by omega),
    LiteralOpeningStages.readSecond_append_stable rs tail (by omega),
    LiteralOpeningStages.readAt_append_stable rs tail 31 _ (by omega),
    LiteralTranscript.vAt_append rs tail (by omega),
    LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt_append rs tail 27 (by omega),
    LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt_append rs tail 28 (by omega),
    LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt_append rs tail 29 (by omega),
    LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt_append rs tail 30 (by omega)]

#print axioms openingView_append_stable
#print axioms matchingData_append_stable

end AspisR1.LiteralReadStability

R1LiteralPairingChecks.text:
import R1LiteralMatchingFacts
import R1SelectedOpeningPairing

/-! A successful literal matching-data read is paired exactly when its
assembled coefficient checks hold. This is a model identity only; it does not
identify the reader with a Rust acceptance path. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace AspisR1.LiteralPairingChecks

open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript
open AspisR1.LiteralOpeningView
open AspisR1.LiteralOpeningStages
open AspisR1.LiteralChallengeRead
open AspisR1.OpeningRecordCodec
open AspisR1.SelectedOpeningData
open AspisR1.MatchingSupport

abbrev E := AspisR1.LiteralMatchingData.E

def checks
    (rs : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge)) : Prop :=
  ∃ (common : LiteralOpeningView.View)
    (staged : LiteralOpeningStages.Second)
    (row31 : OpeningRecordCodec.Payload .final)
    (word : LiteralTranscript.VWord)
    (gamma kappa alpha0 alpha1 : E),
    LiteralOpeningView.read rs = some common ∧
    LiteralOpeningStages.readSecond rs = some staged ∧
    LiteralOpeningStages.readAt rs 31 (OpeningRecordCodec.decode .final) = some row31 ∧
    LiteralTranscript.vAt rs = some word ∧
    LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 27 = some gamma ∧
    LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 28 = some kappa ∧
    LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 29 = some alpha0 ∧
    LiteralChallengeRead.ordinaryAt rs 30 = some alpha1 ∧
    SelectedOpeningPairing.coefficientChecks
      (LiteralMatchingFacts.payloads staged row31)
      common.functionals common.baseFunctional gamma kappa alpha0 alpha1

theorem acceptedPairing_iff_checks
    (rs : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (d : MatchingSupport.Data E)
    (hread : LiteralMatchingData.read rs = some d) :
    MatchingSupport.AcceptedPairing d ↔ checks rs := by
  constructor
  · intro haccepted
    obtain ⟨common, staged, row31, word, gamma, kappa, alpha0, alpha1,
      hcommon, hstaged, hrow31, hword, hgamma, hkappa, halpha0, halpha1, hdata⟩ :=
      LiteralMatchingFacts.read_success_components rs d hread
    rw [hdata] at haccepted
    refine ⟨common, staged, row31, word, gamma, kappa, alpha0, alpha1,
      hcommon, hstaged, hrow31, hword, hgamma, hkappa, halpha0, halpha1, ?_⟩
    exact (SelectedOpeningPairing.acceptedPairing_iff_coefficientChecks
      (LiteralMatchingFacts.payloads staged row31) common.word word
      common.functionals common.baseFunctional gamma kappa alpha0 alpha1).mp haccepted
  · rintro ⟨common, staged, row31, word, gamma, kappa, alpha0, alpha1,
      hcommon, hstaged, hrow31, hword, hgamma, hkappa, halpha0, halpha1,
      hchecks⟩
    have hread' := hread
    simp only [LiteralMatchingData.read, hcommon, hstaged, hrow31, hword,
      hgamma, hkappa, halpha0, halpha1, Option.bind_eq_bind,
      Option.bind_some, pure, Pure.pure] at hread'
    have hdata : d = SelectedOpeningData.data
        (LiteralMatchingFacts.payloads staged row31) common.word word
        common.functionals common.baseFunctional gamma kappa alpha0 alpha1 :=
      (Option.some.inj hread').symm
    rw [hdata]
    exact (SelectedOpeningPairing.acceptedPairing_iff_coefficientChecks
      (LiteralMatchingFacts.payloads staged row31) common.word word
      common.functionals common.baseFunctional gamma kappa alpha0 alpha1).mpr hchecks

#print axioms acceptedPairing_iff_checks

end AspisR1.LiteralPairingChecks
end

R1SelectedOpeningPairing.text:
import R1SelectedOpeningData

/-! Connect explicit coefficient checks on the selected opening payloads to
the existing pairing predicate. The checks, words, functionals and challenges
are supplied inputs. No Rust execution or accepted-proof implication is proved.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.SelectedOpeningPairing

open scoped BigOperators
open AspisR1.SelectedOpeningData AspisR1.MatchingSupport

abbrev E := AspisWideTower.WideExact

def eval7 (coefficients : Fin 7 → E) (x : E) : E :=
  ∑ i : Fin 7, coefficients i * x ^ i.val

def coefficientChecks (p : SelectedOpeningData.Payloads)
    (F : Fin 6 → Functional E) (F0 : Functional E)
    (gamma kappa alpha0 alpha1 : E) : Prop :=
  eval7 p.row30.2 alpha1 = RoundPairing.dot p.row31
    (RoundPairing.dualFold (n := 64) alpha1
      (RoundPairing.dualFold (n := 256) alpha0
        (FunctionalWeights.weights F F0 kappa))) ∧
  p.row30.2 0 + p.row30.2 4 =
    RoundPairing.quarter * eval7 p.row29 alpha0 ∧
  p.row29 0 + p.row29 4 = RoundPairing.quarter *
    (∑ j : Fin 7, kappa ^ j.val *
      SelectedOpeningClaims.parts p.row25 p.row26 p.row27 p.row28 gamma j)

theorem acceptedPairing_iff_coefficientChecks (p : SelectedOpeningData.Payloads)
    (W : Fin 29 → InitialWord E) (V : FinalWord E)
    (F : Fin 6 → Functional E) (F0 : Functional E)
    (gamma kappa alpha0 alpha1 : E) :
    MatchingSupport.AcceptedPairing
      (SelectedOpeningData.data p W V F F0 gamma kappa alpha0 alpha1) ↔
    coefficientChecks p F F0 gamma kappa alpha0 alpha1 := by
  unfold MatchingSupport.AcceptedPairing SelectedOpeningData.data
  simp only [OpeningPolynomialView.firstPolynomial_boundary,
    OpeningPolynomialView.secondPolynomial_boundary]
  simp only [OpeningPolynomialView.firstPolynomial,
    OpeningPolynomialView.secondPolynomial,
    OpeningPolynomialView.polynomial_eval]
  unfold coefficientChecks eval7
  rw [SelectedOpeningClaims.parts_weighted_sum]

#print axioms acceptedPairing_iff_coefficientChecks

end AspisR1.SelectedOpeningPairing
end

R1LiteralOpeningStages.text:
import R1LiteralTranscript
import R1SelectedOpeningStages

/-! Staged strict payload reads over literal-word transcript messages. These
readers inspect only the message constructor schedule and payload bytes; they
do not inspect words, challenges, or acceptance. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.LiteralOpeningStages
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

open AspisR1.InitialWalk
open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript
open AspisR1.SelectedOpeningStages
open AspisR1.CircleRecordCodec
open AspisR1.OpeningRecordCodec

variable {A : Type}

/-- Read a selected row only when the literal message has the constructor
scheduled at that row; the bytes are obtained through the erased projection. -/
def readAt (rs : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (i : Nat) (decode : Bytes → Option A) : Option A :=
  rs[i]?.bind fun mc =>
    if LiteralTranscript.valid i mc.1 then
      match LiteralTranscript.erase mc.1 with
      | TranscriptView.Message.initial _ => none
      | TranscriptView.Message.payload bytes => decode bytes.val
    else none

theorem readAt_append_stable
    (rs tail : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (i : Nat) (decode : Bytes → Option A) (h : i < rs.length) :
    readAt (rs ++ tail) i decode = readAt rs i decode := by
  simp only [readAt, List.getElem?_append_left h]

abbrev Gamma := SelectedOpeningStages.Gamma
abbrev Kappa := SelectedOpeningStages.Kappa
abbrev First := SelectedOpeningStages.First
abbrev Second := SelectedOpeningStages.Second

def readGamma
    (rs : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge)) :
    Option Gamma := do
  let row25 ← readAt rs 25 (CircleRecordCodec.decode 0)
  let row26 ← readAt rs 26 (CircleRecordCodec.decode 1)
  let row27 ← readAt rs 27 (OpeningRecordCodec.decode .gamma)
  pure ⟨row25, row26, row27⟩

def readKappa
    (rs : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge)) :
    Option Kappa := do
  let gamma ← readGamma rs
  let row28 ← readAt rs 28 (OpeningRecordCodec.decode .kappa)
  pure ⟨gamma, row28⟩

def readFirst
    (rs : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge)) :
    Option First := do
  let kappa ← readKappa rs
  let row29 ← readAt rs 29 (OpeningRecordCodec.decode .first)
  pure ⟨kappa, row29⟩

def readSecond
    (rs : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge)) :
    Option Second := do
  let first ← readFirst rs
  let row30 ← readAt rs 30 (OpeningRecordCodec.decode .second)
  pure ⟨first, row30⟩

theorem readGamma_append_stable
    (rs tail : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (h : 27 < rs.length) : readGamma (rs ++ tail) = readGamma rs := by
  unfold readGamma
  rw [readAt_append_stable rs tail 25 _ (by omega),
      readAt_append_stable rs tail 26 _ (by omega),
      readAt_append_stable rs tail 27 _ h]

theorem readKappa_append_stable
    (rs tail : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (h : 28 < rs.length) : readKappa (rs ++ tail) = readKappa rs := by
  unfold readKappa
  rw [readGamma_append_stable rs tail (by omega),
      readAt_append_stable rs tail 28 _ h]

theorem readFirst_append_stable
    (rs tail : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (h : 29 < rs.length) : readFirst (rs ++ tail) = readFirst rs := by
  unfold readFirst
  rw [readKappa_append_stable rs tail (by omega),
      readAt_append_stable rs tail 29 _ h]

theorem readSecond_append_stable
    (rs tail : List (LiteralTranscript.Message × LiteralTranscript.Challenge))
    (h : 30 < rs.length) : readSecond (rs ++ tail) = readSecond rs := by
  unfold readSecond
  rw [readFirst_append_stable rs tail (by omega),
      readAt_append_stable rs tail 30 _ h]

#print axioms readAt_append_stable
#print axioms readGamma_append_stable
#print axioms readKappa_append_stable
#print axioms readFirst_append_stable
#print axioms readSecond_append_stable

end AspisR1.LiteralOpeningStages

import AspisFormal.V6Width29CorrelatedAgreement
import AspisFormal.V5FriDegreeThreeCorrelatedAgreement
import AspisFormal.V6EncoderDistance

/-!
# Exact published-theorem interfaces for the V6 one-fold profile

The cited papers are external inputs, so this file does not recreate their
proofs. It does something narrower and essential: states the exact predicates
Aspis needs from them and checks all finite parameter substitutions around
those predicates.

For the selected initial 29-column batch, the scalar-power curve has degree
28. Guruswami--Sudan multiplicity three gives list expression 112. The
published expression is `1010607079817216 / 3`, so the integer challenge cap
is its ceiling, `336869026605739`.

For the sole arity-four fold, the curve has degree three and the output-code
list expression is below 113. Using 113 as an integer upper bound gives the
challenge cap `9396508281246`.

Conditional on the two named published predicates, the already-formalized
root-union arguments turn those caps into bad-challenge cardinality bounds.
-/

namespace AspisV6PublishedTheoremInterfaces

open AspisSoundnessLedger
open AspisV6Width29CorrelatedAgreement
open AspisV5FriDegreeThreeCorrelatedAgreement
open AspisV6OneFoldParameterAudit

def initialAgreementThreshold : Nat := 38229
def outputAgreementThreshold : Nat := 9557
def initialListExpressionCap : Nat := 112
def outputListExpressionCap : Nat := 113
def initialBatchCurveDegree : Nat := 28
def foldCurveDegree : Nat := 3

def initialBatchChallengeCap : Nat := 336869026605739
def foldChallengeCap : Nat := 9396508281246

theorem exact_initial_list_expression :
    (((3 : Real) + 1 / 2) / Real.sqrt (1 / 1024)) =
      initialListExpressionCap := by
  rw [show Real.sqrt (1 / 1024 : Real) = 1 / 32 by
    rw [show (1 / 1024 : Real) = (1 / 32) ^ 2 by norm_num,
      Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
    norm_num]
  norm_num [initialListExpressionCap]

theorem initial_batch_expression_eq_cap_sub_one_third :
    (initialListExpressionCap : Real) *
        ((2 * (initialListExpressionCap : Real) ^ 4 / 3) *
          (1 / 1024) + 1) *
        initialBatchCurveDegree * 1048576 =
      initialBatchChallengeCap - 1 / 3 := by
  norm_num [initialListExpressionCap, initialBatchCurveDegree,
    initialBatchChallengeCap]

private theorem sqrt_outputRate_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt outputRate :=
  Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by norm_num [outputRate, finalDomainSize])

private theorem sqrt_outputRate_sq :
    Real.sqrt outputRate ^ 2 = outputRate :=
  Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num [outputRate, finalDomainSize])

theorem output_list_expression_lt_113 :
    (((3 : Real) + 1 / 2) / Real.sqrt outputRate) <
      outputListExpressionCap := by
  rw [div_lt_iff₀ sqrt_outputRate_pos]
  have hbound : (7 : Real) / 226 < Real.sqrt outputRate := by
    apply (Real.lt_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : Real) ≤ 7 / 226)).2
    norm_num [outputRate, finalDomainSize]
  norm_num only [outputListExpressionCap]
  linarith only [hbound]

theorem conservative_fold_challenge_cap :
    (outputListExpressionCap : Real) *
        ((2 * (outputListExpressionCap : Real) ^ 4 / 3) *
          (255 / 262144) + 1) *
        foldCurveDegree * 262144 = foldChallengeCap := by
  norm_num [outputListExpressionCap, foldCurveDegree, foldChallengeCap]

/-- Exact Appendix-A.2 predicate needed for the B10 26+3-column batch. -/
def PublishedInitialWidth29CurveDecodability
    {K Message : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (encoder : Message → Fin 1048576 → K) : Prop :=
  Width29CurveDecodable encoder initialAgreementThreshold
    initialBatchChallengeCap

/-- Exact degree-three curve predicate needed for the sole V6 fold. -/
def PublishedOneFoldCurveDecodability
    {K Message : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (encoder : Message → Fin 262144 → K) : Prop :=
  DegreeThreeCurveDecodable encoder outputAgreementThreshold foldChallengeCap

theorem initial_bad_response_challenges_card_le
    {K Message : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (encoder : Message → Fin 1048576 → K)
    (published : PublishedInitialWidth29CurveDecodability encoder)
    (lanes : Fin 29 → Fin 1048576 → K)
    (strategy : Width29ProximateStrategy K (Fin 1048576) Message) :
    (width29GoodChallenges encoder initialAgreementThreshold lanes
      (width29BadStrategy encoder initialAgreementThreshold lanes strategy)).card ≤
        initialBatchChallengeCap := by
  exact width29_bad_response_challenges_card_le
    encoder initialAgreementThreshold initialBatchChallengeCap published
    lanes strategy

theorem fold_bad_response_challenges_card_le
    {K Message : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    (encoder : Message → Fin 262144 → K)
    (published : PublishedOneFoldCurveDecodability encoder)
    (lanes : Fin 4 → Fin 262144 → K)
    (strategy : ProximateStrategy K (Fin 262144) Message)
    (hfalse : ¬ HasJointAgreement encoder outputAgreementThreshold lanes) :
    (goodChallenges encoder outputAgreementThreshold lanes strategy).card ≤
      foldChallengeCap := by
  exact goodChallenges_card_le_of_no_jointAgreement
    encoder outputAgreementThreshold foldChallengeCap published lanes strategy
    hfalse

/-- The exact degree-28 initial theorem, with 34 bits of authenticated work,
is below `2^-109` but not below `2^-110`. -/
theorem conditional_initial_batch_probability_le :
    (initialBatchChallengeCap : Real) / (FIELD - 1) / 2 ^ 34 ≤
      (1 : Real) / 2 ^ 109 := by
  norm_num [initialBatchChallengeCap, FIELD]

/-- The integer-113 fold cap, with 31 bits of authenticated work, is below
`2^-111`. -/
theorem conditional_fold_probability_le :
    (foldChallengeCap : Real) / FIELD / 2 ^ 31 ≤
      (1 : Real) / 2 ^ 111 := by
  norm_num [foldChallengeCap, FIELD]

/-! ## Audit -/

#print axioms exact_initial_list_expression
#print axioms initial_batch_expression_eq_cap_sub_one_third
#print axioms output_list_expression_lt_113
#print axioms conservative_fold_challenge_cap
#print axioms initial_bad_response_challenges_card_le
#print axioms fold_bad_response_challenges_card_le
#print axioms conditional_initial_batch_probability_le
#print axioms conditional_fold_probability_le

end AspisV6PublishedTheoremInterfaces

import R1JointFunctionalBinding
import R1RoundPairing

/-! Exact coefficient weights for a linear functional on a finite vector.
This does not identify any Rust weight constructor with these weights. -/

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.FunctionalWeights

open scoped BigOperators
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def weightedMap {n : Nat} (F : Fin 6 → (Fin n → K) →ₗ[K] K)
    (F0 : (Fin n → K) →ₗ[K] K) (kappa : K) : (Fin n → K) →ₗ[K] K :=
  F0 + ∑ j : Fin 6, kappa ^ (j.val + 1) • F j

def weights {n : Nat} (F : Fin 6 → (Fin n → K) →ₗ[K] K)
    (F0 : (Fin n → K) →ₗ[K] K) (kappa : K) : Fin n → K :=
  fun i => weightedMap F F0 kappa (Pi.single i 1)

theorem vector_eq_sum_single {n : Nat} (q : Fin n → K) :
    q = ∑ i : Fin n, q i • Pi.single i (1 : K) := by
  funext d
  simp [Pi.single_apply]

theorem linear_eq_dot {n : Nat} (L : (Fin n → K) →ₗ[K] K)
    (q : Fin n → K) :
    L q = AspisR1.RoundPairing.dot q (fun i => L (Pi.single i 1)) := by
  have h := congrArg L (vector_eq_sum_single q)
  simpa only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, AspisR1.RoundPairing.dot] using h

theorem dot_weights {n : Nat} (F : Fin 6 → (Fin n → K) →ₗ[K] K)
    (F0 : (Fin n → K) →ₗ[K] K) (kappa : K) (q : Fin n → K) :
    AspisR1.RoundPairing.dot q (weights F F0 kappa) =
      F0 q + ∑ j : Fin 6, kappa ^ (j.val + 1) * F j q := by
  unfold weights
  rw [← linear_eq_dot (weightedMap F F0 kappa) q]
  simp [weightedMap]

#print axioms vector_eq_sum_single
#print axioms linear_eq_dot
#print axioms dot_weights
end AspisR1.FunctionalWeights
end
